title: Biobank Lead (Senior Manager / Associate Director)
description: <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Quotient is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented operational leader to run the management, process control, governance and quality leadership of its research tissue bank. Quotient's human tissue bank is the foundation of our proprietary high-resolution somatic genetics platform, which delivers insights into cellular and organ disease biology and discovers novel targets for the development of new medicines.</p> <p>You will lead across the whole sample lifecycle, from procurement review and receipt through storage, use, reuse, transfer and disposal, and keep Quotient compliant with its Human Tissue Authority (HTA) research licence.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Research Strategy and Operations, you will work closely with the Director of Partnerships to check that proposed research fits the permissions and restrictions attached to each collection. You will also be the central point of coordination between laboratory teams, Facilities, Procurement and Logistics, Project Leads and Data Infrastructure, so that colleagues get timely access to suitable samples with full end-to-end traceability.</p> <p>This role combines ownership of the tissue bank with practical oversight of delivery. Success means reliable, well-organised inventory and chain-of-custody records, timely availability of samples for research, compliance with internal SOPs and HTA regulations, and effective resolution of any sample-related incidents.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Biobank governance and strategy: </strong>Own Quotient's research tissue bank strategy, aligning governance, capacity, resources and operating systems with the research portfolio, and recommend investment and improvements. Report sample availability, integrity, traceability, compliance risks and incident trends to leadership.</li> <li><strong>HTA compliance: </strong>Act as the HTA Designated Individual for Quotient's research licence, supervising licensed activities and making sure that staff, premises, storage and procedures meet HTA requirements. Develop SOPs, oversee training and competency assurance, and lead inspection readiness and responses, covering UK HTA, GDPR, research ethics and health and safety standards.</li> <li><strong>Sample access and use authorisation: </strong>Review access, initial use, reuse and onward transfer against consent, research ethics approvals, licence scope and contractual permissions, and document each decision. Apply independent judgement to complex sample-use decisions, balancing scientific priorities with donor permissions, sample availability and governance requirements, and obtain specialist advice or further approvals where needed.</li> <li><strong>Sample acquisition and custody: </strong>Own custody controls from handover at receipt through registration, storage, retrieval, distribution and disposal, including manifests, shipment conditions, acceptance checks, handovers and receipt acknowledgements. Set requirements for human tissue shipments and approve the release of inbound and outbound shipments, working with logistics colleagues who handle couriers and documentation. Provide cover for sample receipt and shipping, directly or through trained delegates.</li> <li><strong>Inventory systems and traceability: </strong>Integrate sample inventory with LIMS and ELN records, keeping identifiers, parent–derivative relationships, quantities, locations, status and movement histories accurate through timely updates, controlled access and periodic reconciliation. Ensure accurate annotation and metadata for all biospecimens, work with the Data Infrastructure team to bring sample data into research pipelines, and report on utilisation, inventory status and operational metrics.</li> <li><strong>Storage integrity and continuity: </strong>Manage storage organisation and capacity with laboratory and facilities colleagues. Work with the team that owns the temperature-monitoring system to make sure it is fit for purpose and supports HTA compliance, sign off monitoring procedures and the training of staff who use it, and check calibration and alarm-test records as part of routine internal audits. Own specimen decisions during alarms and recovery, including integrity assessment, transfers, holds and incident recording, and agree documented default actions so that out-of-hours response does not wait for a specimen decision.</li> <li><strong>Incident resolution and corrective action: </strong>Escalate concerns, pause non-compliant activities and hold samples where eligibility, documentation or integrity is unresolved. Run a quality-driven incident process, track corrective and preventive actions and approve closure.</li> <li><strong>Capability and culture: </strong>Build capability through coaching, knowledge sharing and effective cover arrangements across the biobank and sample-management network. Create an environment where colleagues raise concerns, learn from incidents and share accountability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <p>You are an experienced biobanking or human tissue governance leader who combines sound regulatory judgement with practical delivery. You can make and explain proportionate decisions, influence across functions and build quality-based systems that support a growing research portfolio.</p> <p><strong>Essential criteria</strong></p> <ul> <li>BSc in Biological Sciences, Biomedical Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.</li> <li>More than 5 years working with human biological samples in a research, biotechnology, biobank or clinical laboratory setting, including leadership of sample governance and operations across the sample lifecycle.</li> <li>Demonstrated leadership, including setting direction, developing colleagues and capability, influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority, and resolving competing priorities.</li> <li>Experience working across a variety of quality systems, and able to interpret guidelines and apply basic principles in a research setting.</li> <li>Experience reviewing consent, ethics and provenance documentation, interpreting sample-use restrictions, and assessing proposed use, reuse and transfer in collaboration with scientific, partnerships and legal colleagues.</li> <li>Experience reviewing sample-related provisions in MTAs, SLAs, MSAs or equivalent agreements and translating those obligations into operational controls.</li> <li>Proven ownership of sample accessioning, chain of custody, storage, database inventory and distribution processes, with practical experience of LIMS, ELN or comparable systems and their data quality and access controls.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of the Human Tissue Act 2004, HTA research licensing and relevant standards, with experience supporting or leading licensed activities.</li> <li>Experience developing controlled documentation, training staff, preparing for audits or inspections, and leading incident investigations, corrective and preventive actions and documented closure.</li> <li>Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and professional judgement, with a commitment to donor respect, confidentiality, scientific quality and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable criteria</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous appointment as an HTA Designated Individual, or substantial experience as a Person Designated with responsibility for tissue governance, inspections and compliance improvement.</li> <li>Familiarity with handling low-complexity clinical data and associated regulatory frameworks (GDPR).</li> <li>Experience in genomics, molecular biology or high-throughput research, including support for histology, flow cytometry or molecular workflows.</li> <li>Experience with cryogenic storage, freezer monitoring, sample integrity assessment and business continuity arrangements.</li> <li>Knowledge or experience of REC applications.</li> <li>Experience coordinating domestic and international sample transfers, external biobanks, offsite sample storage companies or CROs, and working with third-party logistics teams within a growing biotechnology organisation.</li> <li>Experience developing colleagues or leading a biobank or sample reception team, and implementing inventory platforms or significant process improvements.</li> <li>Evidence of building or improving tissue bank processes and systems, planning capacity and resources, and balancing scientific delivery with ethical and regulatory responsibilities.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>About Quotient:</strong></p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics is a privately-held, early stage company developing breakthrough medicines informed by natural somatic genetic diversity present in patients. Through our work in somatic genomics, we are forging a new status quo for biopharma research and development across a broad pipeline of internal and partnered programs. </p> <p>The company was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovative enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Generate Biomedicines, Sana Biotechnology (SANA), Tessera Therapeutics, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Indigo Agriculture, Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), and Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS).</p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics and Flagship Pioneering are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.</p> <p><strong>Recruitment & Staffing Agencies:</strong></p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics (“Quotient”) and Flagship Pioneering (“FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. title: Senior Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are on the lookout for a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> to join our <strong>Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team</strong> and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What is The Role</strong></h3> <p>The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.</p> <p>As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.</p> <p>The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.</li> <li>Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.</li> <li>Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.</li> <li>Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.</li> <li>Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.</li> <li>A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.</li> <li>Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.</li> <li>You can explain how tool calls and their results flow through each iteration, how context grows across turns and how you manage it, and how the loop decides to stop.</li> <li>Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.</li> <li>Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.</li> <li>Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.</li> <li>Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.</li> <li>Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.</li> <li>Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.</li> <li>Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.</li> <li>Practical Elasticsearch experience.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</p> <p>We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email <a ----- ----- class="gmail_default">.</span> We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.</p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below:</span> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf" target="_blank">Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster;</span><span style="color: #000000;"> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_%20English_formattedESQA508c.pdf" target="_blank">Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision</a> Poster; </span><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppabw.pdf" target="_blank">Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster and <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights.pdf" target="_blank">Know Your Rights</a> (Poster)</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.</span></p> <p>Please see <a href="https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement&source=gmail&ust=1611068262479000&usg=AFQjCNG3orAPk5sJIr9WVm0ZDxYw82c5DA">here</a> for our Privacy Statement.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: IT Support Analyst
description: 📍 Sheffield and Lincoln Hybrid - 3 days per week in office (2 of which will be one office with the 3rd day in the other office), 2 working remotely. The Opportunity: We are looking for an IT Support & Security Analyst to act as the primary technical point of contact across our Sheffield and Lincoln offices, reporting to the IT and Security Manager. You will split your time between front-line helpdesk operations and proactive security administration in a fast-paced, adaptable environment. Helpdesk & On-Site Support : Serve as the go-to contact for hardware (macOS, Windows, ChromeOS), connectivity, and tickets logged via Freshservice across Sheffield and Lincoln. Identity & Cloud Administration : Manage full user lifecycles, access permissions, policies, and Google Workspace configurations. Device & Patch Management : Enrol, monitor, and secure endpoints using Google MDM, Hexnode, and Intune, maintaining automated patch schedules via Action1. Security & Incident Operations : Monitor, investigate, and remediate alerts across SentinelOne EDR/MDR, GCP, and email security tools, while proactively mitigating emerging threats. Networking, Compliance & AI : Support Cisco Meraki networking and VPNs, maintain SOPs and audit evidence for vendor and security assessments, and assist with rollouts of internal AI productivity tools. What we need from you: Bring experience in IT support, systems engineering, or security operations, backed by strong knowledge of core networking concepts. Have hands-on administration experience with macOS, Windows, or ChromeOS, alongside MDM tools like Hexnode, Intune, or Google MDM. Possess practical experience maintaining compliance evidence in an ISMS (such as Vanta, Drata, or Sprinto) aligned with Cyber Essentials and ISO 27001. Are a proactive troubleshooter who digs into both hardware issues and suspicious logs, knowing precisely when to resolve or escalate. Excel at communication - able to explain security plainly to non-technical colleagues while collaborating effectively with senior engineers. It would also be great if you have: Experience with security and network tooling, specifically alert triage in EDR/MDR platforms (e.g., SentinelOne), Cisco Meraki, and OpenVPN. Practical background in Google Workspace Administration and service desk platforms such as Freshservice. Relevant industry certifications (CompTIA A+/Security+, Google Workspace, ISC2 CC) or an interest in applying AI tools to IT and security workflows. title: Complaints Team Leader - Claims
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. Purpose of the role Claims complaints at an insurer are where things get real — the customer is already in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences. As Team Leader for Claims Complaints, you'll own the day-to-day running of a team of case handlers, balancing hands-on case work with genuine people leadership. You'll ensure complaints are investigated thoroughly, resolved fairly, and handled in line with DISP and Consumer Duty — and you'll be accountable for the standard your team sets. You'll report to the Complaints Manager and work closely with the Customer Support & FOS Team Leader to keep standards consistent across the wider function. What you will be doing Team Leadership Manage day-to-day operations across case assignment, workload distribution, and queue management Hold regular 1-2-1s, set development plans, and drive continuous improvement in your team Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases to the Complaints Manager promptly Monitor KPIs and identify areas for improvement Quality & Compliance Sign off Final Response Letters, ensuring they are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across all case handling Collaboration Work with Claims Technical, Underwriting, and Legal & Regulatory Affairs on coverage, avoidance, or legal risk complaints Partner with the Customer Support & FOS Team Leader to maintain consistent standards across the function Contribute to QA reviews, training needs analysis, and complaint trend improvements What you will need to be successful Essential Experience handling motor insurance claims or complaints within an FCA-regulated environment. Working knowledge of DISP and Consumer Duty as they apply to complaint handling. Experience leading a team, or clear readiness to step into a first-line leadership role. You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable. Desirable: Cert CII or working towards a financial services qualification. Experience of ShareDo, Snowflake, or Looker, or equivalent case management and MI tools. The Zego ways of working 🏡 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year. Here is what the last one looked like . Benefits 🎁 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year. 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution. 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build 🩺 Private medical insurance. 🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new. 💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact. Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you. Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. title: Social Media Manager (w/m/d)
description: ZEAL Network SE ist ein führender internationaler Anbieter von Online-Lotterieprodukten und seit über 20 Jahren mit Marken wie LOTTO24 und Tipp24 aktiv. Als Deutschlands größter digitaler Lotterieanbieter und vertrauenswürdiger Partner von ONCE in Spanien gestalten wir mit Leidenschaft die Zukunft des Lotterieerlebnisses. Traumautoverlosung ist eine der neuesten und aufregendsten Marken von ZEAL. Sie macht den Traum vom eigenen Wunschauto greifbar: mit einem Ticket sichern sich Spielende die Chance auf ein exklusives Fahrzeug. Gleichzeitig unterstützt jede Teilnahme soziale Projekte, sodass aus der Gewinnchance ein echter sozialer Mehrwert entsteht. Die Traumautoverlosung verbindet den Nervenkitzel des Gewinnens mit einer bedeutenden sozialen Auswirkung und spiegelt damit ZEALs Engagement für Innovation und soziale Verantwortung wider. Sie bietet den Teilnehmenden mehr als nur ein Spiel - die Chance, Gutes zu tun und gleichzeitig groß zu träumen. Deine Aufgaben: Du baust unsere Community auf Instagram, TikTok, YouTube und weiteren Social-Media-Kanälen aktiv aus, förderst den Austausch und sorgst für eine lebendige Interaktion mit unserer Zielgruppe. Du bist die Stimme unserer Marke in Social Media und sorgst für eine authentische, einheitliche und wiedererkennbare Kommunikation. Du entwickelst kreative, plattformgerechte Content-Formate rund um unsere Traumautos, die Welt der Autoverlosungen und unseren Gründer. Du produzierst eigenständig und spontan Social-Media-Content, beispielsweise direkt vor Ort in unserer Traumgarage – vor oder hinter der Kamera. Du verantwortest die Veröffentlichung unserer organischen Inhalte, analysierst deren Performance und optimierst unsere Content-Strategie kontinuierlich. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Paid Social Manager zusammen, um organische und bezahlte Inhalte optimal aufeinander abzustimmen. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Content Creatorn und Influencern auf und entwickelst unser Netzwerk kontinuierlich weiter. Du vertrittst unsere Marke auf Events und in der Automotive-Szene, knüpfst Kontakte und stärkst unsere Präsenz innerhalb der Community. Was du mitbringst: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Social Media Management, idealerweise für eine Marke mit einer aktiven und engagierten Community. Du bist kreativ, entwickelst kontinuierlich neue Content-Ideen, erkennst Trends frühzeitig und setzt diese schnell um. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für plattformgerechten Content auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube und weißt, welche Formate die jeweilige Zielgruppe begeistern. Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Produktion und Bearbeitung von Short-Form-Videos mit dem Smartphone und fühlst dich bei Bedarf auch vor der Kamera wohl. Du arbeitest datengetrieben, analysierst relevante Social-Media-KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du hast bereits mit Creatorn oder Influencern zusammengearbeitet oder bringst ein gutes Gespür für den Aufbau langfristiger Partnerschaften mit. Du begeisterst dich für Autos und die Automotive-Szene oder bist motiviert, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Gewinnspielen, Verlosungen, E-Commerce oder anderen Community-getriebenen Geschäftsmodellen mit. Erste Kontakte in der Automotive- und Creator-Szene, Erfahrung mit Tools wie CapCut oder Premiere wären ein Plus Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir anbieten: Eine moderne, dynamische Unternehmenskultur, basierend auf dem Erfolg eines innovativen E-Commerce-Unternehmens. Ein talentiertes Team aus ambitionierten, gleichgesinnten Kolleg*innen, in dem dein Wissen und deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. title: Senior Majors Account Executive, France
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Location:</span><strong> </strong><strong>Paris<br></strong></h2> <hr> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and Majors Account Executive<strong> </strong>to join our Enterprise/Field Sales Team in France. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare’s platform sale, actively involving and influencing senior technical executives.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of regional specialists, Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare’s services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the “why,” communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation and Closure:</strong> Lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate strong closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Trusted Advisor and Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, supporting deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of their work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organisation.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Organisational Impact and Leadership:</strong> Focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Contribute to Cloudflare’s broader sales organisation while elevating the work of others through diverse perspectives and strategic thinking.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, description: termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. title: Paid Working Student: Medical Device Design and Engineering
description: About Piomic Piomic Medical AG is an award-winning Zürich medtech company on a mission to change how chronic and acute wounds are treated. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 60 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 6 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description: <p><strong>Working at CreateFuture</strong><br><br><a href="https://createfuture.com/" target="_blank">CreateFuture</a> is an <strong>AI-native consulting partner </strong>where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.</p> <p>We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.<br><br>CreateFuture is a <a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/certified-company/1572759" target="_blank">Great Place to Work-Certified™ company </a>and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.<br><br></strong></p> <div class="_1bsb1osq _18s8y1gf _p12fukw8" data-testid="view-page-labels-container"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">About the role and team:</strong> <p>CreateFuture is looking for a collaborative, technically grounded Senior Business Analyst to join our team.</p> <p>Our Senior Business Analysts drive high-impact change across a broad spectrum of client engagements. While we deliver end-to-end digital products, this role is tailored for a BA who is as comfortable driving complex back-end environments (such as API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture, and system integration logic) as they are crafting front-end user experiences and feature specifications.</p> <p>You’ll leverage your proficiency in business analysis, system architecture, and product strategy to guide project development, acting as the crucial bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities span meticulous requirements analysis, data flow mapping, estimation, and championing delivery best practices within your team.</p> <p>Your exceptional communication skills are pivotal for translating complex client objectives into clear, developer-ready specifications and data flows, ensuring what we build is both valuable for users and technically robust under the hood.</p> <p>Does this sound like you? Do you have a passion for the craft of Business Analysis, a natural curiosity for how complex backend systems work, and an interest in how modern tools are changing how we work? If so, we’d love to talk to you.</p> <h4><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What you'll be doing:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Evaluate current and emerging business procedures, collaborating with clients and internal teams to propose impactful system solutions and process improvements.</li> <li>Proactively bring cross-functional teams together to shape user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and technical specifications (including API contracts, payload logic, and data mappings).</li> <li>Facilitate data analysis, query system data to uncover edge cases, and map complex integration dependencies across backend architecture.</li> <li>Manage project backlogs during discovery, build, and run phases, balancing business priorities against technical constraints, non-functional requirements (NFRs), and engineering effort.</li> <li>Support and lead client discovery conversations, driving estimation efforts, facilitating workshops, and championing best practices across your project team.</li> </ul> <div class="styles--2BkR3" data-ui="job-description"> <h4><strong>We'd love to talk to you if you have: </strong></h4> <ul> <li>Proven experience delivering both product-led user initiatives and complex technical projects (e.g., API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture).</li> <li>Experience working for a Consultancy or Client facing environment</li> <li>Strong experience as a Technical Business Analyst working closely with engineering, architecture and product teams.</li> <li>Experience working with data, including data mapping, data models, databases and ideally SQL.</li> <li>A strong track record of working alongside engineering teams to analyse data flows, system logic, and technical dependencies.</li> <li>A user-centric mindset that ensures backend architectural choices directly support a seamless end-user experience.</li> <li>Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of business context and translating complex goals into clear. specifications.</li> <li>Bring meticulous requirements analysis, lead estimation efforts, and champion best practices across your project team.<br><br> <h3><strong>Bonus points if you have:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experimented with AI tools to accelerate research, draft baseline specifications, map data fields, or red-team edge cases in system flows.</li> <li>Exposure to or curiosity about how modern AI capabilities, LLMs, or agentic workflows integrate into backend system architectures.</li> <li>A proactive approach to exploring new tools and techniques that improve the speed and quality of business analysis, with a desire to share those learnings with colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><em>You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert. If you haven’t yet had much opportunity to put AI into practice in your BA work, that shouldn’t stop you from applying. What matters to us is curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and a commitment to high-quality analysis. Everyone at CreateFuture undertakes AI-native training, and we’ll support you to build these capabilities and put them into practice.</em></p> </li> </ul> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 id="What-we’ll-offer-you:" data-renderer-start-pos="8044"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we’ll offer you:</strong></h3> <p>We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.<br><br>We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.</p> <p>We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.</p> <h3><strong>Our hiring process</strong></h3> <p>We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.</p> <p>It usually looks like this:</p> <ul> <li>Call with our Talent Acquisition Team </li> <li>Role specific capability interview </li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.</p> <h3><strong>Inclusion at CreateFuture </strong></h3> <p>We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.</p> <p>If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.</p> <p>We look forward to your application!</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Robot Learning Engineer
description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations. Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after. The scope This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it. What we are looking for 3+ years of relevant full-time robotics experience. PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted. You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall. You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists. Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim.. Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise. AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was. Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2. What success looks like in 90 days You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like. Are we a good fit? Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit? . What we offer The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started Benefits — see what we offer Are you in? title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
description: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about. Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally. Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation. Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production. title: Outcomes Architect Manager, MEDIT
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness. If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion. - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes. - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership. - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met. - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals. - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value. - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion. - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy. - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation. - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it. - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account. - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans. - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams. - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team. - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity. - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership. - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers. - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes. NICE TO HAVES - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes. - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management. - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership. - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path. - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model. - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €153,000-€171,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base. - Set the bar for product and AI fluency across the team and ensure your team masters Notion’s product and maintains an expert-level knowledge of the AI ecosystem. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working NICE TO HAVES: - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Product Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <h4><strong>Role Summary</strong></h4> <p>As a Product Security Engineer, you will support security assessments and vulnerability operations for Cloudflare’s core software products. In this role, you will analyze system architecture, threat model new features, and ensure that product-related security findings are accurately triaged, routed to the correct engineering owners, and mitigated within our SLAs.</p> <p>On any given day, you might conduct a deep-dive security review on a new feature design, triage a complex bug bounty submission, or work directly with engineering teams to resolve vulnerabilities from different sources like bug bounties, SAST, fuzzing and penetration tests. You will also work autonomously to identify areas where our manual processes slow down. You will write code and integrate AI/LLM solutions to automate initial triage and data enrichment, building tools that help the team handle security findings at scale. In short, your work will sit at the intersection of Product Security, Vulnerability Operations, and internal AI Tooling. Ideally, you have experience in conducting academic/vulnerability research with a focus on systems security.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Implement AI Security Solutions:</strong> Identify process bottlenecks and build AI-driven tools or scripts to help automate code analysis, optimize triage, and streamline Product Security workflows.</li> <li><strong>Security Reviews & Threat Modeling:</strong> Conduct structured security reviews and threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE) across product features, defining security requirements early in the development lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Product Vulnerability Management:</strong> Manage the operational lifecycle of product security findings. Ensure vulnerabilities are verified, mapped to the correct engineering owner, and tracked to mitigation in alignment with established SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Bug Bounty Triage:</strong> Perform the technical triage and validation of Cloudflare’s external Bug Bounty submissions, verifying exploitability and evaluating business risk.</li> <li><strong>Pentest Coordination:</strong> Support internal and external penetration testing engagements by reviewing findings, clarifying technical context, and assisting development teams with remediation strategies.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with DevOps and product teams, acting as a reliable security point of contact and helping developers implement secure coding practices.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Product/AppSec Expertise:</strong> 5+ years of experience in Product or Application Security within large-scale distributed cloud environments or SaaS platforms.</li> <li><strong>Practical AI & Automation Engineering:</strong> Demonstrated ability to build production-grade automation scripts and tools. Must possess hands-on engineering experience leveraging AI/LLMs to solve operational or technical challenges.</li> <li><strong>Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis:</strong> Competency in threat modeling methodologies and the ability to evaluate code flaws to determine their actual engineering and security impact.</li> <li><strong>Vulnerability Lifecycle Operations:</strong> Experience tracking, routing, and driving the remediation of software vulnerabilities across engineering groups while working against defined SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Strong Collaboration & Communication:</strong> Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, clearly communicating technical security risks to software engineers and resolving ownership ambiguity constructively.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Offensive Security Tooling:</strong> Familiarity with modern exploitation techniques, fuzzing frameworks, or automated scanning utilities.</li> <li><strong>Program Management Experience:</strong> Experience scaling crowdsourced security programs (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd) or optimizing agile project management workflows within JIRA.</li> <li>Experience in integrating hardware security features into production code bases</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: PHP / Joomla Entwickler (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Wir entwickeln und betreiben moderne Softwarelösungen für den Automobilhandel. Unsere Anwendungen und Webseiten unterstützen Händler bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und der Vermarktung ihrer Fahrzeugbestände. Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen PHP / Joomla Entwickler (m/w/d), der Freude daran hat, professionelle Webprojekte technisch umzusetzen, kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und langfristig zu betreuen. Dabei arbeitest du sowohl an der Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP und Joomla als auch an der Umsetzung moderner, responsiver Benutzeroberflächen. Deine Aufgaben Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Joomla-Webprojekten: Du entwickelst, betreust und optimierst bestehende sowie neue Webseiten auf Basis des Content-Management-Systems Joomla. Entwicklung individueller Joomla-Erweiterungen: Du konzipierst und implementierst eigene Joomla-Module, Plugins und bei Bedarf weitere Erweiterungen und integrierst diese in bestehende Projekte. Frontend-Entwicklung: Du setzt vorgegebene Designs und Layouts mit HTML, CSS und JavaScript technisch präzise um und sorgst für eine responsive, performante und benutzerfreundliche Darstellung. Template-Entwicklung und -Anpassung: Du entwickelst und individualisierst Joomla-Templates und stellst eine konsistente Darstellung auf unterschiedlichen Endgeräten sicher. Anbindung externer Systeme: Du integrierst externe Dienste und Datenquellen über Schnittstellen, insbesondere REST-APIs, und entwickelst bei Bedarf eigene Schnittstellenanbindungen. Wartung und Qualitätssicherung: Du übernimmst die technische Pflege bestehender Webseiten, führst Updates durch, analysierst Fehler und sorgst für einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb. Versionsverwaltung und Dokumentation: Du arbeitest strukturiert mit Git, dokumentierst technische Lösungen nachvollziehbar und achtest auf eine saubere, wartbare Codebasis. Technische Optimierung: Du verbesserst kontinuierlich die Performance, Sicherheit, Barrierefreiheit und technische Qualität unserer Webprojekte. Das bringst du mit Deine fachlichen Qualifikationen Fundierte Erfahrung mit Joomla: Du hast bereits eigenständig Joomla-Projekte entwickelt und betreut und kennst dich mit der Architektur, dem Template-System sowie der Entwicklung und Integration von Erweiterungen aus. Sehr gute PHP-Kenntnisse: Du beherrschst PHP sicher und verfügst über Erfahrung in der objektorientierten Programmierung sowie im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, insbesondere MySQL/MariaDB. Sehr gute Frontend-Kenntnisse: HTML5, CSS3 und JavaScript gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug. Du kannst Designvorgaben eigenständig in hochwertige, responsive Webseiten umsetzen. Erfahrung mit APIs: Du hast bereits REST-Schnittstellen angebunden und bist mit JSON, HTTP und gängigen Authentifizierungsverfahren vertraut. Sicherer Umgang mit Git: Versionsverwaltung und strukturierte Entwicklungsprozesse sind für dich selbstverständlich. Qualitätsbewusstsein: Du legst Wert auf gut strukturierten, wartbaren und dokumentierten Code. Verständnis für Webstandards: Du kennst die Grundlagen moderner Webentwicklung hinsichtlich Performance, Sicherheit, Responsivität und Browserkompatibilität. Das wäre zusätzlich von Vorteil Erfahrung mit aktuellen Joomla-Versionen und der Migration bestehender Installationen. Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung eigener Joomla-Komponenten und komplexerer Erweiterungen. Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Composer und modernen PHP-Entwicklungswerkzeugen. Erfahrung mit Linux-basierten Webservern und gängigen Hosting-Umgebungen. Grundkenntnisse in technischer Suchmaschinenoptimierung (SEO) und Web-Barrierefreiheit (WCAG). So arbeitest du Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du … gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitest und technische Aufgaben selbstständig löst. ein gutes Auge für Details hast und Wert auf eine saubere Umsetzung von Designvorgaben legst. sowohl Backend- als auch Frontend-Aufgaben mit Freude übernimmst. bestehende Lösungen nicht nur wartest, sondern auch Verbesserungspotenziale erkennst. strukturiert arbeitest und deine Lösungen für andere Entwickler nachvollziehbar dokumentierst. gerne im Team arbeitest und dich mit Kollegen über technische Lösungen austauschst. Das erwartet dich bei uns Abwechslungsreiche Webprojekte: Du arbeitest an professionellen Webseiten und digitalen Lösungen für den Automobilhandel. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, technische Lösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und eigene Ideen einzubringen. Langfristige Perspektive: Dich erwartet eine unbefristete Festanstellung mit vielseitigen Entwicklungsaufgaben. Moderne Entwicklungsprozesse: Wir setzen auf strukturierte Zusammenarbeit, Versionsverwaltung und nachhaltige Softwareentwicklung. Ein kollegiales Entwicklerteam: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Kollegen zusammen und profitierst vom gemeinsamen technischen Austausch. Raum für Weiterentwicklung: Du kannst deine Kenntnisse vertiefen und dich fachlich und technologisch weiterentwickeln. Interesse geweckt? Du hast Erfahrung mit Joomla, fühlst dich in PHP genauso wohl wie in HTML, CSS und JavaScript und möchtest anspruchsvolle Webprojekte langfristig mitgestalten?
