title: Growth Manager, Website & Product Configurator (m/f/d)
description: About the Company You will be joining a fast-growing, founder-led European signage company that designs, produces and installs custom branded signs and visual identity systems for businesses of every size, from start-ups to global brands. Growing 40–50% year-on-year, the company is on its way to becoming the first marketing-led player in a complex, traditionally offline industry. Its websites and online configurators are where most customer journeys begin, so the focus now is on turning them into even stronger digital sales engines. The Role As Growth Manager, you will own how the company’s websites, landing pages and lead funnels turn visitors into customers across its brands, and help shape the build of a new product configurator. This is a hands-on ownership role: you decide what to test, write the copy, shape the experience with a designer and AI tools, and turn data and customer insight into measurable gains in conversion. Key Responsibilities Own and continuously improve the company’s websites, landing pages and conversion funnels, and set the test roadmap Plan, build and analyse A/B tests on full pages and individual sections, and report what moved and why Write sharp headlines, USPs, CTAs and website copy in German that turn visitors into customers Design intuitive, visually strong web experiences that convert, working alongside a designer and AI tools Help shape the experience and build of a new online product configurator, from user needs and flows to launch KPIs, together with Design and Tech Run customer surveys and user research independently, and translate data and insights into prioritised growth experiments Plan and develop SEO pages with support from the copywriting team Drive execution across Performance Marketing, Content, Design and Tech, and report on the impact of every change Ideal Candidate Must have Fluent German and professional English, as website copy is a core part of the role Around 3+ years of experience in CRO, growth, e-commerce or digital product management. Exceptional candidates with less experience and a strong track record are also welcome A proven talent for concise, sales-driven web copy and persuasive messaging Strong analytical thinking and commercial understanding: you tie every change back to conversion and revenue Uses AI tools natively in day-to-day work, from research to copy to design Self-directed: sets clear priorities and owns outcomes with a high degree of autonomy Based in Berlin or willing to relocate, for a hybrid set-up Nice to have Excellent UX/UI understanding and a strong aesthetic sense SEO experience Experience with e-commerce or product configurators Tools & Stack Claude, Claude Code, n8n, make.com, Bitrix24 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description: <p><strong>THE ROLE 📝</strong><br><br>We’re looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Manager to lead Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy, helping drive pipeline growth and brand development across our priority markets. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you’ll combine strategic ownership with execution across integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, digital acquisition and performance measurement. accounts.<br><br><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own Form3’s digital growth and demand generation strategy.</li> <li>Create go-to-market plans for products, propositions, smoothly.</p> <p>Working cross-functionally with Planning, Production, Finance, Culinary, and Operations, you'll play a key role in ensuring the right products are available at the right time, while driving operational excellence and supporting Factor's continued growth.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="text-align: left;">Lead and develop our Procurement Operations title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.</li> <li>Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.</li> <li>Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.</li> <li>Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <h2><strong>You are...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.</li> <li>Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.</li> <li>A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.</li> <li>Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.</li> <li>Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> title: Senior AI Specialist
description: <h3><strong>Hi 👋 we’re Genio. We create beautifully simple learning tools that boost knowledge, skills, and confidence.</strong></h3> <p> </p> <ul> <li>We’re a SaaS scale up - there’s 90+ of us around the UK with our HQ in Leeds.</li> <li>Our software is award-winning and used by 100,000s of students at over 1,000 universities & colleges worldwide.</li> <li>We’re driven achieve our mission to support 1 million students to become better learners by 2030.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4><strong>🚀 About the role</strong></h4> <p><strong>Career track:</strong> IC4</p> <p><strong>Unit:</strong> Shared Services</p> <p> </p> <p>Genio has given everyone access to Claude, but most of what makes AI work across a company doesn’t exist here yet: connections to our business systems, a shared skills library, people in each team who can help their colleagues, and the checks that keep it safe. This role designs and builds that system, then gets every team using it.</p> <p> </p> <p>It’s a hands-on building role. We buy and configure leading platforms rather than build our own agent infrastructure, and you’ll write code and build custom integrations wherever configuration isn’t enough. Success is measured by how well other teams build and run their own workflows.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>You will be responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design.</strong> You design how our AI platforms, connectors, skills and agents fit together. You track what’s changing in AI tools, recommend platform and model choices to the Head of BizOps, and judge new tools on measured performance, reliability, security and cost.</li> <li><strong>Build and run.</strong> You build and maintain the integrations and agents that connect our AI platforms to business systems such as our CRM and our documentation, communication and finance tools. You’re responsible for the health of the whole system: spotting failures and out-of-date skills, and tracking use and cost by team so they can be recharged and reported. Champions answer first-line questions and IT handles access, while you handle escalations and fix root causes so problems don’t come back.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge.</strong> You build and look after the skills library and the shared knowledge our AI tools draw on: where it lives, how it’s organised, and how it’s kept current and correctly permissioned. You spot good workflows in one team, refine them and make them available to everyone, and decide which become company standards. The teams that own content keep it up to date.</li> <li><strong>Adoption.</strong> You train people at every level of technical skill and build a network of champions, nominated by their function heads, so every team has someone nearby to ask. You work alongside teams as they redesign processes, bringing the options for what can be automated, and share practice with engineering in both directions. and cross-cultural communication, sound discretion, and the ability to make practical recommendations from incomplete information.</li> <li>Must reside in the UK or the Netherlands.</li> </ul> expertise or additional language capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Director, International Affairs that is:</p> <ul> <li>Able to connect <li>Passionate about clean energy </li> <li>Passionate about making advanced fission a reality</li> <li>Willing and able to learn quickly</li> <li>Highly strategic and a forward-looking thinker</li> aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. title: Senior EW Direction Finding & Estimation Engineer (All Genders)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">WHY JOIN US</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>YOUR MISSION</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will turn our directional mesh network into a sensor. Using the same aperture that carries traffic, you will build direction finding, spectrum sensing, and GNSS-free position estimation, and prove their accuracy in the field against surveyed references. You own the error budget and the evidence, from IQ samples up to a validated position.</span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">STARK's Electronic Warfare team is a systems-focussed engineering group delivering software-defined, mass-scalable RF solutions for autonomous systems. Combining deep domain expertise in hardware board design, thermal/ structural packaging, real-time C++ signal processing, and resilient directional mesh networking, we rapidly build field advanced EW capabilities designed to survive and operate in contested spectrum environments. </span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Build position estimation from the mesh itself under GNSS denial: TDOA/TOA ranging, multilateration, geometry and GDOP, the clock-synchronisation error budget, and fusion with platform navigation.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop the DF and baseline spectrum-sensing chain on the directional aperture that carries traffic, running concurrently with communications.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own antenna calibration together with the antenna team, and keep it valid in the field.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the error budget, design validation campaigns against surveyed references, and produce the evidence packs for programme milestones.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You have measured DF accuracy against real signals and done localisation with an explicit geometry and error budget. Practical experience is what counts here, not GNSS integration or theory alone.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You have run measurement campaigns validated against a surveyed reference.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You have calibrated an antenna array yourself.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You work comfortably from IQ data and channel-level observables upward.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A background in direction finding, radar, or SIGINT, whether from industry, a research institute, or space-based SIGINT.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Publications with a real measurement section.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Kalman filter or factor-graph estimation.</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your <strong>CV in English</strong>. We're looking forward to meeting you!</span></span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>SECURITY CLEARANCE</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.</span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>EQUAL OPPORTUNITY</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">WHY JOIN US</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong></p> <p>The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.</p> <p><strong>YOUR MISSION</strong></p> <p>Data is the fuel of STARK’s AI stack - you build the engine that makes it usable. You own the software backbone of our data platform: the metadata systems, ETL pipelines, data contracts, catalogs, databases, and internal tools that let engineers find, understand, validate, and reuse terabytes of multi-sensor field data in minutes, not days. You treat data context as a product: structured, searchable, version-aware, documented, and traceable from raw recording to processed asset, annotation delivery, dataset, and downstream ML workflow. Success in this role requires seamless cross-functional collaboration—acting as the central hub between the teams collecting data in the field, our external annotation vendors, and the ML engineers training the models. Your job is to design the automated workflows and data tooling that unify these groups, transforming raw operational data into reliable, high-quality systems at scale.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the Data Backbone:</strong> Design, write, and maintain robust Python software and ETL pipelines that ingest, process, and merge complex field recordings (flight data, rosbags, video) and external deliveries into our GCP cloud storage.</li> <li><strong>Create Data Tooling:</strong> Build the programmatic tools that bridge raw data and downstream usage. This includes writing services to automatically sub-sample video feeds, extract valuable frames, package datasets, and build self-serve data access tools.</li> <li><strong>Database & Metadata Engineering:</strong> Design, implement, and maintain our metadata databases and data catalogs (tracking datasets, recordings, sensors, labels, and lineage) using solid SQL and schema design principles.</li> <li><strong>Data Operations & Labeling Workflows:</strong> Own the end-to-end technical workflows for data curation and labeling. You will build the operational tooling and coordinate with external labeling subcontractors to ensure high-quality data deliveries, track progress, and run automated QA.</li> <li><strong>Internal Tooling & APIs:</strong> Develop backend APIs, self-service dashboards, and data-access tools that allow the entire AI and engineering organization to quickly search, filter, and understand terabytes of multi-sensor data.</li> <li><strong>Drive Engineering Excellence:</strong> Establish and enforce good software engineering hygiene in a young codebase: rigorous testing, typing, documentation, logging, and CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Generalist Problem Solving:</strong> Thrive in an evolving startup environment. Take on ambiguous problems, migrate legacy data, handle access management, and aggressively automate away manual support tasks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strong Software Engineering in Python:</strong> You write clean, typed, tested, and maintainable Python code. You approach data problems with a software developer's mindset.</li> <li><strong>Data Engineering & ETL:</strong> Proven experience designing, building, and operating robust ETL/data ingestion pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Database Mastery:</strong> Solid SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) with a strong grasp of schema design, data modeling, and metadata systems.</li> <li><strong>Cloud & Infrastructure:</strong> Hands-on experience with object storage (GCP/GCS, S3) and the basics of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.</li> <li><strong>Unix/Linux Environments:</strong> Strong familiarity with Unix-based systems, shell scripting, and standard Unix tools. You are comfortable working natively in a Linux environment.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatic & Adaptable:</strong> You know how to balance a quick, scrappy fix with a long-term architectural solution, and you are highly comfortable with the changing priorities of a startup environment.</li> <li><strong>Communicator & Coordinator:</strong> You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with external vendors and non-technical stakeholders to drive data labeling and curation efforts.</li> <li><strong>Automation Mindset:</strong> You aren't allergic to jumping in to do support tasks, but you have the technical chops to automate them away so you never have to do them twice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>GenAI / Synthetic Data:</strong> Experience with synthetic data generation or GenAI-assisted workflows (auto-labeling, data augmentation, foundation-model-based curation).</li> <li><strong>Data Ecosystems:</strong> Familiarity with data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, FiftyOne), computer vision annotation formats (e.g., COCO), or large-scale data curation workflows.</li> <li><strong>Advanced GCP:</strong> Experience with GCP services beyond basic storage (BigQuery, Cloud Run, IAM).</li> <li><strong>Robotics / Complex Data:</strong> Exposure to robotics data formats (ROS bags, MCAP, PX4 logs) or handling heavy, multi-modal data streams (video, lidar).</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your <strong>CV in English</strong>. title: Head of Strategy & Insights
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>WPP Media is seeking a Head of Strategy & Insights to lead the global media strategies for one of the most prestigious global luxury groups in the world. You bring a broad knowledge of communications, media, and luxury, combining big-picture strategic thinking with the technical fluency to dive into expert topics. You are equally comfortable advising on high-level strategy as you are coordinating specialized teams to turn macro-visions into high-quality execution.<br><br></p> <p>As a trusted advisor to Maisons C-suite stakeholders, you will go beyond traditional media planning to shape long-term brand equity, champion luxury intelligence, and elevate planning excellence across our global network of over 40 markets.<br><br><strong>* Location: Paris</strong></p> <p><strong>* Team management: 5-6 people (Senior to Manager Media Planning & Insights Talents)</strong></p> <p><strong>* Client: Global Luxury group</strong></p> <p><strong>* Language: French & English<br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Strategy & Planning Excellence</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Team Leadership: Direct and inspire a global team of five strategic planners (ranging from Manager to Senior profiles), ensuring the high-quality delivery of strategic media recommendations across diverse briefs and a varied Maisons portfolio.</li> <li>Annual Media Strategy: Define the overarching annual media strategy for the group leading Maisons, across various luxury categories.</li> <li>Media Guidelines: Define and oversee the creation of media planning guidelines (annual or high-stakes campaigns). quality by refining existing planning frameworks and enforcing their adoption, supported directly by the Planning & Insights Capabilities Associate Director.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u> </u></strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Luxury Thought Leadership & Intelligence</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Intelligence Agenda: Define the annual Luxury Thought Leadership calendar; oversee the creation and presentation of high-impact intelligence reports and global webinars.</li> <li>Macro-Consultancy: Partner with Maisons and relevant WPP agencies on forward-looking, long-term prospective topics that extend well beyond pure paid media.</li> <li>Knowledge Ecosystem: Foster a culture of luxury intelligence-sharing, ensuring a seamless flow of insights between central and local market teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Tools & Insights</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Planning & Insights Capability: Manage and mentor the Insights & Planning Capabilities Associate Director to enforce the consistent application of WPP Media "hero" planning and insight tools across the entire account network, ensuring data-driven strategic foundations.</li> <li>Global Research Agenda: In collaboration with the Insights & Planning Capabilities Associate Director, define the global studies agenda, overseeing research execution and the delivery of actionable insights to the client.<br><br></li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Local Market Support & Connectivity</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Global Upskilling: Refine and deploy planning and insights training programs tailored for local market teams and planning resources.</li> <li>Network Synergy: Build influential relationships with top-tier global markets to capture local best practices, maximize global strategy adoption, and elevate localized execution.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements & Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Global Strategic Planning Experience</strong>: 10–15+ years of experience within integrated communications and media planning, with a heavy emphasis on global or multi-market accounts.</li> <li><strong>Luxury Expertise:</strong> Deep, demonstrable expertise within the luxury sector (Fashion, Jewelry, and Watches preferred), with a thorough understanding of the luxury consumer mindset and differences across Maisons and regions.</li> <li><strong>Holistic Comms Thinking:</strong> Proven ability to think beyond traditional paid media, demonstrating an integrated communications planning mindset that connects media strategy with broader cultural and brand ecosystems.</li> <li><strong>C-Suite Gravitas:</strong> Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with a proven ability to engage, persuade, and challenge C-suite executives through strong, well-reasoned convictions.</li> <li><strong>Team Management:</strong> A proven track record of managing, mentoring, and inspiring diverse strategic teams; a natural collaborator and team player.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Agility:</strong> A highly flexible thinker capable of adapting strategic frameworks across a wide variety of brands with vastly different budgets, target audiences, and ambitions.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Department Orchestration:</strong> Proven ability to collaborate with and coordinate across diverse, specialized expert teams (e.g., Social, Search, and Centralized Buying) to align channel tactics with overarching macro-strategy.</li> <li><strong>Language</strong>: Full professional fluency in both English and French</li> <li><strong>Curiosity</strong>: A genuine appetite for working in a highly international, multicultural environment.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to <strong>Be Extraordinary</strong>, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also <strong>Lead Optimistically</strong>, firmly believing in and <strong>Championing Growth </strong>and <strong>Development </strong>for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. </p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. </p> <p>Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. </p> <p></p> <p><strong>#LI-Promoted</strong> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - title: AI Engineer - Full time
description: TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. Where We Operate Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions , each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more. The Role You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do. You can expect to: Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows. Own the system end to end : infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale. Ensure production-grade quality , performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients. Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations. Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills. Key Responsibilities Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale. Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times. Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits. Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display). Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time. What We're Looking For 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance). Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems. Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs). Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture). Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning). Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis . Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase. Nice to Have Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production. GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding). Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules). NLP background Why Join Us You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours. Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation. Real-world impact : your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built. High ownership : own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part. Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company. A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together. More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after: Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis . They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we're a team of 12 : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We're small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need. Why We'll Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability ; parametric tools only check constraints after generation , leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites. Generative AI has the potential to solve this , but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: AI Researcher - Full time
description: TLDR ; Davis is hiring an AI Researcher to push the frontier of floorplan generation. Working directly with architects, you'll own research directions end-to-end, from diffusion and flow matching models (continuous and discrete) to deployment in a product used by real estate professionals. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. Our Mission We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. By leveraging discrete diffusion models (operating on structured representations rather than pixels), we aim to produce floorplans and site plans that respect real-world constraints (zoning laws, space requirements, etc.) and can be iteratively refined like a human-designed plan. The Role We are looking for a AI Researcher to lead this effort in our Paris office. If you’re excited about improving our current state-of-the-art floorplan generative model and applying it to a high-impact domain, this role offers a unique opportunity to define a new class of AI-driven design tools . You will work within a focused team of 3–4 engineers and researchers, collaborating daily with architects to turn foundational research into deployable tools. What you'll own: Model Architecture & Design Space: Design the core model architecture and work on a discrete design space for architectural layouts. You will choose how to represent floorplans (e.g. as graphs of rooms/connections or token grids) such that the diffusion model’s outputs are editable and code-compliant by construction. This involves ensuring the model can enforce architectural rules (e.g. room sizes, adjacency constraints) within its generation process. Large-Scale Model Training: Lead the training of a foundation diffusion model from scratch on GPU clusters. You’ll set up distributed training across multiple nodes, optimize data loading and checkpointing, and manage experiments at scale. The role requires hands-on engineering for efficient training of large models on high-performance computing infrastructure. Benchmarking & Iteration: Evaluate the model’s performance and establish benchmarks to measure success. Using these evaluations, you’ll iterate on the model to push performance beyond existing methods. Our goal is to surpass the latest research results and produce genuinely useful architectural designs. En un coup d'œil Contrat : CDI Lieu : Paris ou Aix-en-Provence ; hybride Équipe : Métier Expérience : 2 à 5 ans en paie, avec une forte composante paramétrage Missions 🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain. Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement. 🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant Nous étendons en continu la couverture d'Alassio à de nouvelles conventions collectives et à de nouveaux dispositifs réglementaires. Chaque paramétrage se retrouve sur des milliers de bulletins : ta rigueur garantit la justesse des paies de nos cabinets, et ta réactivité leur permet d'obtenir vite les ajustements dont ils ont besoin. 🚀 Ton rôle Tu fais évoluer le moteur de paie d'Alassio : c'est toi qui traduis les règles de paie (conventions collectives, dispositifs réglementaires, cas particuliers) en paramétrage fiable, utilisé par tous nos cabinets. Tu travailles avec les équipes Métier et Juridique à l'extension réglementaire d'Alassio, en t'appuyant sur les workflows IA d'intégration et de mise à jour des paramètres légaux et conventionnels que nous avons développés. 🧭 Tes missions Réaliser et maintenir le paramétrage du moteur : rubriques, cotisations, profils de paie et conventions collectives Traiter les demandes de paramétrage de bout en bout : diagnostic, analyse, paramétrage et livraison, en lien avec notre équipe Juridique Requalifier les cas limites : distinguer ce qui relève du moteur, du paramétrage propre au dossier du cabinet ou d'une évolution produit Mettre en œuvre les évolutions réglementaires : analyser, paramétrer et tester les changements de taux, de plafonds et de règles Traiter les corrections issues du support : vérifier et ajuster les modifications analysées, puis les valider et les implémenter Tester chaque paramétrage livré : tests de conformité et de non-régression, construction et entretien des jeux de tests Fiabiliser le workflow IA d'intégration des CCN : contrôler, tester et corriger ce qu'il produit Gérer la file des demandes : prioriser, suivre et accompagner la validation des livrables Documenter les paramétrages réalisés Analyser des cas clients pour identifier l'origine d'un écart de calcul Remonter au Product les anomalies et les besoins d'évolution du produit 🤝 Ton environnement Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) et Ludivine (Resp. Juridique) Tu travailles également avec l'équipe Support, l'équipe Tech et l'équipe Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA) Outils : Alassio, Linear, Notion, outils d'IA développés par Alassio 🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le moteur de paramétrage et le workflow IA des CCN, et tes premières corrections sont validées en binôme À 3 mois : tu reprends en autonomie le paramétrage quotidien, avec des jeux de tests de non-régression en place sur ton périmètre À 6 mois : tu pilotes en autonomie une campagne d'évolutions réglementaires et tu tiens les délais de traitement des corrections Profil recherché 🌱 Expérience Indispensable : Formation en paie ou en RH, ou expérience équivalente 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en paie avec une forte composante paramétrage : consultant(e) paramétrage ou expert(e) fonctionnel(le) chez un éditeur, gestionnaire de paie référent(e) outil, ou paramétrage SIRH Pratique approfondie d'un logiciel de paie du marché Aisance dans la lecture et l'interprétation des conventions collectives Esprit logique et rigueur de test : tu ne valides pas un paramétrage sans l'avoir vérifié sur des cas concrets Bonne connaissance de la DSN Un plus : Notions de code (Python) ou de logique de formules avancées Utilisation avancée des outils d'IA 💎 Qualités La rigueur et l'autonomie La curiosité pour la tech et l'IA La capacité à tenir les pics d'activité Processus de sélection 1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min 2️⃣ Entretien métier avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) : 45 min 3️⃣ Cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh : paramétrer une disposition conventionnelle (par exemple une prime d'ancienneté ou un maintien de salaire) et écrire les cas de test associés : 1 h 4️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h 👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence. Ce que nous offrons 👊 Une mission unique Être au cœur du moteur de paie d'un logiciel nouvelle génération, travailler avec l'IA au quotidien et voir ton travail utilisé chaque mois sur les bulletins de milliers de salariés. 🎁 Rémunération et avantages 💰 Rémunération fixe de 60 à 75K€ selon l'expérience + BSPCE 🏥 Mutuelle Alan 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant) 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé) 🏡 Télétravail régulier possible 🤓 Offsites d'équipe réguliers (un par trimestre en moyenne) Certaines personnes hésitent à postuler quand elles ne cochent pas toutes les cases. Si tu hésites, postule quand même : on en parlera volontiers. ➡️ Prochaines étapes Si la mission te parle, postule via le formulaire de candidature. Pour toute question, écris à Pour en savoir plus sur Alassio : alassio.fr Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)
description: Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english) Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London) Level: Programme Manager senior Team: Client Delivery Contract: Permanent Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English. About Kaluza Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What you’ll do Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one. Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams. Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting. Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery. Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads. Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE. Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards. Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include: Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence. Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business. Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched. Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre. Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams. Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs. What you’ll bring Ideally, you’ll have: Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision. Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one. Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors. Fluency in French and English, written and spoken. Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak. Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort. What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology. Our Values Five values guide how we work at Kaluza: Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale. Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes. Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say. Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego. Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives. Our Perks Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance) Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility Come as you are We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn . Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here . Compensation: €56 – €75 • €56 – €75 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager – Agent Experience ( Français/ Anglais)
description: Product Manager – Agent Experience Lieu : Paris de préférence, possibilité à Londres (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau) Équipe : Customer Care Langues : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais Contrat : CDI Rattachement : Lead Product Manager À noter : ce poste est ouvert à Paris et à Londres, et nécessite un droit de travailler déjà acquis dans le pays où vous serez basé(e) (UE pour Paris, Royaume-Uni pour Londres). Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de parrainage de visa, mais nous étudions le parrainage poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour de futures opportunités. Merci de soumettre votre CV en anglais. À propos de Kaluza Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours. Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen. Ce que vous ferez Piloter la roadmap : porter la stratégie de bout en bout de Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) sur le marché européen, en cohérence avec les objectifs produit globaux et affinée par les besoins clients locaux et les comportements des agents. Vous suivrez les indicateurs opérationnels clés (AHT, FCR, CSAT, adoption de l’IA, onboarding) pour vous assurer que chaque évolution améliore l’expérience des agents et des clients. Concevoir les parcours et garantir la cohérence UX : être le garant de l’expérience agent sur l’ensemble de KAE. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites. Mener les intégrations et l’onboarding client : piloter les intégrations techniques et produit avec des plateformes tierces, et superviser de bout en bout le déploiement de nouvelles instances KAE pour les nouveaux clients, de la phase de découverte jusqu’à la mise en production. Garantir l’accessibilité et la conformité : défendre les réglementations européennes d’accessibilité dès la conception, en traduisant les exigences réglementaires et spécifiques à chaque marché en besoins techniques concrets. Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure. Rester les mains dans le cambouis, de la livraison à l’accompagnement : vous impliquer sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du développement produit (PDLC), des sessions de discovery avec les agents aux boucles de feedback, et produire les supports qui favorisent l’adoption côté clients. (À noter : des déplacements chez les clients, par exemple à Bruxelles, sont à prévoir, environ 1 à 3 par mois au début, puis 1 à 2 par trimestre.) Ce que vous apporterez Idéalement, vous avez : Une expertise centres de contact et UX : une solide expérience de la responsabilité de parcours utilisateurs de bout en bout pour des outils opérationnels très sollicités (par exemple des postes de travail d’agents), avec une vraie pratique de la recherche utilisateur, de la cartographie de parcours et des tests d’usabilité auprès d’agents et de superviseurs. Une connaissance de l’accessibilité européenne et de l’intégration de plateformes : une bonne maîtrise des standards d’accessibilité européens, ainsi qu’une expérience avérée d’intégration de produits avec des plateformes tierces et des écosystèmes de fournisseurs complexes. Une expérience de delivery client et d’expansion de marché : un historique de mise en œuvre ou de localisation d’un produit pour des clients entreprise externes, en menant les solutions de zéro à la mise en production : discovery, configuration et conduite du changement. Un jugement fondé sur la donnée et de l’influence : la capacité démontrée à vous appuyer sur des indicateurs opérationnels (AHT, FCR, CSAT, effort de l’agent) pour défendre vos décisions produit, avec un état d’esprit « plateforme d’abord » qui privilégie les capacités existantes au code sur mesure. Un bilinguisme professionnel : une maîtrise complète, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, du français et de l’anglais. Ce qui fera la différence Une expérience de l’utilisation d’outils d’IA, de capacités de machine learning ou d’intégrations LLM dans des workflows produit, pour renforcer l’intelligence de la plateforme et l’automatisation directement dans les environnements de poste de travail du service client. Une expérience dans des plateformes SaaS, le secteur de l’énergie ou des migrations d’envergure chez des opérateurs de services publics. Une expérience concrète de la mise à l’échelle de la cohérence UI entre plusieurs équipes produit. Où vous travaillerez Nous proposons un cadre de travail flexible, avec trois jours par semaine au bureau. C’est le meilleur des deux mondes : du temps réel ensemble pour collaborer et créer des liens, et la liberté de travailler comme vous le préférez le reste de la semaine. Nos valeurs Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza : Jouer pour gagner : la fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle. Résoudre le vrai problème : aller droit au but pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets. Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : constance, transparence et tenir parole. Assumer les résultats : une responsabilité totale, dans les succès comme dans les échecs, sans ego. Aller plus loin ensemble : collaboration, respect et diversité de points de vue. Nos avantages Financier et assurances : bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle santé Alan, assurance décès et invalidité (prévoyance) x3 via Alan, et cotisations de Sécurité sociale standard (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage) Indemnités : remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport, indemnité télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 € Congés et flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congé « Moments Qui Comptent », congé de compassion, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, travail flexible et possibilité de congé sabbatique Venez comme vous êtes Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur leur mérite et leur potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis d’avoir de vos nouvelles. title: Senior Sensor Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role As a Senior Sensor Engineer (Tactile & Proprioception) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will build the neural architecture of physical touch and spatial awareness that gives our robotic hands human-like dexterity. You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines. Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control. What you will do: Own the sensing architecture. Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype. Develop tactile array hardware. Design and prototype high-resolution tactile sensors (optical, capacitive, piezoresistive, or magnetic) tailored for space-constrained, contact-rich finger pads and palm surfaces. Engineer proprioceptive feedback. Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking. Design readout electronics & AFEs. Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI). Build calibration & processing pipelines. Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack. Characterize & validate on real hardware. Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles. Drive sensor manufacturing & yield. Partner with specialized suppliers on Design for Manufacturing (DFM) for flexible/rigid-flex PCBs, molded tactile skins, and elastomeric components, ensuring high assembly yield and second-sourcing. Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics (for load paths and physical packaging), Electronics (for board interfaces), and Software (for state estimation and closed-loop grasp control). What you bring: Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Sensorics, Robotics, or a related field. 5–10 years of experience developing sensor hardware, mechatronic instrumentation, or sensor fusion systems, including at least one product taken into series production. Deep domain expertise in tactile sensing modalities (e.g., optical tactile/GelSight style, piezoresistive, capacitive) or high-density proprioceptive feedback (encoders, strain gauges, load cells). Proven experience in analog circuit design, signal conditioning (AFE), active filtering, and high-SNR data acquisition for physical sensors. Hands-on experience with sensor calibration techniques, thermal/hysteresis modeling, signal processing, and standard communication buses (SPI, I2C, CAN). Practical experience designing or integrating flexible PCBs, molded elastomers, or miniaturized mechatronic assemblies into tight physical envelopes. A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, sensor characterization on test rigs, and tracing physics-to-signal anomalies with scopes and logic analyzers. Fluent in English; German is a plus, not a requirement. Bonus: Background in real-time embedded C/C++ firmware or ROS/ROS2 for sensor data processing and filtering. Experience with tactile algorithms for slip prediction, texture recognition, or contact shape estimation. Experience with soft robotics, stretchable electronics, or conductive polymers. Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066, and sensor design for collaborative applications. The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
