title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. </strong>The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>As <strong>Account Management Lead – Editions France</strong>, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.</p> <p>You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Editions Strategy & Growth</p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)</p> </li> <li> <p>Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Occupancy & Commercial Performance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines</p> </li> <li> <p>Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team</p> </li> <li> <p>Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>P&L Ownership & Governance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter</p> </li> <li> <p>Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics</p> </li> <li> <p>Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens</p> </li> <li> <p>Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops</p> </li> <li> <p>Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Senior Stakeholder Management</p> <ul> <li> <p>Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events</p> </li> <li> <p>Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network</p> </li> </ul> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;"> </div> <h3><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>7+ years working in commercially focused roles</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time</p> </li> <li> <p>Mix of both strategy and execution experience</p> </li> <li> <p>Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators</p> </li> <li> <p>Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams</p> </li> <li> <p>Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email</p> </li> <li> <p>Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver</p> </li> <li> <p>Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)</p> </li> <li> <p>Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluent in French and English is required</p> </li> </ul> <div style="min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Head of Product Operations (Core)
description: Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. title: Head of AI - NLP Healthtech
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. title: Engineering Manager, Bots & Fraud
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Washington D.C.; New York City</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Our team builds the products that answer "Can we trust this traffic?" Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we deliver to our customers.</p> <p>Our products address a broad and evolving range of traffic integrity challenges. Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have a track record of leading engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and supporting professional growth. Your past teams respect you as both a technical leader and a people manager.</li> <li>You have a strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and services.</li> <li>You have taken projects from inception to production and overseen execution to meet commitments in a fast-paced, iterative engineering environment.</li> <li>You connect business goals with technical decisions, explain both the "why" and the "how," and make thoughtful tradeoffs when requirements are uncertain.</li> <li>You work effectively across Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver shared outcomes.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and senior leadership, adapting the level of technical detail to your audience.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in engineering workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You are curious about web security, bot management, fraud and abuse, and the evolving role of AI agents on the Internet. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team building and scaling Cloudflare's products for bot management, fraud detection, and abuse mitigation. title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
description: About CREATEQ CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy. We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future. We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership. People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do. The opportunity We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams. Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal. You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region]. What you'll do Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region]. Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management. Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams. Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature. Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business. Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance. Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management. What we're looking for This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management. Requirements At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility. A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements. A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market. A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps). A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations. An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently. Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English. Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit. Benefits A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth. An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams. A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component. Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths. Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact. A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Designer - Berlin
description: About RA Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture. Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it. The mandate We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform. This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers. Responsibilities Product design and leadership Lead design for Resident Advisor's consumer products end to end, across web and native app touchpoints. Set design direction and quality standards, and partner with Product, Engineering and Data leads to shape strategy, roadmaps and prioritisation. Mentor and coach other designers through critique, pairing and feedback, raising the bar for craft across the team. Lead discovery activities including user research, workshops and analysis of customer feedback and data. Work closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure quality execution and close the gap between design and code. Design systems and AI Own the RA Design System: maintain, evolve and govern tokens, components and patterns so they stay consistent across Figma and code. Structure and document the design system so developers and AI can use it reliably and efficiently. Bring AI into the design workflow, using it for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping and production, and helping the wider team adopt it thoughtfully. Document design decisions, patterns and best practices in a way both people and AI tools can use. Who we are looking for A portfolio demonstrating strong product design thinking, visual craft and impact on products shipped at scale. 4+ years of Product Design experience, including time in a senior or lead role setting design direction for a product area. Experience mentoring designers and influencing product and engineering stakeholders. Hands-on experience using AI in your design practice, from ideation and prototyping to working with AI coding tools, and a considered point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't. Deep experience building and maintaining design systems, including design tokens, component libraries and documentation, and keeping Figma and code in sync. An understanding of what makes a design system usable by AI: structured tokens, consistent naming, well-defined component properties and clear usage guidance. Expert UI and interaction design skills with a keen eye for detail. A strong grasp of user-centred design and balancing user and business needs. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and experience working in Agile product teams. Experience designing AI-powered or personalised product experiences is a plus. What we offer you Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance. Flexibility in working arrangements, offering hybrid or remote work options based on role requirements and location. Matching pension schemes and/or 401k. Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs. Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on RA merch. Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about. Regular company-wide Q&As with senior leadership, along with ongoing virtual educational training sessions for all staff. A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ). Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community ). More about RA We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis. Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it. RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge. We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations. Our values Electronic music is art. We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music. We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community. We honour the past, present and future of electronic music. We use innovation to empower the community. We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit. We're always front left. This role is a permanent position based in Berlin. Please note: This position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary for this role is €50k–€60k. If you have questions about the role, please contact Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
description: <div><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via <a href="https://careers.hilti.group/de-ch/stellenangebote/19051-en/global-trainee-program-outperformer-software-business-track-m-f-x/">Hilti Careerpage</a></div> <h2>Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.</h2> <p>Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.<br><br>The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.</p> <h2>What You'll do</h2> <p>The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.<br><br>The program places you inside one of two business units:<br><br>Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.<br><br>Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.<br><br><br>For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.</li> </ul> <p>​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.</li> </ul> <p>You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.</p> <h2>What You’ll Bring</h2> <p>You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:</p> <ul> <li>Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.</li> <li>Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.</li> <li>Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. </li> <li>Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.</li> <li>Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.</li> <li>You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s In It for You</h2> <p>​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:</p> <ul> <li>Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.</li> <li>Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.</li> <li>Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Hilti</h2> <p>Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/</p> <h2>Commitment to Inclusion</h2> <p>​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.<br><br>​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.<br>​<br>​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.<br><br>​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​<br><br>​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:</p> <ul> <li>It all starts with your application and a video interview.</li> <li>Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.</li> <li>Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.</li> <li>Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.</li> <li>And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.</li> </ul> <p>​Exciting, right? Let's get started!</p> <p><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via <a href="https://careers.hilti.group/de-ch/stellenangebote/19051-en/global-trainee-program-outperformer-software-business-track-m-f-x/">Hilti Careerpage</a>.<br><br>​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process:<br><a href="https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/" target="_blank"><br>Candidate Interview Preparation</a></p> <p>​​For further questions, please feel free to contact Vanessa Furtner ----- and (My LinkedIn).<br>​<br>*For non-EU / EFTA citizens: Please state your eligibility status to work in EU or UK countries and note that if you do not own a valid work permit, Hilti cannot guarantee your final employment due to authority regulations.​</p> <section class="section-image js-animate"> <div class="container-fluid"> <div class="row"> <div class="col-md-6 col-lg-7"> <div class="slant-outer"> </div> </div> </div> </div> </section> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. title: (Senior) Consultant* – Securities & Custody Operations
description: <div id="ScreenPanelContainer22Content" class="cc-content"> <div id="ScreenPanelContainer22Content" class="cc-content"> <div id="ScreenPanelContainer22Content" class="cc-content"> <p><strong>Standort: Frankfurt / München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Capital Markets | Anstellungsart: Unbefristet</strong></p> <p><strong>Gestalte die Zukunft von Securities & Custody Operations im Finanzdienstleistungssektor.</strong></p> <p><strong>Die Rolle</strong></p> <p>Als (Senior) Consultant* in unserer Capital Markets Practice arbeitest Du mit führenden Finanzinstituten zusammen, um deren Securities-, Custody- und Capital-Markets-Operations zu transformieren und zu optimieren.</p> <p>Du bringst fundierte Fachkenntnisse entlang des Wertpapier-Lebenszyklus und im Post-Trade-Umfeld mit. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden analysierst Du komplexe operative Herausforderungen, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und übersetzt Anforderungen in praxisorientierte Lösungen. Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung und arbeitest dabei eng mit Stakeholdern aus Operations, Technologie und Change zusammen.</p> <p><strong>Was Du bei uns machst</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du unterstützt Transformationsinitiativen in den Bereichen Securities, Custody und Post-Trade Operations – von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Implementierung.</li> <li>Du analysierst bestehende Operating Models, Prozesse und Kontrollen und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung, Optimierung und Effizienzsteigerung.</li> <li>Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern aus Business, Operations und Technologie zusammen, definierst Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in praxisorientierte Lösungen.</li> <li>Du setzt Dein Wissen über Wertpapierprozesse ein – einschließlich Trade Lifecycle, Settlement, Asset Servicing und Custody Operations – um komplexe Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu lösen.</li> <li>Du unterstützt die Projektdurchführung durch Workshops, Analysen, Dokumentation, Stakeholder Management und Implementierungsbegleitung.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Was wir von Dir erwarten</strong></p> <ul> <li>Relevante Beratungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungserfahrung in den Bereichen Securities, Custody, Post-Trade oder Capital Markets Operations.</li> <li>Fundierte Kenntnisse des Wertpapier-Lebenszyklus und operativer Prozesse wie Settlement, Custody, Asset Servicing und/oder Corporate Actions.</li> <li>Erfahrung in Business Transformation, Prozessoptimierung, Operating Models oder Change-Initiativen innerhalb der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche.</li> <li>Ausgeprägte analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen in klare und praxisorientierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.</li> <li>Sichere Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Business- und Technologie-Teams.</li> <li>Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Von Vorteil</strong></p> <ul> <li>Erfahrung bei oder mit Global Custodians, Investmentbanken, Asset Managern, Marktinfrastrukturen oder Securities-Services-Anbietern.</li> <li>Kenntnisse regulatorischer und branchenspezifischer Entwicklungen im Securities- und Post-Trade-Umfeld.</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Operating Model Design, Prozessoptimierung oder umfangreichen Transformationsprogrammen.</li> <li>Kenntnisse von Wertpapierplattformen, Custody-Systemen oder Post-Trade-Technologien.</li> <li>Beratungserfahrung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen in komplexen Finanzdienstleistungsorganisationen.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Warum Capco?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Arbeite an wirkungsvollen Lösungen für führende Finanzinstitute.</li> <li>Erlebe eine kollaborative, flache und unternehmerisch geprägte Beratungskultur.</li> <li>Nutze kontinuierliche Lernangebote, Trainings und Branchenzertifizierungen.</li> <li>Werde Teil eines Teams, das die Zukunft der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche mitgestaltet.</li> <li>Gestalte die Transformation im Capital-Markets-Umfeld aktiv mit.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Wir bieten Dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Benefits-Paket, das Deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt:</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten je nach Projekteinsatz möglich</li> <li>Ein umfassendes Onboarding und Dein persönlicher Coach und Buddy</li> <li>Bike Leasing Programme</li> <li>Capco Benefits Card mit monatlicher Gutschrift i.H.v. 44 EUR</li> <li>Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks sowie Mental Health Kurse</li> <li>Der PME-Familienservice bietet Unterstützung für alle Lebenslagen</li> <li>Kontinuierliches Feedback und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. über interne Trainings und Udemy Business)</li> <li>Großartige Firmenevents & After Work Veranstaltungen</li> <li>Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag</li> <li>Autonomie, flache Hierarchien, Hands-on-Mentalität und schnelle Entscheidungswege</li> <li>Ein dynamisches, wachstumsstarkes und internationales Umfeld mit zahlreichen Möglichkeiten Dich und Deine Talente einzubringen</li> </ul> <p><strong>Inklusion bei Capco</strong></p> <p>Wir setzen uns dafür ein, unseren Recruiting-Prozess für alle zugänglich und unkompliziert zu gestalten. Wenn Du in irgendeiner Phase Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigst, lass es uns einfach wissen – wir helfen Dir gerne weiter.</p> <p>Wir schätzen die individuellen Perspektiven und Beiträge jedes Einzelnen. Bei Capco glauben wir, dass Du am stärksten bist, wenn Du Du selbst sein kannst. Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität und Zusammenarbeit – eine Haltung, die jeden Tag prägt, wie wir mit unseren Kunden und miteinander arbeiten.</p> <p>*(m/w/d) - Wichtig ist nur, dass wir zueinander passen! #BeYouselfAtWork</p> </div> <p> </p> </div> </div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Account Director, Large Enterprise | France
description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the role Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy. You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI. This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. In this role, you'll: Manage a number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan. Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment. Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects. Own a consumption revenue target. Manage consumption revenue forecasts. Analyse key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders. Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies. Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering. Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates. Support the development of company culture. We're seeking someone with experience including: 10+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service. Have full professional fluency in both French and English. Achieving revenue targets >$2M per year for more than 3 years. Designing and executing complex deal strategies. Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies. Working directly with c-level executives. Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders. Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.). Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence. You might thrive in this role if you: Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions. Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organisation. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. About the role Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France. At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world. We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value. You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world. What we think you need to be successful Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL) Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…) Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract (CDD). title: Founding Robotics Engineer Navigation & Autonomy
description: ABOUT NAXON Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones. Why now : rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site. Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM). THE ROLE You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there. As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination WHAT YOU BRING Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos Strong in SLAM, localisation, state estimation and motion planning Expert in ROS2, C++ and Python, and a heavy user of AI coding agents Hands on with quadrupeds, wheeled robots or drones and their sensors on real hardware MSc / PhD plus 2 to 4 years in industry, or equivalent proven experience WHY JOIN NAXON The challenge: one map shared across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, task allocation across a live site, and an edge/cloud split over networks that drop Full ownership of your area, from architecture to what runs at the customer , and a clear path into leading it Real robots at real customer sites, from research to working reliably in real world conditions Hands-on work with cutting-edge robotics, hardware and AI Competitive salary and equity (VSOP / ESOP) as a founding team member Backing from EWOR and robotics mentors who have built, scaled and exited companies A supportive and inclusive team that values ownership and creativity Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: SAP Integration Architect
description: About the role We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator. What you'll do Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back. Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer. Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last. Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against. Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript. Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects. Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout. What we're looking for 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them. Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says. Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core. Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job. A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice. Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work. Fluent German and English. Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller. Work at Finto An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking. Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network. Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team. Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox. 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days." A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office. title: IT Stage
description: Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende IT-stage waarin je jouw technische kennis in de praktijk kunt brengen én jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen? Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd. We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Samen met onze leveranciers bouwen we sterke supply chains en creëren we waarde door grondstoffen in te kopen en te leveren aan de internationale voedingsmiddelen-, diervoedings- en energiesector. Bekijk hier onze corporate video . De stage Als IT Support Stagiair(e) word je onderdeel van het IT-team en ondersteun je collega’s bij hun dagelijkse IT-vragen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers en helpt bij het oplossen van technische problemen, zowel op afstand als op kantoor. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt. Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met: Het bieden van eerstelijns IT-support en oplossen van hardware-, software- en netwerkproblemen; Het beheren van gebruikersaccounts, wachtwoorden, licenties en apparaten; Het installeren, configureren en uitgeven van laptops en mobiele telefoons; Het registreren en opvolgen van incidenten en aanvragen via het ticketsysteem. Daarnaast werk je samen met ervaren IT-specialisten aan projecten op het gebied van infrastructuur, werkplekbeheer en procesverbetering. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie. Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand. Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur. Wie ben jij? Je bent nieuwsgierig, servicegericht en krijgt energie van het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Dankzij jou kunnen onze klanten de financiële gevolgen van bedrijfsrisico’s uitstekend opvangen. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht en vanuit huis ben jij voor hen hét aanspreekpunt. In een groeiende organisatie waar gebouwd wordt met collega’s die hart voor onze klanten hebben én oog voor elkaar. Kom jij meebouwen? Jouw baan als senior relatiebeheerder zakelijk Als relatiebeheerder zakelijke verzekeringen word je de rechterhand van je buitendienstcollega. Samen zijn jullie eigenaar van jullie portefeuille met bestaande én potentiële MKB - relaties in de regio Utrecht en omstreken. Deze portefeuille bestaat voornamelijk uit grotere klanten die o.a. actief zijn in de vastgoedsector. Ondernemend als je bent, bespreek je op jouw initiatief de zakelijke risico’s die jullie klanten lopen en welke financiële gevolgen dit kan hebben. Ook adviseer je over verzekerbare oplossingen én te treffen preventiemaatregelen. Dankzij jou is de agenda van je buitendienstcollega goed gevuld met afspraken. Je zorgt ervoor dat je buitendienstcollega goed voorbereid het klantgesprek in gaat. Je brengt op eigen initiatief offertes uit en legt alles netjes vast in onze systemen. Je signaleert commerciële kansen en overtuigt klanten om totaalklant te worden. Je handelt klantgesprekken af en neemt de nazorg volledig voor je rekening. Wat krijg je van ons? Een goed salaris: schaal loopt van € 3.052,- tot € 5.755,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week. We stemmen de hoogte van je salaris af op je kennis en ervaring. Deelname aan de collectieve pensioenregeling bij BeFrank. Een maandelijkse netto internetvergoeding van € 20,-. 27 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks maximaal 5 dagen bij te kopen. Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer tot 40 km enkele reis of volledige vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer. Aantrekkelijke kortingen op je zorgverzekering en de eigen verzekeringsproducten van HZG. De mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen tegen fiscaal voordelige voorwaarden. De flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken. Daarbij zorgen we ook voor een fijne en veilige thuiswerkplek. Werken bij een topspeler in de Nederlandse assurantiemarkt die onderdeel is van de stabiele, internationale NN Group. Blijvende aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en inzetbaarheid. Jouw profiel Werkervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening in een functie met zakelijk klantadvies. De beroepskwalificaties Adviseur Schade en Inkomen. Heb je deze nog niet (allemaal)? Dan mag je ze op korte termijn en op onze kosten behalen. Een gelukkige klant is jouw prioriteit. Jij houdt van klanten ontzorgen. Je toont interesse: je vraagt door en luistert aandachtig. Je signaleert commerciële kansen, denkt in oplossingen en bent in staat dit door te vertalen naar een duidelijk advies. De afdeling Je komt terecht in een team met drie collega’s op ons kantoor in Utrecht. Twee van hen werken ook in de binnendienst en één collega zit buiten bij onze klanten. In deze functie rapport je rechtstreeks aan de manager zakelijk advies Utrecht - Gelderland, Mike Peschke. Dit zijn wij Twee sterke bedrijven, Heinenoord Holding en Zicht, risico- en verzekeringsadviseurs. Samengebracht in één toekomstgerichte organisatie: HeinenoordZicht Groep. Een nieuwe naam, gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw ervaring. De kracht van digitale mogelijkheden combineren we met lokaal ondernemerschap én de professionaliteit van een grote landelijke Nederlandse speler. Wij helpen elkaar en onze klanten vooruit. We geven onafhankelijk en professioneel advies en helpen bij het maken van bewuste keuzes over financiële risico’s. Dit geldt zowel richting onze klanten, als binnen de organisatie. Dit is wat ons energie geeft en waar ons talent ligt. Dit doen wij vanuit ons vakmanschap, onze passie, de rijke ervaring, maar ook de lokale verbinding. Dat is de reden waarom onze collega’s hier werken, waarom onze klanten bij ons komen. En wat ons verbindt. HeinenoordZicht Groep is een gaaf bedrijf: goed geregeld, aantrekkelijk voor medewerkers, aantrekkelijk voor klanten en financieel gezond. Solliciteren? title: Développeur Nouveaux Projets (F/H/X)

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ? 💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours. 🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance. 🌴 Une prime vacances. 🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 🚗 Une voiture de fonction. 🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous. 📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS). 🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. title: Senior Linux Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Linux Engineer</strong></h3> <p>An engineering role at Cloudflare provides an opportunity to address some big challenges, at scale. We believe that with our talented team, we can tackle some of the biggest security, reliability and performance problems facing the Internet.</p> <p>We are searching for Linux engineers to make our flavour of Linux fast, resilient and reliable across the many use cases that a distribution saving the Internet requires. </p> <p>Our Engineers come from a variety of technical backgrounds and work across a broad range of environments and codebases. Common qualities across all of our performance-focused engineers include a passion for analysis, optimization, scaling, networking, cross-team collaboration and hard problem solving.</p> <p><strong>What you would be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Keep Cloudflare Linux platforms secure and up-to-date</p> </li> <li> <p>Help with quick and safe deployment and delivery of the Linux kernel and basic operating system to Cloudflare Datacenters in more than 335 cities in over 100 countries</p> </li> <li> <p>Continuously monitor and resolve kernel bugs and performance regressions</p> </li> <li> <p>Design tools and frameworks for other engineering teams to successfully embrace and enable the latest Linux kernel features and optimizations</p> </li> <li> <p>Help porting the Cloudflare software stack to new hardware platforms and architectures</p> </li> <li> <p>Research and adopt the latest Linux kernel security features and performance improvements</p> </li> <li> <p>Build tools and CI/CD pipelines for safe and automated operating system continuous deployment</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Requisite skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience with the Linux kernel and Linux software packaging</p> </li> <li> <p>CS fundamentals and comfortable working in multiple programming languages and codebases; Comfortable working in Go, Rust, C, Bash, and Python.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with constructing and using eBPF programs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of Linux and POSIX operation systems concepts: processing, files, syscalls, and networking</p> </li> <li> <p>Containerization technologies in Linux (e.g Docker, Namespaces, Cgroups)</p> </li> <li> <p>Configuration management (e.g Saltstack, Chef) and CI/CD pipelines</p> </li> <li> <p>Version control systems (git)</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Performance analysis and debugging</p> </li> <li> <p>Time series databases such as OpenTSDB, Graphite, Prometheus or Grafana</p> </li> <li> <p>Key/Value stores</p> </li> <li> <p>Network fundamentals DHCP, ARP, subnetting, routing, firewalls, IPv6, BGP</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in a DevOps team structure</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience with programming in C, Rust, Go, or similar languages</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with rapid release engineering</p> </li> <li> <p>Upstream community contribution</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong tooling and automation development experience</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Some tools that we use </strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Consul</p> </li> <li> <p>Docker</p> </li> <li> <p>Grafana</p> </li> <li> <p>Kubernetes</p> </li> <li> <p>Nginx</p> </li> <li> <p>Nomad</p> </li> <li> <p>PostgreSQL</p> </li> <li> <p>Prometheus</p> </li> <li> <p>Salt</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Brand Designer / Art Director
description: International Brands is a fast-growing Swiss company in the Personal Care / FMCG space. With our brands, we bring products into tens of thousands of retail locations worldwide, from drugstores and leading retail chains to e-commerce. We build brands that work on shelf. Not just on slides. Not just on Instagram. Fast. Visible. Tangible. Scalable. We develop and scale brands that combine design, product and performance without compromise and win exactly where it matters most: in the market. More than 90,000 retail locations worldwide. From packaging and brand worlds to the smallest details that ultimately make the difference. Someone who challenges existing ideas, wants to improve things and does not accept “the way it has always been done.” This role is demanding, fast-paced and highly hands-on. We are not looking for an administrator. We are looking for a builder. Someone who takes ownership, moves fast and executes with high quality. Someone who wants to actively shape and grow brands. Not only conceptually, but all the way through to finished products in the market.
