title: Data Center Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Austin, San Francisco or New York</strong></h3> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>Cloudflare is hiring a Data Center Architect to define and deliver the physical infrastructure behind high-density compute and GPU deployments across our global network. You'll own 3 connected domains: the liquid cooling chain, the low-voltage connectivity layer, and the MV/LV electrical architecture that powers both.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role spanning architecture, detailed design, technical qualification, design governance, commissioning, and operational readiness. You're Cloudflare's owner-side technical lead in these domains: the person who connects what our hardware needs with what colocation providers, equipment manufacturers, and delivery partners can actually build.</p> <p>Scope runs from a single rack in commercial colocation to multi-megawatt compute deployments. You'll design power, cooling, and cabling as one system so they don't fight each other at the rack, in the white space, or during maintenance.</p> <p>If your background is only HVAC design, only cold-plate research, or only utility-scale generation, this role will be wider than you expect. We need someone who can hold the electrical, cooling, and cabling layers together.</p> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>We work with engineering, capacity planning, network strategy, supply chain, and operations to grow Cloudflare's data center and PoP footprint. With colocation providers, hardware suppliers, and delivery partners worldwide, we turn infrastructure requirements into deployments that come online faster, cost less, and work the first time.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <h4>Architecture and reference designs</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Own the physical-infrastructure architecture.</strong> Build reference designs for power, liquid cooling, and connectivity for AI and high-density compute, including how they interface at rack, row, and site level. Maintain the standards, templates, and libraries that deployment, operations, and partner teams build from.</li> <li><strong>Translate hardware and capacity needs into engineering requirements.</strong> Turn heat loads, electrical loads, port counts, network topologies, and growth plans into power, cooling, and connectivity requirements and into site and rack qualification criteria.</li> <li><strong>Qualify sites and facility interfaces.</strong> Assess provider power and cooling availability, utility and backup capacity, water supply and return conditions, hydraulic capacity, upstream heat rejection, expansion headroom, maintenance constraints, and contractual boundaries. Give go/no-go recommendations with the risks written down.</li> </ul> <h3>Electrical power architecture (MV/LV)</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead MV and LV electrical architecture:</strong> single-line diagrams, power distribution, switchgear and UPS topology, busway and PDU design, grounding and bonding.</li> <li><strong>Design physical power infrastructure,</strong> AC and DC, including power conversion, backup generation, energy storage, and distribution, with attention to fault levels, selectivity, and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Validate designs with modeling:</strong> load-flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, and selectivity studies, checked against measured performance where possible.</li> <li><strong>Define digital power requirements</strong> for monitoring, metering, protection coordination, and control. Work with controls and operations teams on alarm thresholds, trend retention, remote monitoring, and BMS/SCADA integration.</li> <li><strong>Fold emerging standards</strong> (NEC, NFPA, UL, OCP power and rack specs) into forward-looking electrical designs.</li> </ul> <h3>Liquid cooling</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the liquid-cooling architecture and roadmap.</strong> Develop repeatable direct-to-chip designs and evaluate liquid-to-liquid, liquid-to-air, rear-door, and other approaches against deployment needs.</li> <li><strong>Design and validate the hydraulic system.</strong> Flow and pressure-drop calculations, pipe sizing, pump selection, balancing, and control requirements. Validate at partial load, during expansion and maintenance, and in failure scenarios, not just at nameplate.</li> <li><strong>Specify equipment and rack integration.</strong> Qualify CDUs, heat exchangers, pumps, manifolds, hoses, quick-disconnects, valves, and instrumentation. Coordinate rack access, piping routes, service clearances, and installation sequencing with the electrical, cabling, hardware, and structural disciplines.</li> <li><strong>Own coolant integrity and serviceability.</strong> Set manufacturer-aligned requirements for fluid quality, material compatibility, cleanliness, filtration, corrosion control, condensation prevention, and leak detection. Make isolation, fluid handling, component replacement, and servicing safe and maintainable.</li> </ul> <h3>Low-voltage connectivity and structured cabling</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the physical-layer architecture.</strong> Reference designs for rack, row, cage, and site connectivity: copper and fiber distribution, patch-panel placement, cross-connect demarcations, diverse routes, and reserved expansion capacity.</li> <li><strong>Engineer fiber and copper connectivity.</strong> Specify media, connectors, trunks, cassettes, and patching for equipment reach and performance. Validate optical loss budgets, connector counts, polarity, breakouts, bend radius, and compatibility across hardware generations.</li> <li><strong>Produce buildable designs.</strong> Pathway layouts, fiber schedules, port-to-port patching plans, cable-length schedules, bills of materials, and installation specs.</li> <li><strong>Connect to colocation and carrier infrastructure.</strong> Qualify meet-me-room access, provider pathways, cross-connect options, demarcation points, and route diversity. Define handoffs with data center providers, carriers, ISPs, and Cloudflare's network strategy team.</li> </ul> <h3>Integration, controls, and resilience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Coordinate white-space interfaces.</strong> Layouts that account for rack access, airflow, liquid-cooling pipes and manifolds, power segregation, pathway capacity, and expansion. Coordinate supports, bonding, grounding, and firestopping with the responsible disciplines and providers.</li> <li><strong>Design for resilience and controlled failure.</strong> Evaluate redundancy, shared failure dependencies, cooling and power interruptions, and thermal ride-through. Agree protective responses with hardware and operations teams for pump or CDU failure, loss of facility cooling, leaks, sensor faults, control failures, and power events.</li> <li><strong>Define controls and operational visibility:</strong> temperatures, pressures, flows, power metering, leak alarms, equipment status, and capacity telemetry.</li> </ul> <h3>Governance, delivery, and acceptance</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Be Cloudflare's owner-side design authority.</strong> Own basis-of-design documents, single-line diagrams, P&IDs, cabling and equipment schedules, interface requirements, scopes, responsibility matrices, review gates, and acceptance criteria. Review partner designs and contractor submittals, resolve RFIs and technical disputes, and drive deviations to documented closure.</li> <li><strong>Lead delivery and live-site changes.</strong> Guide contractors and remote hands through new deployments, expansions, migrations, and remediation. Work with deployment and operations on installation sequencing, methods of procedure, change controls, and rollback plans that protect running services.</li> <li><strong>Lead commissioning and acceptance.</strong> Define factory and site acceptance tests across electrical, cooling, and connectivity: cleanliness and leak-test evidence, flow balancing, loaded performance tests, failure-mode testing, and copper and fiber certification (fiber inspection and cleaning, insertion-loss testing, OTDR where appropriate). Track deficiencies and verify corrective work before sign-off.</li> <li><strong>Keep the physical source of truth accurate.</strong> Define labeling and connectivity-record standards. Make sure as-builts, power and cooling records, patching schedules, cross-connect inventories, and test records reconcile with Cloudflare's infrastructure inventory and DCIM.</li> <li><strong>Oversee handover:</strong> deficiency closure, operator training, maintenance procedures, spares, and turnover documentation before production.</li> </ul> <h3>Cost, efficiency, and standards</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Support sourcing.</strong> RFPs, technical bid evaluation, technical negotiations, supplier qualification, and lifecycle cost analysis. Partner with supply chain on prefabricated assemblies, preterminated cabling, rack integration, lead times, and alternatives that cut field labor without cutting quality.</li> <li><strong>Reduce energy and water use.</strong> Evaluate phased deployment, consumption, and retrofit options.</li> <li><strong>Evolve standards from evidence.</strong> Investigate incidents and recurring installation defects with network and operations teams. Feed commissioning and operating results back into designs, standards, and quality checks.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years in data center mechanical, electrical, or physical-layer infrastructure, c

title: Senior Engineering Manager — Network Connectivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal or London, United Kingdom or Austin, Texas or New York City</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/connectivity-cloud/">Connectivity Cloud</a>: egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products. The team build and operate cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/smart-shield/configuration/dedicated-egress-ips/how-it-works/egress-ips/">Dedicated Egress IP Connectivity</a>, WARP, Cloudflare One/Zero Trust, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the<a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/icloud-private-relay/"> iCloud Private Relay</a> product.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>As an Engineering Manager on the Egress team you will hire, mentor, and coach a distributed team of Software Engineers. You will play a key role in developing the team and shaping its culture and technical vision. This includes:</p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Product Managers and other Engineering leaders to communicate the vision, prioritize the team's roadmap, and achieve cross-functional objectives.</li> <li>Understanding the technical implications of work across a distributed software network infrastructure to influence scope, work across teams, and help unblock projects: from data planes responsible for delivery of critical customer traffic to distributed control-plane services.</li> <li>Applying technical experience to evaluate tradeoffs, contribute to design decisions, and help drive resolution to customer-facing issues, while creating space for engineers to lead design, implementation, and delivery.</li> <li>Taking responsibility for the team's production services by organizing on-call rotations, handling customer escalations, and overseeing incident response and follow-up.</li> <li>Driving reliability and automation improvements across the platform</li> <li>Using tools and processes to convey project status and resolve blockages.</li> </ul> <p>You are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.</p> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years experience as an Engineering Manager for a team of Software and Systems Engineers.</li> <li>Demonstrate a track record of managing a team including hiring, onboarding, and professional development. You inspire your team to reach higher. You're as good at explaining "why" as you are "how".</li> <li>Excel at planning and overseeing execution to meet commitments and deliver with predictability.</li> <li>Experience/interest in Layer 3 and Layer 4 networking</li> <li>Experience/interest in network performance monitoring and tuning.</li> <li>Experience with monitoring, alerting, and debugging distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience participating in and/or managing an on-call rotation for production services with direct customer impact.</li> <li>Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your workflow.</li> <li>Clarity in written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €89,000-122,000. </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Lisbon, Portugal </li> <li>London, UK </li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's network-as-a-service: Egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products.</p> <p>As a member of the Egress team, you will be a key technical contributor to a cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is WARP, our Zero Trust platform, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/icloud-private-relay/">iCloud Private Relay</a> product.</p> <p>You will work closely with various Engineering teams to translate their requirements into new capabilities on the platform. Likewise you will partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure that the technology makes the best use of Cloudflare's world-class edge network.</p> <p>You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, Linux networking, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Grafana, Kubernetes, and more.</p> <p>Engineering teams at Cloudflare operate a Run What You Build model, including ours. We are responsible for the health of our system and participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of operational responsibilities.</p> <p>Because you’ll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Make daily progress on assigned engineering tasks, such as designing systems, writing specs, writing and pushing code via git, writing release plans for complex changes, rolling out production releases and working with other teams to coordinate system actions</li> <li>Participate in daily and ad-hoc team meetings to share progress and collaborate</li> <li>Participate in the team’s on-call schedule to ensure uptime of our production systems</li> <li>Investigating customer issues that are escalated to the Egress team for triage and resolution</li> <li>Responding to questions from other teams in the Egress team’s internal, public chat room</li> <li>Using AI-powered tools and systems as part of your daily workflow to analyze and extend codebases, introspect production systems and datasets, and accelerate problem-solving</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including a track record of owning the architecture of complex, distributed, production-critical systems end to end.</li> <li>Programming experience in <strong>Go or Rust</strong> and a desire to improve your skills in both.</li> <li>A solid grasp of networking protocols in Layers 3 and 4 of the OSI Model.</li> <li>Knowledge of HTTP, TLS, and CDN networks.</li> <li>Experience in implementing secure and highly-available distributed systems.</li> <li>Strong ability to debug issues in complex systems.</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills.</li> <li>Experience/interest in HTTP networking and VPN technologies.</li> <li>Experience/interest in network performance monitoring and tuning.</li> <li>Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your engineering workflow.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Knowledge of TCP/IP and Internet routing.</li> <li>Professional systems-level programming experience in Rust.</li> <li>Experience building tools and APIs.</li> <li>Experience with monitoring, alerting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems</li> <li>Experience participating in an on-call rotation.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code completion, codebase analysis, log/data exploration) in a professional setting.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Senior Account Executive, Hotels - France & Netherlands (12M FTC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></p> <p>The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping independent, boutique hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you will be responsible for converting leads into net‑new supply to support new-market launches and at pace to hit quarterly goals. Working the full sales funnel, you will proactively turn cold leads into warm sales opportunities helping to build the Hotels category’s market presence in the process through collaboration with other teams. This includes partnering, strategizing, and running daily operations directly with independent, boutique hotels , and ensuring that Airbnb sources  the best hotel inventory available to our guests.</p> <p>This role is based in Paris (hybrid, 2 days a week in the office).  It will start off as a 12-month FTC with the potential for conversion depending on individual performance. </p> <p><strong>A Typical Day</strong></p> <ul> <li>Meet and exceed KPIs by owning the performance and success of assigned region</li> <li>Prospect new potential hotels through external research, networking, and use of Airbnb tools.</li> <li>Securing new hotels involves targeted sales strategies and negotiating and closing the deals</li> <li>Develops acquisition strategies and scalable, localised supply strategies for established and emerging markets</li> <li>Expertly position and communicate Airbnb’s value proposition to new partners via phone, email, and in-person</li> <li>Add net new hotels by qualifying and moving leads through the funnel as quickly as possible, achieving defined quarterly goals</li> <li>Find supply in and launch new markets: Own market launches including supporting lead generation and coordinating cross functionally</li> <li>Support hotel onboarding as needed from won sales opportunities</li> <li>Effectively promote and build strong relationships with hotels by demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of our platforms and confidently pitching their value</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional experience, preferably in a fast growing startup tech or hospitality company working in sales and/or account management</li> <li>Previous hospitality experience is a plus</li> <li>Proficiency in both English and French.</li> <li>CRM required; Proficiency in Salesforce, Gong and other scalable AI Sales prospecting tools is a plus.</li> <li>The ability to get things done with constantly changing priorities, projects and deadlines</li> <li>Excellent communication, organizational, and analytical skills, detail-oriented but moves fast</li> <li>Ability to establish strong relationships with and influence partners </li> <li>Capacity to balance day-to-day responsibilities with longer-term strategic execution</li> <li>You’re a quick learner and you’re fearless about doing whatever it takes to get the job done, even if it means making mistakes along the way</li> <li>Able to travel up to 25-30% of the time</li> <li>Passion for Airbnb and travel</li> </ul> <p><strong>How We’ll Take Care of You:</strong></p> <p>Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for variable incentive pay, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</p> <p>The On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) range for this role is €98,000 to €115,000 gross per year, which includes a split of 80% (base pay) / 20% (variable incentive). Of this OTE amount, the annual gross base salary range is €78,400 to €92,000. </p> <p>The OTE reflected on this job posting is the target cash compensation a candidate could earn in a year if they achieve 100% of their performance or sales goals. The variable incentive is not guaranteed and is governed by the terms of Airbnb’s Hotels Variable Compensation Plan (the “Plan”). The actual payouts depend on performance against targets set under the “Plan” and may be higher or lower than the range listed on this job posting.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing & CRM Intern, Experiences
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The community you will join:</strong></p> <p>Airbnb is looking for a Marketing & CRM intern to join the Experiences team in Paris for a 6-month internship. </p> <p>You will work directly with the person in charge of Demand for Paris Experiences, alongside Marketing, Growth and Product Management partners.</p> <p>Experiences let guests step into the real life of a destination: cook with a local chef, explore a hidden neighborhood with a historian, discover Paris through the eyes of the people who live there. Paris is one of our most iconic and competitive markets, and our job on the Demand side is to make sure the right guests find the right Experience at the right moment, whether they are visiting Paris or live nearby.</p> <p>We are looking for a curious, organized and data-friendly student who loves the craft of CRM and Operational Marketing: a sharp brief, a well-built email, a smart audience, and an analysis that tells us what to do next. You are comfortable juggling several campaigns at once, working with different teams, and turning numbers into clear recommendations.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The difference you will make:</strong></p> <p>You will support the Paris Experiences Demand lead on the day-to-day CRM and marketing activity that drives bookings. You will see a campaign from the first brief to the final analysis, and you will own your own projects along the way. During your internship, you will:</p> <p><em>Run email campaigns end to end</em></p> <ul> <li>Write briefs for email campaigns (audience, objective, key messages, timing) and coordinate with copy, design and CRM partners</li> <li>Execute campaigns through our internal tools and planning process, including setup, QA and send follow-up</li> <li>Analyze results after each send (opens, clicks, bookings, incrementality) and share clear learnings and next steps</li> </ul> <p><em>Support listing promotion and audience targeting</em></p> <ul> <li>Analyze cohorts of guests (new vs. returning, local vs. traveler, International vs Domestic) to understand behavior over time</li> <li>Build simple, readable dashboards and recurring reports to select and prioritize listings based on quality, availability, performance and fit with the campaign</li> <li>Work with Market and Supply teams to make sure what we promote is bookable and best-in-class</li> <li>Turn insights into concrete recommendations for audiences, timing and messaging</li> </ul> <p><em>Follow local activations</em></p> <ul> <li>Provide operational support and follow-up on field campaigns such as flyering, partnerships, events or more: briefing, logistics, timing, partners and results tracking</li> <li>Help measure what works locally and recommend future iterations</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The intern experience:</strong></p> <p>As an intern, you will be part of a team where you contribute to real projects with real business impact. Your manager, your team and our wider employee community will strive to be superhosts to you during your internship. We provide the support, mentorship and hands-on experience you need to learn quickly and make an impact. </p> <p>You’ll get a front-row seat on how a global marketplace builds demand for a destination, with real ownership from day one: your campaigns go live and your analyses shape decisions. You’ll do it alongside a team that cares about craft, curiosity and human connection. You can expect to:</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Marketing, Market Management and Acquisition partners to deliver projects</li> <li>Present your analyses and recommendations to stakeholders</li> <li>Seek and give feedback throughout the internship</li> <li>Take part in the Experiences and broader Airbnb community</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Current student or recent graduate</strong> (degree completed within the last 12 months) from a leading business school, engineering school or equivalent program in France, looking for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027</li> <li><strong>Fluent in French and English</strong>, with excellent written communication: you can write a clear brief and a clear recap. You also have an eye for great copy and for what makes a message feel human</li> <li><strong>A strong interest in marketing, CRM or growth</strong>, and in travel, hospitality or community-driven products</li> <li><strong>Curious about data and performance metrics</strong>, with an interest in using insights and quantitative analysis to evaluate campaigns, track performance, and inform decision-making. Experience with Claude or other AI tools to work faster and smarter is a must-have. </li> <li><strong>Highly organized and detail-oriented</strong>, able to manage several campaigns and deadlines in parallel, and to follow up until everything is done</li> <li><strong>A collaborative mindset </strong>and the confidence to work with people across teams, from Marketing to Product to Operations</li> <li>Must have work authorization for France. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your location:</strong></p> <p>Due to the nature of this position, the successful applicant will need to be based in Paris, France to be able to conduct their work. title: (Senior) Implementation Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Dafür bauen wir ein eigenes Consulting-Team auf, und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Die Rolle Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach der Unterschrift und bringst sie in den ersten 90 Tagen in die produktive Nutzung. Du leitest den Kick-off, klärst mit dem Kunden, wer ausschreibt und mit welchem Projekt es losgeht, schulst Einkauf, Kalkulation und Projektleitung und sorgst dafür, dass die ersten Ausschreibungen rausgehen und Angebote zurückkommen. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, merkst du es früh und drehst ihn, notfalls über die Geschäftsführung. Nach 90 Tagen übergibst du ihn mit klarem Stand an seinen Account Manager. Du begleitest viele Kunden parallel, vom Familienbetrieb bis zum Generalunternehmer mit mehreren Niederlassungen. Als Senior Implementation Consultant übernimmst du die komplexen Einführungen: mehrere Standorte oder Gesellschaften, Freigabeprozesse, Systemlandschaften und viele Beteiligte. Und du entwickelst mit, wie unser Consulting-Team arbeitet. Du berichtest an die Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams. Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen Deine Kunden sind nach 90 Tagen produktiv: Sie schreiben über Cosuno aus und erhalten Angebote, nachweisbar im Activation Report. Jeder Kick-off endet mit klaren Zusagen: ausschreibende Nutzer, erstes Projekt, Termine, Mandat der Geschäftsführung. Kunden, die hinter Plan liegen, haben schnell einen Plan, und die meisten holen auf. Deine Kunden bewerten ihr Onboarding gut, und dein Account Manager weiß bei der Übergabe genau, wo der Kunde steht. Als Senior: Deine komplexen Einführungen erreichen ihr Ziel, und das Team arbeitet mit Bausteinen, die du entwickelt hast. Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast. Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal. Drive. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, rufst du an, statt auf die nächste Mail zu warten. Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird. Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn du gern erklärst und es dich reizt, gerade die Skeptiker zu überzeugen. du lieber vom Ziel rückwärts planst, als Schulungen abzuarbeiten. du bei vielen Kunden parallel den Überblick behältst und weißt, wer heute deine Zeit bekommt. du mit Kalkulatoren und Geschäftsführern gleichermaßen auf Augenhöhe sprichst. du verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft und vergeben wird. Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du Onboarding als eine Reihe von Produktdemos verstehst. du lieber in langen Projekten mit wenigen Kunden berätst als viele Kunden schnell zum Ergebnis zu bringen. du wartest, bis der Kunde sich meldet. Harte Anforderungen Mindestens ein Jahr eigene Verantwortung für die Einführung einer Software beim Kunden, etwa als Implementation Consultant, Onboarding Manager oder Customer Success Manager mit Onboarding-Schwerpunkt, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS. Erfahrung mit vielen parallelen Kunden und belegbare Ergebnisse, zum Beispiel Go-live- oder Aktivierungsquoten. Du hältst Schulungen und Workshops souverän, online und vor Ort. Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch, Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS und sicherer Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen sind ein Plus. Für Senior Implementation Consultant zusätzlich: Einführungen bei Kunden mit mehreren Standorten, Gesellschaften oder Systemen und viel Kontakt zur Geschäftsführung. Was wir bieten Aufbau: Du bist von Anfang an Teil eines neuen Teams und gestaltest mit, wie wir Kunden in die Nutzung bringen. Wirkung: Klare Ziele und direkter Einfluss darauf, ob ein Kunde bleibt. Entwicklung: Vom Implementation Consultant zum Senior über immer komplexere Kunden, mit regelmäßigen 1:1s und offener Feedbackkultur. Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung. Arbeitsort: Remote innerhalb der EU möglich, Berlin-Kreuzberg bevorzugt. Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline. So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess Kennenlernen mit unserem Head of Customer Success (45 Minuten) Gespräch mit der Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams (30 Minuten) Case Study an einem realistischen Neukunden, dazu ein Gespräch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem Team Referenzgespräch, danach unser Angebot Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Talent Partner, Tech
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Why this role exists We are about to hire the people who will define the next phase of this company. Not backfill a plan someone else wrote — define it. The quality of who joins Dust over the next eighteen months is the single highest-leverage variable in whether we build the category or watch someone else do it. That work needs a recruiter who treats hiring as a craft rather than a queue. Someone who can hold a real point of view on what "great" looks like for a role, defend it with a hiring manager who disagrees, and then go find that person themselves — from a cold start, without a lead gen team, a sourcing pod, or a playbook waiting for them. You'll be an early member of a small Talent team. That means you own roles end to end, and you also help build the thing itself: the assessment design, the interview loops, the calibration, the data we use to know whether any of it is working. We're looking for someone who cares about the candidate experience for all parties internal and external. And prioritizes protecting Dust's culture by being thoughtful, thorough and leading by example in being a true team player. What you'll own Full-cycle hiring, end to end. You run your own searches from role kickoff to close. Sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, offer strategy, negotiation. You are the owner of the outcome, not a coordinator of other people's opinions. Assessment design, not just assessment delivery. For every role you open, you help define what evidence would actually predict success — then you build the loop that surfaces it. You'll push back on interview stages that exist out of habit and replace them with ones that test something real. Hiring manager partnership with a spine. You'll spend as much time calibrating hiring managers as you do talking to candidates. When a manager says "not quite the right feel," you'll ask what they mean until there's a defensible answer, and you'll say so when there isn't one. Market intelligence. You'll know your talent market better than anyone else in the building — who's good, where they are, what moves them, what compensation actually looks like right now — and you'll bring that back into how we scope roles and design offers. The candidate experience. Our hiring process is the first honest sample of what working here feels like. You'll make it expedient, direct, well-communicated, and worth a candidate's time whether or not they get an offer. Building the function. Process, tooling, structured scorecards, funnel data, quality-of-hire signal. You'll leave the system better than you found it, and you'll be trusted to change it without asking permission first. Two tracks — tell us which one is yours We're hiring for depth in one of two areas. You should have a genuine centre of gravity in one; interest in the other is a bonus, not a requirement. GTM. Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Marketing, and the leaders above them, across Europe and the US. You know how to assess commercial talent on evidence rather than swagger, and you can tell the difference between a rep who carried a territory and a rep who inherited one. Technical. Software engineers, infrastructure, product, and design, in a market where the best people are not looking and the second-best are drowning in outreach. You can hold a credible conversation about what someone actually built, and you know why that matters more than where they built it. How we think about hiring We're telling you this up front because if you disagree with it, this will be a frustrating job. We don't hire based on pedigree. Logos and school names are weak evidence. What someone has actually done, and what they can demonstrate now, is strong evidence. We design our loops accordingly. We hire for evidence, not affinity. "Culture fit" that means "reminds me of me" is how companies get homogeneous and slow. We assess against explicit behaviours tied to how we work, and we write down what we saw. Speed and rigour are not in tension. Slow processes are usually a symptom of unclear thinking about the role, not of high standards. A no should be as clear as a yes. To the candidate, and internally. Some of us came from well-known companies. That's context, not criteria. It isn't why we're here and it won't be why you are. We celebrate everyone's achievements and want to create an environment where diversity of thought and experience of a collective whole makes this place exceptional and lasting. Recruiters are operators, not order-takers. If you think a role is wrongly scoped, badly levelled, or shouldn't be open at all, you're expected to say so. What we're looking for 5+ years in full-cycle recruiting, with meaningful time in-house at a high-growth company. You've hired in an environment with real ambiguity, not just real volume. Demonstrable depth in either GTM or technical hiring — you can talk through searches you've run, what made them hard, and what you'd do differently. Genuinely strong sourcing. Not "I partner with a sourcing team." You find people yourself, and you write outreach that people reply to because it's obviously written by a human who read something. Comfort operating without infrastructure. No playbook, no SDR equivalent, limited tooling to start. The judgement and directness to challenge senior stakeholders, and the credibility to be listened to when you do. A bias to start. You see the gap and close it before anyone asks you to. Excellent written English and a real feel for language. Everything you write is a piece of our employer brand. Low ego, high ownership. No job is too big or too small — you'll design an assessment framework in the morning and chase a scheduling conflict in the afternoon. Based in Paris, London or New York. Ideal, but not required: experience hiring in AI or developer-facing companies; experience building or improving a hiring process rather than inheriting one; multi-market hiring across Europe and the US. You'll be using AI to do this job — properly We build the AI operating system that companies use to rewire their work. We expect our own team to be the sharpest possible example of that. You'll build and run your own Dust agents: market maps, candidate research, interview debrief synthesis, competitive intelligence on where talent is moving. Not as a side project — as how the job gets done. You don't need to have done this before, but you do need to be the kind of person who is genuinely excited to, rather than politely tolerant of it. You'll also be one of our most credible internal sources of feedback on the product, because you'll be a heavy user of it every day. Location This role is based in Paris, London or New York, and we'd love you to spend real time in the office with the team. A lot of the best things about building at Dust happen because people are in the same room: the energy, the fast decisions, the unexpected conversation that unlocks a hard problem. We hire people with strong judgement and extend that trust to how they manage their time. Our process We'll tell you the full loop up front, keep it to a small number of stages, and give you a decision quickly. You'll meet the people you'd work with, not a panel of proxies. Expect at least one stage where you work through a real hiring problem with us rather than describing a past one. If you don't check every box, apply anyway. We're more interested in your potential and how you think than a perfect match to a checklist. Please send your application and resume in English. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Team Lead (mid-market)
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ Sales Team Lead (mid-market) ⭐ We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Account Executives and scale some of our Mid-Market segments addressing companies of 30–300 employees. In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Account Executives to win the associated market. This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan. Why mid-market is exciting at Alan: A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on. Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly. A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers. Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France. ⭐ What you will do ⭐ You will be the Sales leader of one of the Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will: Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets. Lead a team of Account Executives: Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew. Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management. Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates. Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy. Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.). ⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐ Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works Have experience selling to mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.) Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy Nice-to-have: Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance . Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only. Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply ! Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. title: Marketing Operations
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions. It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable. Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side , we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side , messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket. We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems , operate them strategically , and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly. ⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️ We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers , each embedded in a different crew: Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process. Why is this role interesting? Speed : marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew Trust : clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time Scale : as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly AI at the frontier : this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption What will you do with us? You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model. Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities: Marketing Automation & CRM : own and optimize our marketing stack ( Customer.io , CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos Data Model & Governance : maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice Segmentation & Lifecycle Design : design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos Nurturing Infrastructure : own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant AI-First Operations : identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them Performance Monitoring : track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data Documentation & Enablement : create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns Then, depending on your crew: Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales. Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams. title: Customer Operations Director
description: Customer Operations Director Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence? As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets. Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. What will you do? You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. You will: Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high. In addition: You have 10+ years of experience in customer service, order management and/or sales support in a B2B environment. You have 5+ years of leadership experience, including managing team leaders and being responsible for service performance. You have a proven track record of improving processes and leading change, ideally across multiple countries. You combine commercial awareness with operational discipline. You have experience with CRM and order management systems, and you know how to turn data into practical improvements. Experience in building automation, technical products or subscription services is a strong plus. You are fluent in Dutch and professionally proficient in English. German is a plus. You are willing to travel regularly between teams and markets. What you get In numbers A competitive salary based on your experience; We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 8% holiday allowance; Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. For your own sustainability Be secured with our pension plan; Feel engaged and join our participation plan; Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. Ready to make an impact? Do you want to take Customer Operations within Building Automation to the next level and build a strong, scalable and customer-focused organization for our customers and partners? Then we would love to meet you. Apply for the position of Customer Operations Director and discover how you can make an impact at Priva. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
description: The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence. Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting. Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination. Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden. Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai , RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing. Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation. Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection. Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k). Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required. Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design. PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, clinical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience (required). 8+ years in product or delivery for medical devices or medical imaging software, with products shipped end to end (required). Knowledge of radiology and emergency department workflows (required). Knowledge of machine learning in Clinical AI (required). Experience running cross-functional delivery across data, ML, software, and QA/RA to fixed dates (required). Fluent English (required). Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) in current work (required). Preferred: French language skills. Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background. Preferred: Experience with SaMD and regulated environments (EU MDR, FDA 510(k)). Quality Standards Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors. Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance. Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment. Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures. Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times. Practices universal safety precautions. Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person. Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems. Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines. Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner. Travel This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
