title: Communications Officer
company: Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering - BIIE
description: About the BIIE The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region. Position Overview We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences. Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities. This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events. Key Responsibilities Content Creation Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials. Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content. Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics. Website & Social Media Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date. Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling. Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Internal Communications Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged. Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials. Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity. Stakeholder Engagement & Events Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring. Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM. Plan and coordinate internal and external BIIE events, including scientific events, stakeholder events, visits and institutional activities. Manage event logistics and communications, including invitations, programmes, briefings, promotional materials and follow-up activities. Communications Strategy & General Support Support the Head of Communications & Institute Relations in establishing and implementing the BIIE's Communications and Institute relation Strategy and related priorities. Ensure consistent application of the BIIE's key messages, tone of voice and visual identity across communications activities and materials. Support the planning, coordination and implementation of communications projects and campaigns across the Institute. Required Qualifications Essential University degree in communications, journalism, or a related field. At least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in communications, science communication, journalism or a related role. Excellent writing and editing skills in English and German. Experience creating and managing content in particular for digital channels. Ability to understand complex scientific topics and translate them into accurate, accessible and engaging content for wider audiences. Strong organisational and project management skills. Ability and confidence to work directly with leading scientists and subject-matter experts. A proactive, collaborative and hands-on working style, with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and growing organisation. Preferred Background or professional experience in academia, life sciences, pharma, biotechnology, global health or another field relevant to the BIIE. Experience with website content management systems and digital analytics. Experience with visual communications and design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva. Experience producing or commissioning photography, video or other multimedia content. Additional languages apart from English and German. Experience working in an international and multicultural environment. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Solution Consultant - Enterprise Software & KI (m/w/d)
description: Wie findet man ein geeignetes Produkt aus Millionen von Varianten, ohne dass der Vertrieb alles im Kopf haben muss? Mit dieser Frage kommen Unternehmen zu uns. Wir lösen sie mit dem SquareNeo SalesCoach, unserer cloudbasierten KI-Plattform für den Vertrieb komplexer, variantenreicher Produkte. Wir sind ein Team aus zwei Gründern, fünf Entwicklern und zwei Beratern. Für die Beratung suchen wir Verstärkung: jemand, der Kundenprojekte eigenverantwortlich führt und mit uns gestaltet, wie SquareNeo wächst. Bei unserer Größe heißt das: kurze Wege, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und spürbarer Einfluss auf Produkt und Unternehmen. Uns sind Gemeinschaft, Kreativität, Fairness, gegenseitiger Respekt und Spaß bei (und auch mal nach) der Arbeit wichtig. Bist du bereit, deine Karriere auf das nächste Level zu heben? Dann bist du bei SquareNeo genau richtig! Aufgaben In unserer Onboarding-Phase lernst du den SalesCoach, unsere Entwicklungsprozesse und unsere KI-Agenten kennen und begleitest ein laufendes Projekt, bevor du eigene übernimmst. Du verantwortest Kundenprojekte von der Anforderung bis zur fertigen Lösung auf Basis des SalesCoach und bist dabei die zentrale Ansprechperson für den Kunden. Wir lösen die kniffligen Fälle. Du denkst dich tief in die Vertriebsstrukturen, die Produkt- und Regelwelt und die IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden ein und entwickelst daraus Lösungen, die sich umsetzen lassen und einen messbaren Mehrwert bringen. Du übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Tickets für die Entwicklung, steuerst die Umsetzung und stellst dem Kunden die Zwischenstände vor. Du arbeitest täglich mit aktuellen KI-Ansätzen wie LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI und MCP, sowohl in den Kundenlösungen als auch in unseren eigenen Arbeitsprozessen. Und ganz wichtig: Du bringst dich aktiv ein. Wir wollen wachsen und freuen uns daher über all deine Ideen! Qualifikation Wenn du Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informationswirtschaft oder einen ähnlichen Studiengang studiert hast, passt das perfekt. Muss-Kriterium: Du hast mind. 5 Jahre Unternehmenserfahrung in der Beratung oder Softwareentwicklung. Du hast Projekte rund um Enterprise-Software begleitet und kennst die IT-Landschaften von Unternehmen aus der Praxis, etwa CRM, ERP oder CPQ. Du kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell durchdringen und sie für Fachbereich und Entwicklung gleichermaßen verständlich machen. Erfahrung mit KI und LLMs ist ein Plus. Tiefes Wissen baust du bei uns auf, auch über Schulungen zu aktuellen Themen. Muss-Kriterium: Viele unserer Kunden sind im deutschsprachigen Raum ansässig und auch die Teamsprache ist Deutsch. Deutschkenntnisse auf dem Niveau C1 sind daher nötig. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für technologische Innovationen und die Motivation, kontinuierlich Neues zu lernen. Wir sind ein Start-up und wollen gemeinsam etwas aufbauen. Jeder packt mit an. Wenn du darauf Lust hast, bist du ein perfekter Match! :-) Benefits Wir helfen dir dabei, Experte in der Kerntechnologie der nächsten Jahrzehnte zu werden: Künstliche Intelligenz Wir haben ein modernes und zentral gelegenes Büro mit Start-up-Flair im Smart-Production-Park (Cyberlab) in der belebten Karlsruher Oststadt Ob im Büro, von zu Hause oder von unterwegs - der Mix macht's. Jeder arbeitet bei uns, wo es am besten passt. Um uns optimal abstimmen zu können, ist die Stelle jedoch nicht ausschließlich aus dem Homeoffice machbar. Passe deine Arbeitszeit fortlaufend an: 50 % / 60 % / 80 % / 100 %-Vertrag - ganz wie es zu der jeweiligen Lebenssituation passt. 30 Urlaubstage inkludiert - 10 weitere können pro Jahr hinzugekauft werden. Und natürlich haben wir auch ein paar monetäre Benefits: steuerfreier Sachgutschein, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersversorgung, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und Corporate Benefits bei vielen Marken. Darüber hinaus: kostenlose Getränke, Süßigkeiten, Eis und der obligatorische Obstkorb :-) Komm zu SquareNeo und gestalte die Zukunft der KI mit uns! Werde Teil unseres motivierten und wachsenden Teams als Senior Solution Consultant. Deine Ideen zählen – bewirb dich jetzt! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Working Student Communications (f/m/d)
description: 01 · Why this role exists This year, RIZM has created unprecedented savings at our customers. We just aren't telling anyone. If you love telling stories, let's talk. RIZMO is our Agentic Energy Manager: an AI agent that helps industrial companies optimize their energy use and cut costs. We work with BMW, Stellantis, Boehringer Ingelheim and Bitburger. Right now, those success stories stay inside the project team. Nice to have: Experience with video editing, PR or event organization. Availability: 20 hours per week on-site in Münster or Munich, for at least 6 months, ideally longer. 04 · What we offer Pay: €16 per hour. Real ownership: From day one, you'll help build our communications from the ground up. Short paths: A direct line to the founders and fast decisions. Stories worth telling: Customers everyone knows. 05 · How to apply You love telling stories? Then tell us two. No cover letter needed: What topic could you explain for hours without ever getting bored? What experience from your studies shaped you more than any exam? Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Territory Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <p>Spain</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic <strong>Territory Account Executive</strong> to join our <strong>Iberia Sales Team</strong>. In this role, you will be pivotal in driving growth across your assigned territory in Spain by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of existing customers and strategically acquiring new logos.</p> <p>The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders, such as Heads or VPs of Networking, Security, and Infrastructure.</p> <p>As a Territory Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate proficiency across all sales activities, ensuring accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistent achievement of attainment targets. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare’s platform sale, actively involving and influencing senior technical executives.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of regional specialists, Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as a trusted authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers—such as new offering development and enhanced customer capabilities—and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare’s services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the “why,” communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation and Closure:</strong> Lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate strong closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Trusted Advisor and Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, supporting deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of their work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organisation.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Organisational Impact and Leadership:</strong> Focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Contribute to Cloudflare’s broader sales organisation while elevating the work of others through diverse perspectives and strategic thinking.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <ul> <li> <p>5+ years of experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B sales model, with a significant track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing a defined territory or portfolio of accounts, balancing new-logo acquisition with retention and expansion of existing customers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Knowledge of, or experience selling into, the Spanish market, with an understanding of its business and technology landscape.</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep expertise and fluency in cloud networking, security, and edge computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven ability to understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams—including Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal—to drive complex deals to closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the “why” and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context, such as account intelligence, outreach personalisation, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. title: Staff Backend Engineer - Analytics Instrumentation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of this role</strong><br>Analytics Instrumentation is part of the Data Engineering and Monetization (DE&M) group, focused on the collection of Product Usage and Billing event data within GitLab. We build data collection platforms that enable product teams to assess user behavior and make evidence-based choices through privacy-conscious instrumentation that captures product usage throughout the user lifecycle.<br><br>As a Staff Backend Engineer, you’ll guide the design and development of a unified data infrastructure platform that consolidates analytics instrumentation across GitLab’s engineering organization. You’ll build and maintain backend systems that give the company visibility into customer usage patterns across GitLab SaaS and Self-Managed deployment environments. That data directly informs strategic product priorities and strategies. This role offers the opportunity to work on foundational infrastructure that simplifies instrumentation for teams at GitLab, replacing the complexity of multiple language-specific software development kits with a single, unified solution that teams can rely on.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Guide the design, implementation, and evolution of a unified data collection platform using Golang, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, and NATS, with success measured by reliability, performance, and adoption across GitLab teams.</li> <li>Improve the emission, transit, and quality of instrumentation data across the system, with success measured by data quality, data integrity, and usage billing accuracy.</li> <li>Provide technical guidance for usage billing and instrumentation systems during working hours, with success measured by timely incident handling, effective root cause analysis, and reliable service restoration.</li> <li>Work across the organization with research and development teams and the enterprise data organization to deliver common solutions, with success measured by adoption across multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Make technical choices that balance ease of use for product teams with reliability and correctness for data consumers, with success measured by platform usability and reliable downstream data.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and clear technical documentation, with success measured by stronger code quality, faster technical alignment, and more maintainable systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience working with platform or infrastructure systems in production environments.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in the Go programming language, with experience building and maintaining production services.</li> <li>Strong backend development experience, with the ability to design and deliver scalable, reliable systems serving internal and external customers.</li> <li>Experience guiding technical design and making tradeoffs across system reliability, performance at scale, data quality, and observability.</li> <li>Experience working across team boundaries with product teams, data consumers, and other internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud native technologies and open source development practices.</li> <li>A track record of mentoring other engineers and helping teams make clear, well-documented technical choices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>The Analytics Instrumentation team operates at the intersection of Product, Analytics, and customer-facing teams, providing data collection infrastructure that serves engineering teams across GitLab. We’re a distributed team of generalist engineers who tackle complex problems spanning the GitLab codebase, JavaScript, Go, and Python satellite services, data pipelines, and AI tool integration. We collaborate transparently across teams, deliver measurable results through efficient iteration, and build inclusive solutions that respect user privacy. Our work enables data-informed choices and planning across the organization. title: Senior Solution Architect - PKI (m/w/x)
description: Digitale Identitäten, sichere Kommunikation und der Schutz sensibler Daten sind zentrale Voraussetzungen einer modernen digitalen Gesellschaft. Unser Mandant ist ein spezialisiertes Technologieunternehmen im Bereich digitaler Vertrauensdienste und entwickelt hochsichere Lösungen für die digitale Identifizierung, Authentifizierung und Kommunikation. Für den IT-Bereich suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Solution Architect – Public Trust PKI (TLS & S/MIME) (m/w/d), der die strategische und technische Weiterentwicklung der IT-Systemlandschaft sowie der Public-Trust-PKI maßgeblich mitgestaltet. In dieser Position übernimmst Du eine zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Architektur, Entwicklung, PKI-Betrieb und weiteren Fachbereichen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit fundierter technischer Expertise und schaffen die Voraussetzungen für leistungsfähige, sichere und zukunftsfähige Systemarchitekturen. Aufgaben Technologie- und Applikationsstrategie: Du koordinierst bereichsübergreifend die Weiterentwicklung einer ganzheitlichen Applikations- und Technologiestrategie für die Systemlandschaft sowie die Komponenten, Produkte und Lösungen unseres Mandanten. Systemarchitektur: Du konzipierst und gestaltest zukunftsfähige Systemarchitekturen und stellst sicher, dass technische, funktionale und regulatorische Anforderungen berücksichtigt werden. Anforderungsmanagement: Du verantwortest die Aufnahme, Analyse und Abstimmung von Anforderungen für die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Komponenten, Produkten und Lösungen. PKI-Architektur & CA Lifecycle Management: Du steuerst und überwachst den Lebenszyklus der Certificate Authorities (CA) und bildest eine wichtige Schnittstelle zum spezialisierten PKI-Team. Public-Trust-PKI: Du konzipierst und entwickelst CA-Hierarchien, Zertifikatsprofile und kryptographische Verfahren gemäß relevanter Standards und regulatorischer Anforderungen weiter. Governance & Compliance: Du erstellst und pflegst Certificate Policies (CP), Certification Practice Statements (CPS) sowie weitere sicherheits- und compliance-relevante Dokumentationen. Automatisierung & Tooling: Du evaluierst, entwickelst Prototypen und führst geeignete Tools zur Verwaltung und Automatisierung von Systemen ein. Audits & internationale Anforderungen: Du begleitest externe Audits, unterstützt die Pflege relevanter CCADB-Einträge und koordinierst Anforderungen internationaler Root-Programme. Stakeholder-Management: Du koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte, steuerst fachlich PKI-Spezialist und externe Dienstleister und sorgst für eine zielgerichtete Zusammenarbeit. Qualität & Weiterentwicklung: Du unterstützt das CA-Incident-Management, führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung von KPIs und SLA-Reports mit. title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward. What You’ll Bring: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved. Experience working in a regulated environment. Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work. A systematic, process-oriented way of working. The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems. A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements. The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed. Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices. Nice to have: Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working. Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required. Experience with MDSAP How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward. We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means: We take initiative rather than wait for direction. We focus on execution and delivering results. We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed. We challenge ideas, not people. We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar. We celebrate team success over individual heroics. We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals. If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you. What we offer Competitive salary including pension plan 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position Hybrid work model Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away. Training budget Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. Are you excited? We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Afstudeerstage | Marketing & Propositieontwikkeling
description: Hoe vertaal je marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar sterke proposities die zichtbaar zijn en commerciële kansen creëren? Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen. Risk Solutions ondersteunt organisaties bij het beheersen van financiële, operationele en compliance-risico’s. Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten. Jouw afstudeeropdracht Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management. De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd? Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. Je onderzoekt welke financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken bij klanten spelen, hoe organisaties daarmee omgaan en welke waarde verschillende oplossingen daarbij bieden. Ook kijk je naar wat belangrijk is voor bijvoorbeeld een Compliance Officer, Risk Manager, kredietmanager of directielid. Daarnaast onderzoek je de zichtbaarheid van de verschillende proposities. Je kijkt hoe kanalen en middelen zoals de website, SEO, LinkedIn, klantcases, whitepapers, nieuwsbrieven, webinars en evenementen worden ingezet en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Ook onderzoek je welke werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht en waar AI kan ondersteunen. Op basis van je onderzoek ontwikkel je een Marketing & Proposition Launch Framework . Hierin leg je een vaste werkwijze vast om een propositie van idee en positionering naar content, campagne, leadopvolging en evaluatie te brengen. Je maakt hiervoor praktische hulpmiddelen, zoals templates voor proposities en campagnes, afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om resultaten te meten. Tijdens je stage test je deze werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie. Samen met de betrokken collega’s doorloop je de verschillende stappen en maak je bijvoorbeeld een propositiecanvas, contentplan, campagne-opzet of salesmateriaal. Op basis van wat je in de praktijk tegenkomt, pas je de werkwijze aan. Zo ligt er aan het einde van je stage een aanpak die het team daarna zelf kan blijven gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Je analyseert het huidige proces, van marktontwikkeling en propositie tot campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je onderzoekt de markt en concurrenten en verdiept je in de financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken die bij klanten spelen. Je onderzoekt hoe proposities het beste in de markt kunnen worden gezet en welke content en kanalen bijdragen aan meer zichtbaarheid en vindbaarheid. Je kijkt hoe AI en automatisering kunnen helpen om werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren. Je test de ontwikkelde werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie en gebruikt de resultaten om deze verder te verbeteren. Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport. Je levert een geteste en praktische werkwijze op die het team daarna kan blijven gebruiken, inclusief hulpmiddelen, duidelijke afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om de resultaten te volgen. Dit krijg je Een afstudeerstage waarin je niet alleen onderzoekt, maar ook ontwikkelt en test Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ideeën Een laptop van de zaak Toegang tot de Centric Academy Een stagevergoeding van €550 per maand op basis van 40 uur per week Leuke activiteiten en borrels Dit breng je mee Voor deze afstudeerstage volg je een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Commerciële Economie, Marketing, Bedrijfskunde, International Business, Finance & Control, Finance, Communicatie, Business Innovation of een vergelijkbare studie. Volg je een wo-master en zoek je een meewerkstage waarin je onderzoek met praktijkervaring kunt combineren? Ook dan ben je van harte welkom om te solliciteren. Daarnaast: Heb je interesse in marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en commerciële vraagstukken Ben je geïnteresseerd in financiële en compliancevraagstukken Heb je enige ervaring met het uitvoeren en verwerken van onderzoek, bijvoorbeeld markt-, concurrentie- of doelgroepanalyse Werk je zelfstandig, gestructureerd en resultaatgericht Schakel je makkelijk tussen verschillende stakeholders en vakgebieden Heb je interesse in digitale marketing, data, AI en automatisering Ben je communicatief vaardig en beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk Heb je ervaring met tools voor data-analyse, CRM, online marketing of AI, zoals Excel, Power BI, Google Analytics of Copilot? Dan is dat een pre. Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric Wij zijn Centric, een IT-software en services bedrijf dat verweven zit in de Nederlandse Maatschappij. Vaak zie je ons logo niet op onze producten, maar ze worden gebruikt door o.a. gemeenten, grote retailers, banken en ziekenhuizen. Door bij ons te werken omring je jezelf met kansen. Kansen om impact te maken terwijl jij jezelf ontwikkelt! Geïnteresseerd? Neem vooral even contact op! Ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan via de button. Heb je vragen? Dan kan je contact opnemen met onze Campus Recruiter, Nicolle, via of +316 10 63 99 27. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Responsable d'agence F/H
description: 1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique. Aujourd'hui, avec plus de 10 domaines d'expertise, le Groupe Fondasol est la référence en études et ingénierie conseil de la construction. Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets. Grâce à son actionnariat salarié majoritaire, le Groupe Fondasol continue de renforcer les synergies entre ses expertises, crée des outils digitaux innovants, décarbone ses activités… Autant dire qu'ici, passion de son métier, engagement, évolution… sont des évidences. Prêt à conjuguer votre leadership, votre fibre commerciale et votre expertise dans un rôle à fort impact? Votre mission : créer, structurer et développer notre présence à Rennes. Véritable entrepreneur au sein du Groupe, vous pilotez la création complète de l’agence : développement commercial, structuration opérationnelle, recrutement progressif et représentation locale. A la fois grand ordonnateur, gestionnaire et optimisateur, vous êtes porté par un fort esprit d’entreprendre , qui contribue activement à la bonne gestion de votre agence. De la phase commerciale au déploiement du projet stratégique et de transformation du Groupe, vous contribuez à la chaine de valeur et à l’image de marque du Groupe Fondasol. Vos principales missions Vous assurez le développement commercial , en proposant l’ensemble de nos expertises et solutions innovantes (Géotechnique, Hydrogéologie, Environnement, Pathologie des Structures, etc.). Vous êtes le garant de la qualité de la relation client et de l'acquisition de nouveaux projets. Excellent gestionnaire, vous assurez la traduction de vos actions en performance économique , optimisant la rentabilité de vos agences Vous êtes impliqué dans les projets stratégiques du Groupe et contribuez aux décisions clés (innovations métier, projet stratégique et de transformation du Groupe, décisions stratégiques…). Représentez Fondasol auprès des acteurs majeurs du territoire , consolidant notre image de marque et nos partenariats. Votre future équipe Dans un premier temps, vous démarrez en autonomie, accompagné de près par les équipes techniques, commerciales et RH du Groupe. Votre rôle sera ensuite de constituer et structurer votre équipe , en recrutant progressivement les talents nécessaires au développement de l’agence. Vous bénéficierez du soutien d’un réseau national d’ingénieurs et d’experts, véritable force d’ingénierie prête à collaborer pour concrétiser nos ambitions sur le Grand Ouest. Vos principaux alliés Une image de marque forte, héritée de plus de 65 ans d’expertise dans les sols et les structures. Une galaxie d’outils digitaux de pointe développés en interne, pour maximiser efficacité et qualité. Une organisation solide en filière Ingénierie et Investigations. Le soutien des fonctions support (technique, commercial, RH…). Un projet d’entreprise unique, porté par un actionnariat salarié majoritaire (75 % du capital détenu par les collaborateurs). Profil recherché Diplômé d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un Master en Géotechnique, Génie Civil ou Travaux Publics. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans une fonction similaire (bureau d’ingénierie géotechnique, fondations spéciales…). Excellentes capacités d’organisation, de gestion et d’analyse. Leadership naturel, sens du collectif et qualités humaines affirmées. Goût prononcé pour le développement, la création et l’entrepreneuriat. title: Senior SecOps Team Lead
description: Equativ is an independent ad tech company. Our programmatic advertising platform runs at high scale, with production running entirely on Google Cloud Platform. The role You manage the SecOps team and own the day-to-day security operations of a full-cloud company. You build the team, grow its people and deliver the SecOps roadmap, which you define with the IT & Security lead. You stay close to the technology: roughly 30% of your time is spent on people management and stakeholders, 70% on technical leadership and hands-on work during incidents and key projects. Responsibilities People and team Manage the SecOps engineers: 1:1s, objectives, annual reviews, CPF level assessments and career growth. Run the team's rituals, plan and prioritize the SEC Jira backlog. Represent SecOps in cross-team forums with R&D and Operations teams. Report security operations KPIs and risks to the IT & Security lead. Security operations Define and enforce the GCP security baseline: organization policies, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC Service Controls, KMS and Secret Manager. Own cloud security posture with Wiz, and drive remediation with owning teams. Own detection and response: log pipelines, SIEM use cases, alert quality, incident playbooks. Lead security incidents end-to-end and run blameless post-mortems. Run vulnerability management across cloud, containers, dependencies and external attack surface; track remediation SLAs. Scope external pentests and follow findings through to remediation. Embed security in the SDLC with R&D: threat modeling, SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning. Own the operational evidence for the ISMS and ISO 27001 audit Own the technical answers to security questionnaires and RFPs. Must-have profile 8+ years in security engineering or SecOps, including 3+ years securing production on a public cloud — GCP strongly preferred, AWS/Azure transferable. 2+ years managing a security team: hiring, reviews, coaching. Strong GCP security knowledge: IAM model, org policies, VPC-SC, logging, GKE security. Hands-on experience with modern cloud-native security platforms such as Google SecOps (Chronicle), Security Command Center (SCC), and Wiz (or similar CNAPPs). Proven incident response leadership, including cloud incidents. Experience running detection, vulnerability management and pentest programs. Able to set priorities, say no and arbitrate between security risk and delivery. Clear written and spoken English and French; able to explain risk to engineers, leadership and customers. Nice to have Kubernetes / GKE hardening and runtime security. Experience in ad tech or other high-throughput, latency-sensitive platforms. Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits from the operations side. Identity and endpoint stack: Okta, Google Workspace, CrowdStrike. Certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, GCIH. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Available Locations: </span></strong><span style="font-size: 12pt;">London (UK)</span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h2> <p>Reporting to the Vulnerability Manager, the VM  Engineer will be responsible for identifying, analysing, and supporting the remediation of vulnerabilities across Cloudflare's Infrastructure and cloud environments.You will work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, cloud and compliance teams to identify, triage, and drive timely and effective remediation of security vulnerabilities in line with defined SLAs. A key focus of the role will be supporting DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, ensuring vulnerability processes, evidence, and tooling align with regulatory and assurance requirements. You will also apply AI-driven tools and methodologies to enhance scanning efficiency, triage accuracy, and automated remediation pathways. We are looking for a proactive, detail oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple remediation activities in parallel.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Conduct vulnerability scanning, and perform in-depth analysis of  findings from scanning tools (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7), to verify accuracy, identify systemic patterns, and filter out false positives.</li> <li>Triage, validate and prioritise vulnerabilities using risk based approaches to determine real business impact, and working with engineering and compliance teams to agree remediation actions and timelines.</li> <li>Develop, document, and deliver technical remediation guidance and solutions to enable application and infrastructure teams to remediate efficiently and consistently.</li> <li>Support DOD IL4 and Fedramp preparation, by ensuring vulnerability management processes, evidence, reporting, and controls meet regulatory and assurance expectations.</li> <li>Work closely with engineering and service teams to embed vulnerability management into delivery pipelines , operational processes and change management. </li> <li>Leverage AI security tools and automation to streamline triage, pattern recognition, and risk prioritisation.</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with engineering teams to track and report status and remediation progress</li> <li>Manage and track the remediation backlog, maintaining focus on risk reduction and measurable progress.</li> <li>Contribute to the continuous improvement of vulnerability management standards, procedures, and playbooks, ensuring alignment with IL4, Fedramp and other compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Solid understanding of DoD Impact level IL4, FedRAMP, SOC-2, and PCI frameworks.</li> <li>3+ years  Vulnerability Management experience in a heavily regulated environment.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or security certifications in a related field.</li> <li>Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.</li> <li>A strong understanding of CVSS (Common Vulnerability Scoring System) and how to apply risk assessment methodologies in a business context to support remediation..</li> <li>Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning platforms (e.g., Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7 InsightVM).</li> <li>Strong analytical skills to identify patterns in data and distinguish between theoretical risk and actual exploitability.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI-powered security tools or generative AI assistants to accelerate vulnerability triage, code analysis, or remediation guidance.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automation.</li> <li>Proficiency in using ticketing tools like JIRA for managing tickets and tasks.</li> <li>Experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into cybersecurity workflows and automation pipelines.</li> <li>Hands on experience with Infrastructure pentesting tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Foundations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h1><strong style="font-size: 14px;">An overview of this role</strong></h1> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.</p> <p>You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters.</li> <li>Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.</li> <li>Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.</li> <li>Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively.</li> <li>Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.</li> <li>Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.</li> <li>Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.</li> <li>Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.</li> <li>Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems.</li> <li>Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or  Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.</li> <li>Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers.</li> <li>The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward.</li> <li>Experience using security tooling for activities such as vulnerability triage and remediation, or professional experience building vulnerability management, dependency management, or related security products.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain.</li> <li>Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab.</p> <p>We work with clear goals and shared priorities. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon</p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical Support Engineer for Zero Trust </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, Cloudflare Tunnels, Cloudflare WAN and the Cloudflare One client (formerly known as Cloudflare WARP client).</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.</li> <li>Communicating and working directly with the customers via phone, video conference (ie Zoom, Google Meet), chat and tickets in Salesforce</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.</li> <li>Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.</li> <li>Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Availability to work the weekend shift (Saturday & Sunday)</li> <li>You have a minimum of 3 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IdP, IAM, SCIM) systems, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra, Ping, etc. Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC)</li> <li>Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience). This may also include specialized bootcamps. </li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.</li> <li>Experience with building projects on Cloudflare or using Cloudflare Products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Staff Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm. </p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.</p> <p>It's an opportunity to shape how a large-scale, increasingly AI-driven safety system is built, evaluated and improved.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design the end-to-end ML architecture for detection, risk scoring, routing and decision-making.</li> <li>Develop cost-efficient, layered inference strategies that combine broad, low-latency screening with deeper, more expensive analysis where it adds the most value.</li> <li>Establish approaches to continuous risk assessment across the member lifecycle, from registration and listing creation to ongoing activity.</li> <li>Define how we measure end-to-end detection effectiveness, including precision, coverage, missed harm and computational cost. Use these measurements to identify the highest-impact improvements.</li> <li>Turn siloed, team-level models into a coherent, calibrated detection system by addressing the technical and organisational barriers that lead to local optimisation.</li> <li>Identify and close detection coverage gaps, ensuring that relevant signals and outcomes are available for evaluation, diagnosis and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Set shared technical standards and architectural direction across teams, working with engineering and data science leaders to translate them into production systems.</li> <li>Prototype critical components, test architectural assumptions empirically and build reference implementations that teams can scale.</li> <li>Explain complex ML trade-offs to senior technical and business leaders as clear choices about harm reduction, cost, and engineering investment.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Have 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a similar role, including significant time owning production models or model evaluation at scale.</li> <li>Have led cross-team technical work without formal authority, and you're comfortable setting standards that other teams adopt.</li> <li>Have deep expertise in statistical inference and experimentation: A/B testing, measuring precision and recall under imperfect or biased labels, sampling for ground truth, and causal reasoning.</li> <li>Understand the ML lifecycle in production: evaluation, threshold setting, retraining, drift, feature stores and monitoring.</li> <li>Have hands-on experience evaluating LLM-based systems, or a strong interest in building rigorous methods for them.</li> <li>Are highly proficient in SQL and Python and comfortable working in a modern data stack (e.g. BigQuery, dbt).</li> <li>Can turn messy, cross-system problems into a clear plan, and can explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.</li> <li>Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.</li> <li>Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, content moderation, or risk management.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy </strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€107.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€144.800 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
