Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX | Seattle, WA | Denver, CO</p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, acting as a strategic partner to the global Sales organization. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. structure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Treasury team on the company’s broader capital markets strategy, including debt, convertible, and other structured transactions, and lessors, infrastructure investors, and OEM/vendor finance teams.</li> <li>Monitor market conditions, pricing, and emerging financing structures, and bring new ideas to leadership.</li> </ul> — models, trackers, and workflows that let a small team operate with speed and accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of experience</strong> across structured or project finance, infrastructure investing, private credit, equipment leasing, private equity, investment banking, and/or corporate capital markets — company credibly with senior external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>Deep structuring expertise</strong> — e.g., equipment finance, leasing and sale-leaseback, asset-backed and project finance, vendor financing, and debt or convertible capital markets — plus creativity in designing new structures to meet company goals.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling, credit analysis, and transaction documentation skills</strong>, including familiarity with credit agreements, master lease agreements, and related legal documentation.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of the accounting and tax implications</strong> of financing structures, and comfort partnering with Accounting, Tax, and Legal to get them right.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong>, with the ability to make complex structures legible to non-specialist leadership and to influence diverse stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with ambiguity</strong> — the ability to drive clarity, manage competing priorities, and execute at a high bar in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly company.</li> <li><strong>Sector background</strong> in data centers, digital infrastructure, telecom, cloud, or AI compute preferred; existing relationships with lenders, lessors, and infrastructure description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London or Lisbon</strong></p> <h2>About the Department</h2> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We are building tools that help make the new internet <strong>payable</strong> by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We’re looking for someone excited to deliver products so domain owners can control this experience, while identifying the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across Agentic Commerce.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power machine-to-machine payments and monetization, such as our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/monetization-gateway/">Monetization Gateway</a>. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around payment rails and cryptographic auth, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.</p> <p>At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across high-throughput payment pipelines, agent authentication, and web-scale commerce architecture.</li> <li>Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.</li> <li>Lead the development of agentic payment systems leveraging emerging open standards (x402, Web Bot Auth, ACP, UCP) to enable low-latency, machine-to-machine micropayments.</li> <li>Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.</li> <li>Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails.</li> <li>Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.</li> <li>Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.</li> </ul> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <p>We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in distributed systems or payment platforms, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.</li> <li>You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (like digital wallets, payment protocols, and web authorization) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <h2>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, low-latency transaction processing, API design, web security, or adjacent areas.</li> <li>Experience building or operating products involving traditional payment rails, digital wallets, or open authorization/authentication standards (e.g., OAuth, WebAuthn, Web Bot Auth).</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with emerging agentic/machine-to-machine payment protocols (x402, AP2, ACP, UCP).</li> <li>Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.</li> <li>Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.</li> <li>Previous experience working in payments and on payments technology</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Hiring Locations: <strong>Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Singapore</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p><strong>About This Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of public sector and enterprise accounts in the <strong>Philippines market</strong>. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.  </li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines</strong></li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

high-volume recurring billing, usage-based consumption models, and multi-entity global consolidations.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Security, Compliance, & Data Governance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner readiness for all financial records and ASC 606 reporting.</li> <li>Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process maps, and business continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical financial systems.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Minimum Experience:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, or a experience configuring, administrating, and developing in applications like <strong>NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, and Oracle Fusion Cloud (specifically O2C and R2R/GL modules)</strong>.</li> ecosystems. economic advantages of our approach.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,2,0">Collaborate with Sales and Developer GTM leadership to build repeatable qualification frameworks and deal structures for inference revenue.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market Intelligence & Cross-Functional Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,0,0">Serve as Cloudflare's primary listener and synthesizer for evolve.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. economics, GPU capacity dynamics, and ecosystem players.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Analytical Aptitude:</strong> Ability to prospective partners.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Adaptability:</strong> Comfort navigating fast-evolving markets, making You will own the strategy that scales our connectivity with the largest ISPs and eyeball networks in the U.S. while solving the harder, less-charted problem of building resilient, cost-effective network reach across South America.</p> <p>This role operates on an AI-first model. You won't just consume reports — you'll use AI agents and tooling to analyze traffic, model capacity and cost scenarios, surface peering and transport opportunities, and automate the operational work that historically slowed interconnection teams down. AI is the force-multiplier that lets a single strategist see the whole region clearly and act on it quickly, shifting your time from reactive task processing to proactive architecture. The decisions you make will directly shape Cloudflare's standing as the network leader across the Americas.</p> <p>You will work in close partnership with the Regional Network Acquisition Manager, who executes high-volume sourcing, contract lifecycle, and vendor management under your strategic direction — freeing you to lead the complex, high-stakes work.</p> <h4>What You'll Do / Responsibilities</h4> <p><strong>Regional Network Strategy — Americas</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute the interconnection and backbone strategy for the Americas, balancing the distinct realities of the U.S. and South American markets.</li> <li><strong>United States:</strong> Drive interconnection scale and depth with the largest U.S. ISPs and eyeball networks (e.g., Comcast, Charter, AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile), expanding private interconnect, peering, and capacity to keep pace with traffic growth.</li> <li><strong>South America:</strong> Solve the region's unique build challenges — a sparse and uneven IXP fabric, terrestrial and subsea transport economics, regulatory and market fragmentation, and heavy reliance on local partners — to establish durable, performant reach (with particular focus on Brazil, the region's largest market).</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-First Operating Model</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use AI-driven analytics to interpret regional traffic patterns, peering opportunities, and performance/cost trade-offs, and to inform interconnection and capacity decisions.</li> <li>Leverage and help shape automated, agentic workflows for LOAs, ticketing, contract tracking, and data hygiene — partnering with the support layer to push routine execution to automation.</li> <li>Build models and scenario analyses (capacity, cost, resiliency) that let you make faster, better-evidenced strategic calls and clearly defend them to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interconnection & Backbone Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Formulate and execute plans to optimize traffic flow across the region, balancing backbone, partner, transit, IX, and peer connections.</li> <li>Develop and execute strategies for the expansion, optimization, and maintenance of Cloudflare's backbone across the Americas, planning capacity for scalability and high performance.</li> <li>Lead negotiations for high-value, complex interconnection agreements and Tier-1 partnerships.</li> <li>Advise budget planning cycles to ensure proper resource allocation for regional growth and scaling.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partnership with the Regional Network Acquisition Manager</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the strategy and priorities the Network Acquisition Manager executes against; review and approve sourcing recommendations for new and existing transport services.</li> <li>Lead complex, high-value negotiations directly, while the Acquisition Manager runs high-volume requirements, contract lifecycle support, inventory, and first-level billing response.</li> <li>Ensure a clean handoff model so strategic intent translates into reliable, well-documented execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with ISPs, IXPs, carriers, and partners across the Americas.</li> <li>Act as the regional expert for interconnection relationships, focused on availability, capacity, effectiveness, and cost efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Data Center Strategy, Network Engineering, Capacity Planning, and Infrastructure Operations to align on network strategy and implementation.</li> <li>Engage internal stakeholders to plan requirements and deliver cross-functional projects, communicating clearly throughout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Industry Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent Cloudflare in regional and global industry forums and conferences, contributing to best practices and standards.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, ideally within a Telco, ISP, CDN, or cloud environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of networking protocols and technologies, including BGP, DWDM, and IP networking.</li> <li>Proven experience negotiating and managing interconnection agreements.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the Americas connectivity landscape — the U.S. wholesale/peering market and the transport, IXP, and partner dynamics of South America (including subsea and terrestrial considerations).</li> <li>Fluency with AI tools in daily work, and a genuine appetite to use AI/agentic tooling to scale decision-making and eliminate manual toil.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.</li> <li>Experience with capacity planning, cost modeling, and operations research.</li> </ul> <h4>Bonus Points</h4> <ul> <li>Professional proficiency in <strong>Spanish and/or Portuguese</strong>, to support relationship-building and network expansion across South America.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building or scaling network presence in emerging or infrastructure-constrained markets.</li> <li>Experience designing AI-assisted analytics or automation for network/commercial operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $207,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $143,000 - $197,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $143,000 - $197,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Sydney</strong>, <strong>Australia</strong></p> <p><strong>What you will do as a Manager, Customer Engineering</strong></p> <p>The Manager, Customer Engineering leads a team of Customer Engineers (CE) who own the full customer technical journey from initial discovery through long-term adoption, retention, and account expansion.</p> <p>Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Senior Leader, you will be responsible for building, coaching, and enabling a high-performing team of quota-carrying technologists. Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining technical talent. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York City, NY | San Francisco, CA</strong></h3> <h3 data-path-to-node="2">About AI Gateway</h3> <p data-path-to-node="3">AI inference is becoming core infrastructure. Every serious application will need access to many models across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare's bet that this layer belongs at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Developers using AI Gateway need answers to two questions. Is the model I'm calling working the way you say it does? And which model should I be using at all? You'll lead the models team that answers both.</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">You'll start with model operations. That's the work behind every model in the catalog: provider integrations, capability testing, pricing and metering, capacity, security reviews, docs, health, and deprecations. Sometimes a launch needs to go live within minutes of a lab's announcement. Sometimes the right call is to hold it. Cloudflare is an infrastructure company at heart, so reliability and accuracy come first; speed comes from preparation and automation.</p> <p data-path-to-node="6">Then you'll bring model intelligence online. That means turning what we learn from Gateway traffic into decisions for customers: capability maps, per-task rankings, auto-routing profiles that pick the right model for each request, evals and regression detection, and market intelligence developers can trust.</p> <p data-path-to-node="7">This is a people-management role reporting to the AI Gateway Engineering Manager. You'll hire, develop, and lead the team, and you'll stay hands-on: writing code, building agent-driven workflows, and getting into the details of a failed launch or a suspicious eval SLO. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers approximately 25 million Internet properties, for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us! </p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Delivering this platform with high performance and efficiency depends on advanced Linux kernel and hardware capabilities, and that is where this team works.</p> <p>The Performance Team owns overall system and application performance across that fleet: resource optimization, instrumentation, and the tooling that lets us see what the hardware is actually doing. System memory sits alongside CPU cycles, network processing, and storage IOPS as a first-class resource, and how the kernel manages it is increasingly the thing that decides how hot we can safely run every machine we own.</p> <p>We work upstream first. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. We are looking for an expert to take on these problems, fix them against production workloads, and drive the changes upstream. Solving them lifts efficiency and latency across the entire fleet rather than in one place.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Diagnose and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem, informed by real production telemetry at a scale few environments can offer.</li> <li>Land your work upstream. As part of our explosive growth, we are looking for a Principal, Customer Strategy & Storytelling to establish, scale, and architect the stories we tell about the Developer Platform inside and outside the company.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, foundational individual contributor role within Developer GTM. You will unearth compelling customer transformations, translate complex technical breakthroughs into magnetic narratives, and architect programs that showcase the value of Cloudflare’s developer platform and AI infrastructure to both internal teams and the global ecosystem. As an early member of this team, you will have the autonomy to experiment, to learn what resonates, and to establish scalable operating rhythms and success metrics. Your work will showcase the value of Cloudflare's developer platform and AI infrastructure both internally and to the global ecosystem.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Narrative Creation: </strong>Identify and develop compelling customer stories demonstrating how Cloudflare’s Developer Platform delivers transformational, measurable outcomes for cutting-edge startups and global enterprises. Build repeatable frameworks for customer identification and story development.Marketing Partnership: Partner with Marketing to bring customer stories to life through long form content, campaign materials, thought leadership, executive presentations, and novel channels.</li> <li><strong>Sales & Partner Enablement: </strong>Create the first draft of robust enablement assets for technical sales organizations, sellers, and partner networks. Once we see that our stories equip teams to accelerate sales, you will hand off and support.</li> <li><strong>Bridging Audiences</strong>: Showcase our best technical wins authentically to developer communities while simultaneously translating those into narratives for commercial impact for enterprise buyers and executives.</li> <li><strong>Advocacy & Ecosystem Building</strong>: Cultivate trusted relationships with strategic customers, executive sponsors, and account teams to build a thriving network of customer champions who amplify Cloudflare's product story.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Insights</strong>: Surface emerging customer use cases, customer trends, and strategic insights to inform business strategy.</li> <li><strong>Impact & Measurement: </strong>Measure program effectiveness through customer advocacy participation, storytelling adoption, and commercial impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <p>First 30 days:<br>Establish key relationships, consume an inordinate amount of content about our customers and existing stories, identify a few priority narratives. You’ve shipped your first customer story.</p> <p>First 6 months:<br>Translate and distribute your first stories across internal and external channels. Launch a repeatable customer storytelling motion across DevGTM, including the cross-functional processes for identification and engaging account teams. We are hitting a new level of narrative (this is not a case study factory) and telling the story in novel ways. You’ve shipped a way for customer stories to be easier to find for our field teams, and they hit their goals faster because of it. </p> <p>First year:<br>Build a scalable customer engagement and storytelling capability that is measurably supporting Dev GTM’s growth. Your partnership is sought after, because it has created such compelling narratives through our field teams, owned channels, and executive voices that our program makes waves in the AI ecosystem. </p> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer Experience</strong>: 8-10 Years Experience in Customer Success, Customer Strategy, Strategic Account Management, or Customer Marketing.</li> <li><strong>Customer Presence.</strong> Excellent internal and external relationship building and stakeholder management.</li> <li><strong>Program Builder. </strong>Demonstrated experience working cross functionally to deliver results. Proven success building new programs and processes in fast-growing organizations.</li> <li><strong>Technical Fluency: </strong>5+ Years experience working on developer-first products with a highly technical customer base. programs, including All Hands and Leadership Unplugged, from content development and stakeholder coordination through delivery and follow-up.</li> <li>Partner with executive stakeholders and content owners to ensure messaging is relevant, engaging, and aligned with GTM priorities.</li> <li>Ensure communications are accurate, timely, and appropriate for their intended audiences.</li> <li>Continuously improve how information reaches the field, reducing unnecessary noise while making important updates easier to find and act on.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Field Advisory Board (FAB) Program Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own and continuously improve Cloudflare's global Field Advisory Board (FAB) program, ensuring it serves as a meaningful two-way feedback channel between field teams and GTM leadership.</li> <li>Manage the Americas and International boards, including member engagement, quarterly meetings, agendas, executive participation, and follow-through on commitments.</li> <li>Partner with Sales, Product, Enablement, Revenue Operations, and other teams to turn field feedback into actionable recommendations and improvements.</li> <li>Identify recurring themes, challenges, and opportunities from the field, and bring forward insights that help inform GTM priorities and decisions.</li> <li>Strengthen the program's effectiveness by improving how feedback is collected, prioritized, communicated, and acted upon.</li> <li>Ensure FAB members see tangible outcomes from their input, building trust and sustained engagement in the program.</li> ensure commitments are delivered.</li> <li>Identify risks and dependencies early, recommend solutions, and escalate when necessary.</li> <li>Build strong relationships across the organization and influence outcomes without formal authority.</li> <li>Step into ambiguous or urgent situations and bring structure, clarity, and momentum.</li> <li>Balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while keeping the broader GTM organization's priorities in focus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operational Excellence & Scale</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary work, and improve how the GTM organization operates.</li> <li>Leverage AI, automation, and internal tools to reduce manual effort and improve execution.</li> <li>Create lightweight systems for tracking priorities, decisions, and follow-through.</li> <li>Establish practical quality-control processes to ensure work is accurate and complete before delivery.</li> <li>Continuously improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of work coming out of the Office of the President of Revenue.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in details.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, concise, executive-ready materials.</li> <li>Excellent judgment and the confidence to make recommendations, challenge assumptions, and know when to escalate.</li> <li>A proactive mindset. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin or London</strong></p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-AbouttheRole">About the Role</h3> <p>TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.</p> <p>That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. </p> <p>Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.</p> <p>As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.</p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-Responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business</strong> across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.</li> <li><strong>Build for the whole Internet</strong> by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.</li> <li><strong>Make resilience a product principle.</strong> Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.</li> <li><strong>Drive an ACME-first customer experience</strong> that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with engineering</strong> on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.</li> <li><strong>Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations</strong> to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.</li> <li><strong>Own go-to-market strategy</strong> including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.</li> <li><strong>Represent the customer and the ecosystem</strong> in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.</li> <li><strong>Work across Cloudflare product teams</strong> including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.</li> <li><strong>Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero</strong> by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-DesirableSkills,KnowledgeandExperience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of product management experience</strong> building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.</li> <li><strong>Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products</strong> where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management</strong> including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.</li> <li><strong>Strong business judgment</strong> with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.</li> <li><strong>Ability to operate in ambiguity</strong> and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.</li> <li><strong>Technical fluency with engineering teams</strong> and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>Strong written communication</strong> for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.</li> <li>Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.</li> <li>Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.</li> <li>Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.</li> lifetimes.</li> <li>Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility, Merkle Tree Certificates, or customer migration planning for cryptographic transitions.</li> <li>Prior participation in WebPKI, IETF, browser trust, transparency, or security standards communities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Available Terms</strong></p> <ul> <li>Summer (May - September 2027)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Every product decision we make directly impacts the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, and mobile apps) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world, spanning over 330 cities in more than 125 countries, and operating within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300 to 400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Product Management team defines the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the features that power this massive global footprint. Product Managers bridge the gap between user needs, technical feasibility, and business impact by working directly with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to solve complex problems at scale. Whether defining APIs, shaping control plane workflows, or launching new security and performance features, our PMs turn ambitious ideas into intuitive products.</p> <p>The ideal Product Manager Intern is curious, user-focused, and passionate about making the Internet a better place. You won't just shadow team members; you will own product initiatives, gather customer insights, define requirements, and collaborate closely with experienced engineers and designers to ship real features that reach millions of people worldwide. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are proactive, analytical, and eager to drive projects from concept to launch. This is a unique opportunity for aspiring PMs to learn how to manage and scale products at Internet scale.</p> <p>You can check out our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/internship-experience/">internship blogs</a> to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>As a Product Manager Intern, you will be the voice of the user. You will own a project focused on improving our products, enhancing the user experience, and driving the development of key features. Your responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Define the Future:</strong> Conduct user research and competitive analysis to understand user needs and market trends. You will identify pain points and uncover opportunities to make our tools best-in-class.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate to Build:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with engineering, design, and product leaders to bring your vision to life, ensuring features are built to spec, meet user expectations, and solve hard technical problems at scale.</li> <li><strong>Drive for Impact:</strong> Help define success metrics and ensure the features you launch are not only technically sound, but also drive measurable business value and solve real-world problems for our users.</li> <li><strong>Solve Complex Problems:</strong> Proactively analyze challenges, balance technical feasibility with user needs, and turn market constraints into opportunities for innovation and growth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing a degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Business, Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>A strong passion for technology and a deep empathy for user needs.</li> <li>Technical literacy, with the ability to understand architectural concepts and empathize with developer workflows.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>A self-starter mindset that thrives in ambiguity and takes initiative.</li> <li>Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week) 12-week internship.</li> <li>In-office expectation of 3–5 days per week in London, UK.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with networking, security, or Zero Trust concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with developer tools, APIs, or personal projects using Cloudflare products (such as <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/students/">Cloudflare for Students</a>).</li> <li>Previous experience writing product specifications, building wireframes, or conducting user research.</li> <li>Basic coding ability or familiarity with command-line tools and developer workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please Note:</strong></p> <ul> <li>We hire interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.</li> <li>We are not considering remote or part-time applicants. You should not be enrolled in conflicting classes during the internship term.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. cross-functional teammates.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI Innovation & Process Automation</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Automate Operational Workflows:</strong> Identify manual, repetitive tasks across BOM reviews, reporting, and partner tracking, using AI tools and LLM prompt engineering to streamline processes.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Analyze Performance Data:</strong> Evaluate spend, build timelines, and quality trends using AI-assisted analysis tools to surface actionable operational insights.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build Shared Tooling:</strong> Develop, document, and maintain sustainable, lightweight automation scripts and workflows for adoption across the broader team.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> server hardware, firmware) to ensure manufacturing compliance.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Program Management Discipline:</strong> Hands-on experience managing operational workflows in Jira, with a track record of tracking and reporting on team KPIs and SLAs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Applied AI & Automation Skills:</strong> Practical experience using AI tools or LLMs to automate concrete workflows, optimize reporting, or perform data analysis.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across engineering, procurement, supply chain, and external partner teams.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable / Bonus Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Background in data center infrastructure hardware (servers, network switches, rPDUs, enterprise cabling).</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience writing lightweight scripts (Python, Google Apps Script, or similar) paired with AI developer tools.</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with global hardware supply chain and logistics operations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Oracle ERP Cloud (e.g., SCM, Procurement, Inventory Management) or comparable ERP platforms such as SAP or NetSuite, particularly for BOM management, purchase orders, and materials tracking.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> We are looking for a senior technical architect to help define the systems, protocols, and security architecture behind it.</p> <p>This role spans applied cryptography, Web PKI, distributed systems, security engineering, compliance, and Internet standards. It will help Cloudflare build a CA that operates safely at Internet scale while establishing a credible path from today's X.509 ecosystem toward post-quantum authentication using Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs).</p> <h2>Mission</h2> <p>Define and guide the end-to-end architecture of Cloudflare's public Certificate Authority: a high-assurance, highly available system capable of issuing conventional publicly trusted certificates at Cloudflare scale while supporting Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs) and the evolution toward a post-quantum Web PKI.</p> <p>You will help determine not only how the CA is implemented, but also its trust boundaries, key hierarchy, issuance architecture, auditability, failure modes, incident response mechanisms, and long-term cryptographic evolution.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Define and maintain the end-to-end technical architecture of Cloudflare's public CA across certificate issuance, key management, transparency, revocation, renewal, and relying-party integration.</li> <li>Design root and intermediate CA trust hierarchies, signing systems, HSM integration, key ceremonies, key rotation, backup, recovery, migration, and key-compromise response.</li> <li>Architect secure, resilient, and highly available issuance services capable of operating at Internet scale and across multiple geographic and failure domains.</li> <li>Design certificate lifecycle systems around ACME, domain and IP validation, CAA, Certificate Transparency, pre-issuance linting, revocation, renewal, and large-scale certificate replacement.</li> <li>Integrate Cloudflare’s MTC infrastructure, including CA logs, landmarks,, cosigning or mirroring, and interactions with relying parties.</li> <li>Develop practical architectures for coexistence and migration between classical X.509 certificates and post-quantum authentication mechanisms.</li> <li>Define trust boundaries, security properties, and threat models covering key compromise, unauthorized issuance, software supply-chain compromise, operator error, malicious insiders, infrastructure failure, split views, and cryptographic migration.</li> <li>Design systems that make CA behavior observable and independently verifiable through transparency mechanisms, reproducible builds, cryptographic attestations, public operational telemetry, tamper-evident evidence, and audit controls.</li> <li>Design failure containment and recovery mechanisms that support safe certificate replacement, revocation, key rotation, and incident response without creating avoidable Internet availability failures.</li> <li>Translate CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser and operating-system root-program policies, audit criteria, and certification requirements into concrete technical and operational controls.</li> <li>Review protocols, architecture, and implementations with an adversarial mindset, identifying assumptions and failure modes that do not hold at Internet scale.</li> <li>Work closely with Cloudflare's cryptography, TLS, security, networking, infrastructure, compliance, product, and operations teams.</li> <li>Provide architectural direction, design review, and technical mentorship to engineers implementing and operating the CA platform.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in relevant standards and industry work, collaborating with browser vendors, root programs, researchers, auditors, CA operators, and the wider Web PKI community.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience designing or operating security-critical systems, with deep expertise in at least one of: public Certificate Authorities, Web PKI, applied cryptography, TLS and Internet security protocols, Certificate Transparency, hardware-backed key management, or large-scale distributed security systems.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of certificate trust chains, issuance and validation, revocation, key lifecycle management, and the security and availability implications of CA design decisions.</li> <li>Experience defining system trust boundaries, threat models, security invariants, and failure-handling strategies.</li> <li>Ability to reason about systems in which a subtle architectural or operational mistake can affect a significant fraction of the Internet.</li> <li>Experience leading architecture across multiple engineering teams without relying solely on organizational authority.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain cryptographic and architectural tradeoffs to engineers, auditors, standards participants, and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfort operating with substantial autonomy in an evolving technical and policy environment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Bring new ideas to the program and pilot them with a bias toward practical impact, across all engagement formats and channels.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Stakeholder Influence: </strong>5–8 years of proven ability to build trust across Sales, executive leadership, and cross-functional partners, aligning priorities, and moving people toward shared outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strategic problem solver: </strong>You can quickly understand complex business problems, structure ambiguous questions, synthesize next steps, and identify the highest leverage path forward. You are comfortable moving between strategy, operations, content, and execution. </li> <li><strong>Facilitation & Executive presence: </strong>Strong communication and storytelling skills with the presence and confidence to guide a room of senior leaders through a structured conversation.</li> <li><strong>Customer-first, consultative mindset: You are skilled at uncovering what customers actually care about, not just what they say in the first meeting.
