title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Locations: Austin, Lisbon, San Francisco, NYC, or London</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/agentic-web/">more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated</a>. Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet.</p> <p>Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web.</p> <p><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/">AI Search</a> (internal data), <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ai-search-ga/">now generally available</a>, is the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ai-search-agent-primitive/">search primitive for applications and agents</a>. It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/">Workers AI</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/">Vectorize</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/">R2</a>, and <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-run/">Browser Run</a>. Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs.</p> <p><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-search/">Web Search API</a> (external data), <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/changelog/post/2026-10-02-introducing-web-search-api/">now in open beta</a>, gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/">AI Gateway</a>, so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls as model inference. Developers can choose from <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-search/providers/">multiple search providers</a> and always get results back in one normalized format.</p> <p>Your mission in this role is to make Cloudflare the default place developers and agents go to search, across both their own data and the open web, and eventually in a single call. You’ll also help build a search ecosystem that works for AI companies, site owners, and creators alike.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Talk directly with developers, AI companies, publishers, and customers every day.</li> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Agentic Search (AI Search and Web Search API), from ingestion and indexing through retrieval, ranking, and answer generation.</li> <li>Define and measure what “good search” means, including relevance, freshness, latency, and cost, and build the evals that improve it with every release.</li> <li>Scale AI Search for the workloads that matter most, like multi-tenant platforms, enterprise agents, and website search, with support for billions of documents, rich media, and built-in observability.</li> <li>Take Web Search API and shape what comes next: provider partnerships, search and page extraction in one call, blending web and private data,</li> <li>Own pricing and packaging, and make our products first-class for agents through MCP, agent-friendly APIs, and templates like <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-search/how-to/nlweb/">NLWeb</a>.</li> <li>Partner with engineering, ML, and product teams across <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/">Workers AI</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/">Vectorize</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/">AI Gateway</a>, <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/browser-run/">Browser Run</a>, and <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-crawl-control/">AI Crawl Control</a>, as well as Marketing, DevRel, BD, Sales, and Support.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare at conferences, community events, and customer and partner meetings.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience as a PM, EM, or founder shipping search, information retrieval, data infrastructure, or developer platform products. You’ve led teams to ship before and can point to impact.</li> <li>Deep understanding of how search works end to end: crawling, indexing, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector), query rewriting, reranking, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). You understand the tradeoffs between relevance, freshness, latency, and cost.</li> <li>Experience defining and measuring search quality, including offline evals, relevance judgments, metrics like recall, MRR, and NDCG, and online experimentation.</li> <li>Fluency in the modern AI ecosystem: LLMs, text and multimodal embedding models, agents, tool calling, and MCP. You’ve built with them yourself and know where they break.</li> <li>Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast. You’ve built a RAG pipeline or an agent that searches the web, and you have opinions about what made it good or bad.</li> <li>Deep empathy for developers and understanding of their workflows, pain points, and how they adopt new tools and platforms.</li> <li>Understanding of the web publishing ecosystem: crawlers, bots, SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO), and the changing economics of AI search for content creators. Comfortable working where technology, business, and policy meet.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based pricing, two-sided marketplaces, or partner and business development relationships, including build-vs-partner decisions, is a plus.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and collaboration skills. You can translate between ML research, infrastructure engineering, and business stakeholders, and align diverse teams on goals.</li> <li>Passion for design details and polish. You raise the bar for sweating the details.</li> <li>External presentation skills. You can walk into a room of developers or AI company leaders and build trust and credibility.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Seattle/NYC/California based hires - Estimated annual salary of: €68,000 - €85,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.</p> <h1>Responsibilities</h1> <h2>Product strategy and roadmap</h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.</li> <li>Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.</li> <li>Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.</li> <li>Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.</li> <li>Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.</li> <li>Partner with the Cloudflare Security Research team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Security provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.</li> <li>Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.</li> <li>Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Customer experience</h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation</li> <li>Ensure customers can understand what protections they have, what events mean, and what action to take.</li> <li>Establish feedback loops with Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and customers. technical posts, customer guidance, and product communications for security researchers, customers, press, and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in the broader security community, at conferences, and online as a product and technical spokesperson for Managed Rules and HTTP application vulnerabilities</li> </ul> <h2>Skills Required </h2> <ul> <li>Strong product-management experience, including strategy, roadmap ownership, discovery, prioritization, and cross-functional delivery.</li> <li>Technical fluency to understand HTTP applications, vulnerabilities, exploits, and detection systems.</li> <li>Ability to synthesize input from security research, engineers, customers, and commercial teams into clear product decisions.</li> <li>Customer empathy and strong product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous security environment.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across Cloudflare Security Research, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Communications, and other product teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Security research, exploit-development, or detection-engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience with WAFs, managed rules, security-rule rollout, false-positive management, application security, threat intelligence, security operations or vulnerability management.</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise security operations, including APIs, automation, auditability, policy controls, logs, and SIEM integrations.</li> <li>Experience with code scanning, software supply-chain security, or exposure discovery.</li> <li>An established presence in the security research community, conference speaking, technical writing, or press engagement.</li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Lisbon </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of 65,000 - 80,000 EURO</li> <li>For <strong>New York City </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $216,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, Texas; Lisbon, Portugal; London, UK </strong></p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>The Network Platforms team was formed to build and extend network software infrastructure responsible for delivery of traffic through critical paths of Cloudflare's global network. These systems directly impact traffic across Cloudflare's network infrastructure, across numerous products and millions of customers. They are key to Cloudflare's mission to make the internet faster, safer, and more reliable.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <p>As a member of the team you will build and extend various software systems that carry traffic on critical paths of Cloudflare's network: from the host server linux kernel, to the network hardware dataplane, to the physical interconnect at an adjacent network. You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will collaborate with engineers across the company, from operations teams to the teams building customer-facing products, ensuring these capabilities match business needs.</p> <p>Our team at Cloudflare operates under a "Run What You Build" model. This means we are responsible for the health of our systems and actively participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of our operational duties.</p> <h3><strong>What we are looking for</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for smart, innovative team players that have experience in covering Linux kernel network stack development (particularly with eBPF), complex distributed systems, and understanding of internet protocols and technologies. As you’ll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.</p> <h4><strong>Role requirements</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Systems-level programming experience in Go, Python, Rust, C, or C++</li> <li>A solid grasp of BGP and internet routing</li> <li>Relish opportunities to dive into new technologies, and a demonstrated ability to do so</li> <li>Experience in implementing, deploying, and debugging mission-critical distributed systems</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills</li> <li>Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your engineering workflow</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Familiarity vendor switching SDKs</li> <li>Familiarity with SR-MPLS and sFlow, BGP-LS & PCE protocols</li> <li>Experience writing packet-processing software (eg, eBPF at TC or XDP, DPDK)</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code completion, codebase analysis, log/data exploration) in a professional setting</li> <li>Experience participating in an on-call rotation</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €68,000-91,000€,</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Every serious application will need access to many models, across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare’s bet that this layer should exist at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to help build that layer. This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role for someone who can move from a half-formed product idea to a working, production-ready system quickly. You will work across the stack — from distributed systems and high-throughput APIs to developer-facing workflows, dashboards, SDKs, and docs — helping define how developers build and operate AI applications on Cloudflare.</p> <p>You should be excited by the current pace of the AI ecosystem. Provider APIs change weekly, new models appear constantly, and developer expectations are rising just as quickly. AI Gateway needs engineers who can build durable infrastructure in that environment without slowing down.</p> <p>We also believe AI should change how we build software, not just what we build. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Dubai, UAE<br></strong></h3> <hr> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and Senior Territory Account Executive<strong> </strong>to join our Sales team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As a Senior Territory Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.<br><br><strong>Regional Focus: Oman</strong></p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:  Austin or London (Hybrid) </strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We're hiring the first Dashboard & Configuration Product Manager Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own.</p> <p>Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. Your job is to make that kind of reasoning legible and controllable to the people who rely on it, from the security analyst running an investigation to the marketing team trying to understand the performance of their most recent campaign.</p> <p>This role spans the full arc of how customers work with our product suite, from navigation, configuration, exploring and investigating their traffic, to proving the value of what Cloudflare's network sees. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. This role will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line</p> <p>This is a rare "0-to-1" seat: you'll help define the interaction model for a suite of product categories we are largely inventing, with room to shape not just how it looks but what it fundamentally is.</p> <h3>Who you are</h3> <p>Note: A portfolio is not required for this role, but is a bonus. Please include a link to work that shows how you think. The interview process will dive in deeper.</p> <ul> <li>A product inventor who works in the medium of design, presenting complex problems to Enterprise customers. You've taken genuinely ambiguous, ill-defined problem spaces and defined what the product should be. You can point to work where the concept was yours.</li> <li>You've had to make a complex, high-dimensional system legible to the people who live in it, whether in security, fraud, observability, developer tools, analytics, network operations, finance, or somewhere equally demanding. You don't need a security background, but you need the mind and craft to go deep in one fast.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in your own craft, and you have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You bring independent design conviction. You've originated solutions in spaces with little prior art, and you can clearly articulate why a design is right, or why you're pushing back.</li> <li>Exceptional at the full craft — defining the problem, defining the experience requirements, information architecture, and especially data visualization — with enough polish to make it real and compelling.</li> <li>Someone who wants to obsess over a domain. You want to go deep, and are excited about pushing boundaries in a complex space.</li> <li>Comfortable with a blank page. As the first design lead, you'll set your own process and build alongside your peers and engineers.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience as the first or founding product manager or We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong title: Workplace Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Places Team</strong> at Cloudflare is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic <strong>Workplace Operations Manager</strong> to lead and elevate the day-to-day operations of our Austin hub. In this role, you’ll be the go-to person for creating a smooth, welcoming, and highly functional workplace—partnering with global counterparts to share best practices and continuously enhance our spaces.</p> <p>You’ll gather feedback from employees and guests to shape how the hub evolves, contribute to future buildouts, and collaborate with teams across IT, Legal, Physical Security, EBC, and more. You're comfortable navigating fast-paced environments, solving problems on the fly, and thinking creatively about how to improve systems and experiences. With a hospitality mindset and strong communication skills, you take pride in delivering excellent service and building a space that reflects our culture and values.</p> <p>This role reports to the <strong>Regional Manager, Workplace Operations</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><em>Workplace Experience:</em></strong> Ensure our hub is a functional, inspiring space that reflects our culture and supports hybrid work. Act as the first point of contact for employee workplace needs, solving issues quickly and thoughtfully.</li> <li><strong><em>Stay Connected Across Channels:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Maintain clear, responsive communication with the local team across platforms like chat, email, and in-person touchpoints—ensuring everyone stays informed, supported, and aligned on workplace updates and needs.</li> <li><strong><em>Track and Report Workplace Metrics: </em></strong>Monitor key data points such as space utilization, occupancy, and service ticket volume to support data-driven decision-making and long-term planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Workplace Programs: </em></strong>Help drive local implementation of global workplace programs—from our food program (think snack stocking, team lunches, and special food moments) and sustainability initiatives to employee engagement efforts.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Internal Events & Experiences:</em></strong> Plan and execute a range of onsite events—including team onsites, in-person weeks, executive briefings, customer meetings, and cultural moments—both independently and in collaboration with the Global Events & Experiences team, ensuring each gathering is seamless, engaging, and reflective of our culture.</li> <li><strong><em>Safety & Compliance:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Partner with Security and Legal teams to maintain a safe and compliant workplace. Support emergency preparedness efforts, safety drills, and incident response protocols.</li> <li><strong><em>Scale Smartly</em></strong><strong>: </strong>As the hub grows, help onboard new team members, support hiring needs for workplace roles, and participate in long-term workplace planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support the Regional Places Team:</em></strong> Assist with administrative tasks such as responding to tickets, managing emails and inquiries, and providing holiday coverage to ensure seamless team operations across regions.</li> <li><strong><em>Lead Onsite Operations:</em></strong> Own the day-to-day management of the workplace—from front desk services, greeting guests/employees/visiting employees, and mail handling to office supplies, swag, deliveries, and space readiness. You’ll make sure everything flows, looks great, and feels seamless for employees and visitors alike.</li> <li><strong><em>Be the go-to for Vendors and Places Team:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Liaise with building management, building security, and external vendors (cleaning crews, caterers, property managers, etc.) to keep our operations running efficiently. Oversee vendor performance and contracts, lead RFPs when needed, and track workplace budgets responsibly.</li> <li><strong><em>Create a World-Class Environment:</em></strong> Champion an inspiring, inclusive, and vibrant office culture. Plan and execute engaging onsite events, team celebrations, catering, and daily amenities that make coming into the office exciting, productive, and memorable for our team.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Have 5+ years of experience leading workplace operations teams, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including 3+ years of people management experience.</li> <li>Are people-first and service-minded, with a friendly, professional presence that makes everyone feel welcome</li> <li>Know how to juggle vendors, projects, and priorities—and still sweat the small stuff</li> <li>Bring sharp budget management skills and make thoughtful, cost-effective decisions</li> <li>Communicate clearly and confidently across all levels and time zones using Google Workspace</li> <li>Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—you spot what needs doing before anyone else does</li> <li>Thrive in fast-moving environments, stay calm under pressure, and love finding creative solutions</li> <li>Have experience collaborating cross-functionally with teams like IT, Security, People Ops, and more</li> <li>Bring a hospitality mindset and a passion for building inspiring, functional spaces where people love to work</li> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday).</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen. Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn. Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst; Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; • Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; • Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; • Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; • Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; • Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; • Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; • Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening. Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is? We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen. • ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support; • prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen; • vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten; • richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening; • sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid; • onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen; • afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams; • samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren; • signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren; • richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur; • kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; • organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives. Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan. Wat bieden wij Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie. Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf. De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 10. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring ligt de salarisrange (schaal 10) tussen € 65.807 en € 94.551 bruto per jaar (op basis van een 38-urige werkweek inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning). De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje: • je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties; • 13e maand; • variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris; • arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd; • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek; • goede studiekostenregeling; • prima pensioenvoorziening; • reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding; • en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé. Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy. Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner. Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken. Overige informatie Enthousiast? title: Senior Scrum master
description: Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken. AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt. Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert. Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking. Jouw rol Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties. Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven. Maar je kijkt ook vooruit. Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen? Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. Wat ga je doen? Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders. Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren. Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren. Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie. Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling. Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen. Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling. PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering. Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering. Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels. Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré. Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen. Het team Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken. Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert. Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris; 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen; Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden; Goede pensioenregeling; Doorgroeimogelijkheden; Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team. title: Marketing & Communicatie Stage
description: MARKETING & COMMUNICATIE STAGE jan 2027 Afdeling: KEUNE Nederland & Vlaanderen, Marketing Ben jij altijd online en op de hoogte van de laatste haartrends? Vind je het leuk om te ondersteunen bij de organisatie en uitvoering van Events en PR? Als Marketing & Communicatie Stagiair(e) ondersteun je het Marketing team in hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden zoals het uitrollen van nieuwe campagnes, organiseren van Events en PR-activiteiten. Daarnaast heb je ook je eigen verantwoordelijkheden en zal je volledig meedraaien in het marketing team. Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner. Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus. title: Senior System Test & Validation Engineer
description: As a Senior System Test & Validation Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for defining and driving system-level verification and validation for complex multidisciplinary products. You develop a strong understanding of the product, customer use cases, system architecture, operating environment, and technical risks, and translate these into effective validation strategies, test setups, and test campaigns. The systems you validate combine sensing hardware, embedded software, Edge computing, networking, cloud software, data processing, algorithms, and customer-facing applications. Your role is therefore focused on validating the complete system and ensuring that critical customer workflows work reliably before release. You work closely with Product, Systems Engineering, Software, Embedded, Hardware, Algorithms, Operations, Manufacturing, and other IVVQ engineers. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role, combining system-level thinking, test design, technical investigation, and practical validation. Qualifications BSc or MSc in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Physics, or a related technical discipline. 7+ years of relevant experience in system testing, verification & validation, integration testing, or product qualification. Experience validating complex multidisciplinary products combining hardware and software. Strong understanding of system-level test strategy, risk-based testing, requirements verification, and product qualification. Experience translating requirements and customer use cases into practical validation approaches. Experience designing system test setups and representative test environments. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across subsystem boundaries. Working knowledge of Linux and networking. Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, and modern engineering workflows. Experience with requirements traceability and verification evidence. Strong communication skills in English and a collaborative working style. Eligible for required EU/NATO/security screening or clearance, where applicable. Nice to have Python experience for test automation, analysis, or tooling. Hardware-in-the-Loop or automated system-level testing experience. Experience with Edge systems, Docker, or cloud-connected products. Experience with environmental, reliability, lifetime, or mechanical testing. Experience with industrial sensing, condition monitoring, photonics, energy systems, or similar technologies. Experience with FAT, commissioning, or field validation. Experience with requirements-management tools such as Jira, Polarion. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Work on complex multidisciplinary products combining photonics, hardware, software, cloud, and algorithms. Shape how system-level validation is done within a growing R&D organization. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines. The Role As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life. You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product. Responsibilities Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation. Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product. Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible. Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records. Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development. Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability. Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness. Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements. Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities. Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications. Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution. Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges. Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture. What we offer Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups. Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success. A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities. A competitive salary and benefits package. 30 days of holiday per year. Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events. Requirements BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments. Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards. Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation. Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems. Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design. Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners. Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams. Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design. Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings. Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects. Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Specialist Cybersecurity
description: Ben jij een creatieve marketing specialist met ervaring in de IT en toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging? Bij Nomios werken we aan cybersecurity- en netwerkoplossingen voor organisaties in Nederland en ver daarbuiten. We groeien hard en zoeken een medior marketing specialist die ons team versterkt en onze zichtbaarheid vergroot. Je werkt veel samen met onze strategische vendoren, partners en de partner manager van Nomios. Samen bedenk je campagnes, rol je ze uit en laat je zien wat ze opleveren. Zo speel je een belangrijke rol in het aantrekken van nieuwe klanten en het versterken van ons partnerecosysteem. Kennis van cybersecurity is geen must; die bouw je bij ons snel op. Wat ga je doen? Als medior marketing specialist ga jij aan de slag met: Vendor- en partnermarketing Samen met onze strategische vendoren, partners en de partner manager van Nomios bedenk, ontwikkel en voer je gezamenlijke campagnes uit. Je beheert de marketingactiviteiten met onze vendoren op strategisch, tactisch en operationeel niveau, inclusief planning, marketingfondsen (MDF) en de bijbehorende administratie. Je rapporteert de resultaten van campagnes aan vendoren, partners en het managementteam en vertaalt die naar verbeteringen. Campagnes en performance marketing Je bedenkt en ontwikkelt digitale (ABM-)campagnes die onze doelgroep raken. Je beheert en optimaliseert onze Google Ads- en LinkedIn-campagnes. Content marketing Je bedenkt, creëert en publiceert artikelen, video's en andere content, samen met onze experts. Je optimaliseert bestaande content om vindbaarheid en relevantie te verbeteren. Social media Je werkt mee aan de langetermijnstrategie voor LinkedIn en nieuwe kanalen waar onze doelgroep te vinden is, met als doel meer awareness en groei van ons bereik. Event marketing Je bedenkt, organiseert en voert professionele evenementen uit samen met onze vendoren en partners, waar klanten graag naartoe komen. Marketing support Je ondersteunt het marketingteam bij digitale campagnes binnen de Nomios Groep en draagt bij aan de verbetering van onze website. title: Backend Engineer - Payments Team
description: Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on! Your role Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger. The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day. We encourage responsible AI usage and provide tooling like Claude Code, Codex, Dust . You’ll work closely with the other product teams, alongside fellow Backend Engineers, Data, Design, an Engineering Manager and a Product Manager in a Scrum setup. This role suits an engineer who enjoys a complex domain, cares about getting the details right, and wants to grow by taking real ownership of business-critical systems. Your overall responsibilities include Designing, developing, testing and reviewing reusable, maintainable and scalable code Working AI-first: using AI-augmented engineering, agentic workflows and AI tooling as a natural part of how you design, build, test and review, with judgement for where AI is a multiplier and where humans stay in the loop; Taking ownership from discovery to post-production; Taking operational responsibility for what you build, including monitoring, alerting and incident analysis; Helping improve engineering methodologies and best practices Who we are looking for In order to be successful in this role, you bring a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, proactive mindset. You enjoy working in a collaborative scale-up environment where things can change quickly and where taking initiative matters. Additionally, you tick the following boxes: You have 3+ years of professional backend experience, with strong hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience. You have previous experience in the payments domain. You have experience working in agile teams within an international, multicultural environment. You have experience building and operating microservices in production, using REST APIs, cloud platforms and relational databases. You are familiar with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka. You care about reliability, maintainability and the operational impact of the software you build. You spot opportunities and problems and pick them up yourself instead of waiting for a ticket. You use AI tooling as part of your engineering workflow, with sound engineering judgement. You are fluent in English and have an affinity with Fastned’s mission. Nice to have Experience in e-mobility, energy, charging infrastructure or another operationally complex domain. Join us in building a better future We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We focus on work-life balance, provide genuine work flexibility, and have family-friendly policies in place. Electric mobility is new territory for you? Don’t worry! As part of your onboarding, you will participate in a series of exciting workshops where you will learn everything about our industry and fast-charging infrastructure. Our benefits package includes: Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation. Pension plan (fully covered by Fastned). A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities. In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered), which is also for private use. 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you two mission days you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you. Going the extra mile for parents: We provide you with personalised coaching support before, during, and after parental leave, facilitated by Foundree. Understanding women's health is beneficial for all of us, fostering empathy, improving communication, and creating a more inclusive workplace. That's why we teamed up with Flouria, providing you with quick access to a broad range of women's health professionals. Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations. Next to fun events year-round, we throw notorious Christmas parties and organise an amazing yearly trip abroad with all employees. title: Senior SDK Hardware Simulator Engineer
description: About Us: Innatera is a rapidly growing Dutch semiconductor company that develops ultra-efficient neuromorphic processors for AI at the edge. These microprocessors mimic the brain’s mechanisms for processing fast data streams from sensors, enabling complex turn-key sensor analytics functionalities, with 10,000x higher performance per watt than competing solutions. Innatera's technology serves as a critical enabler for next-generation use cases in the IoT, wearable, embedded, and automotive domains. To support our rapid development roadmap, we’re looking for a Senior SDK Hardware Simulation Engineer to help drive the development of our simulation environment by enabling early application development and system validation before hardware is available. This role is critical to how our software and hardware teams collaborate to test, validate, and iterate on next-gen chip designs. We will trust you with: Design and implement simulation models in modern C++ (C++17/20) to replicate the functions of neuromorphic processors, CPUs, memory systems, and other components in the full SoC; Convert technical hardware specs into high-performance, verifiable software models; Contribute to performance modeling: simulate power consumption, latency to identify performance bottlenecks; Support early application development with accurate and configurable hardware simulation tools; Work closely with cross-functional teams (Digital Design, Firmware, SDK) to ensure models reflect the real hardware faithfully; Take ownership of simulation infrastructure quality: write unit tests, review code, and continuously improve design and maintainability; Collaborate on expanding our SDK feature set, ensuring the usability of the simulation for external developers. Participate in team brainstorming and contribute to other SDK development tasks as needed. What will you need to succeed: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; Strong C++ development skills (including C++17/20); Proven track record of designing modular, maintainable, and testable software architecture; Experience in transaction-level modeling of hardware components; Solid understanding of digital hardware fundamentals (e.g., CPU, instruction sets, memory systems, DMA); Familiarity with hardware/software co-design concepts; Working knowledge of Python (e.g., for scripting, automation, or SDK integration); Great communication skills. Nice to have: Experience working with RTL simulations, waveforms, and understanding how hardware behaves at the signal level; Experience in low-power resource-constrained embedded programming; Exposure to bare-metal firmware development, including assembly language; Familiarity with RISC-V or ARM computer architectures; Knowledge of machine learning, edge AI, and SNN (Spiking Neural Networks).
