title: International Expansion - Netherlands
description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
description: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce : making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio : letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Who you are: You are a builder before anything else . You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one : your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates : the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using. A growth path that follows your output, not your age : if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you. A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar. Flexible set-up : full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver. Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent. How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built. title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
description: Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln. Ihre Verantwortung Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher. Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle. Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg. Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein. Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte. Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern. Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion. Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil. Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen. Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien. Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung. Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze. Interessiert? Vertraulicher Erstkontakt Sie möchten mehr erfahren? title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect
description: <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">FEQ228R125</p> <p>As a Senior Specialist Solutions Architect (Sr. SSA) for AI/ML, you will be the go-to technical expert for Databricks' AI platform across our customers. You will help them move from AI experiments to <strong>governed, cost-efficient agents and ML systems running on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform</strong>.</p> <p>You will work with Account Executives and Solutions Architects to win strategic opportunities. You will design architectures for advanced agent and ML use cases and lead hands-on proofs of concept and MVPs. You will act as a trusted advisor to customer technical leaders on AI strategy, governance and economics. You will also shape our AI go-to-market in the region, enable the wider field team, and feed what you learn from customers back to Product and Engineering.</p> <p>This role reports to the Manager, Specialist Solutions Architects – Switzerland, Austria & Eastern Europe.</p> <h3><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Win the technical decision for AI on Databricks.</strong> Lead discovery, architecture design, demos, proofs of concept and MVPs for agent, GenAI and ML use cases in competitive evaluations.</li> <li><strong>Design production-grade agent systems.</strong> Architect agents and multi-agent applications using Agent Bricks, Databricks Apps, MCP tools, Lakebase, AI Search and the Foundation Model APIs. Govern assets under Unity Catalog</li> <li><strong>Make agent quality measurable.</strong> Help customers build evaluation and observability into everything they ship, using MLflow tracing, domain-specific LLM judges, labelled evaluation datasets, release gates and production monitoring.</li> <li><strong>Govern AI at enterprise scale.</strong> Position the AI Gateway as the central control point for model access, guardrails, PII protection, usage tracking and rate limiting.</li> <li><strong>Scale your expertise.</strong> Enable SAs and partners with workshops, reusable assets and reference architectures. </li> <li><strong>Influence the product.</strong> Bring structured customer feedback and requirements specific to the market to Product Management and Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Be a visible voice.</strong> Represent Databricks at customer executive briefings, meetups, conferences and in written content.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we look for</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering or data science, including customer-facing technical work (pre-sales, consulting or technical leadership).</li> <li><strong>A track record of shipping LLM and agent systems to production</strong>, not just prototypes, including evaluation, monitoring and cost management.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agent architecture: tool use and function calling, MCP, agent memory and state, orchestrating multiple agents, and retrieval and context design.</li> <li>Strong practical experience <strong>evaluating GenAI systems</strong>: tracing, LLM-as-a-judge, building evaluation datasets, regression testing and observability in production.</li> <li>Hands-on with at least one modern agent framework (e.g. LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, DSPy). You should be framework-agnostic in how you design.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the foundation-model landscape (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models) and the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost and data residency.</li> <li>Strong grounding in classical ML and MLOps: model development, deployment, monitoring and lifecycle management at scale.</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills in Python and SQL. You use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) daily and can build a working demo application quickly.</li> <li>Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms.</li> <li>Proven ability to influence technical leaders up to CTO/CDO level and to explain complex AI topics in business terms.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Proven ability to communicate and teach complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: IT Applications & AI Specialist
description: Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy . Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house . La produzione è effettuata dalla nostra azienda italiana di Siziano (Pavia-Milano Sud). Sostenibilità, qualità, innovazione e sicurezza sono per noi valori chiave. Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale . La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con le diverse funzioni aziendali, raccogliendone le esigenze e traducendole in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Avrà un ruolo sia operativo sia progettuale nello sviluppo, nell’integrazione e nel mantenimento delle applicazioni aziendali, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alla realizzazione di progetti innovativi per il business. Principali responsabilità: sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365 , con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale in grado di migliorare l’efficienza operativa, l’integrazione dei dati e l’esperienza degli utenti partecipare allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione delle applicazioni gestionali aziendali , contribuendo all’integrazione di funzionalità AI, API, flussi di dati e soluzioni di automazione a supporto delle diverse aree di business seguire, dal punto di vista tecnico e applicativo, lo sviluppo del progetto digitale dedicato al settore cosmetico , collaborando alla definizione delle funzionalità, alla realizzazione delle soluzioni, ai test e alla relativa integrazione nell’ecosistema aziendale garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni sviluppate, gestendo attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento, test, troubleshooting, documentazione tecnica e supporto agli utenti, anche in collaborazione con partner e fornitori esterni Requisiti richiesti: conoscenza dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 e capacità di sviluppare o configurare soluzioni basate su SharePoint, Power Automate e Power Apps competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python , e familiarità con API, database, integrazioni tra sistemi e tecnologie di sviluppo moderne conoscenza dei principi e degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale, automazione e analisi dei dati , con interesse per la loro applicazione concreta nei processi aziendali capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, autonomia operativa, capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici Requisiti formativi e professionali preferenziali: laurea o diploma a indirizzo informatico, ingegneristico, scientifico o formazione equivalente esperienza nello sviluppo, nella migrazione o nell’integrazione di applicazioni e flussi all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone obiettivi, priorità e processi Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, concreta e orientata all’innovazione, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche e comprensione delle esigenze del business. Il profilo ideale possiede un approccio hands-on , autonomia operativa e interesse verso la sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie. È in grado di seguire un progetto dalla raccolta delle esigenze fino al rilascio della soluzione, mantenendo attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza, alla semplicità di utilizzo e alla sostenibilità nel tempo. In GFL accogliamo con piacere ogni candidatura e crediamo nel valore delle persone, nella loro unicità e nelle loro storie. Valorizziamo la diversità e offriamo pari opportunità a chiunque voglia far parte del nostro percorso. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
description: Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution. Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit. En tant qu' Expansion Associate , tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande , avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes. Tasks Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique , chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient. Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu. Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce. Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir. Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise. Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce. Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable. Requirements Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle. Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires. Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas. Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes. Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise. Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande. Anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, notre langue de travail interne. BONUS Expérience dans le secteur immobilier suisse (formation en gérance immobilière, cours USPI, activité de courtage) Réseau existant auprès des régies et des propriétaires à Genève et dans la région lémanique Expérience dans l' univers du coliving ou des appartements meublés avec services Connaissances de base du droit du bail suisse Allemand Benefits Salaire fixe plus bonus progressif pour chaque chambre acquise, sans plafond : plus tu acquiers de chambres, plus tu gagnes par chambre. Bureau à Lausanne, avec la possibilité de télétravailler certains jours Équipement de ton choix (ordinateur portable, écran, accessoires) Des processus et des listes de contrôle documentés, et un·e responsable d'équipe à qui reviennent les exceptions, pour que tu puisses faire ta part avec précision au lieu d'improviser Un rôle qui t'appartient : tu ne fais pas partie d'une équipe d'acquisition, tu es l'acquisition en Suisse romande Une équipe internationale et solidaire, avec une vraie culture de l'apprentissage Budget de formation continue (cours, livres, conférences) Une vraie évolution : ton ambition détermine jusqu'où tu iras, tes résultats à quelle vitesse. Ton périmètre de responsabilité grandit avec les deux. Chez Room Estate, tu bénéficies de vraies responsabilités et d'un feedback direct, sans micromanagement ni langue de bois. On se tutoie, on se dit les choses, et nous sommes exigeants : tu as le droit de l'être tout autant avec nous. Des séminaires d'équipe, une fête d'été annuelle et une collaboration étroite avec des collègues de différents pays font partie de l'aventure et élargissent ton réseau personnel et professionnel. Mais l'essentiel est simple : nous voulons progresser chaque jour et nous cherchons des personnes qui le veulent aussi. Ici, tu assumes un rôle qui compte, dans un environnement international, et tu contribues activement à façonner l'avenir du coliving en Europe. Rejoins Room Estate et construis avec nous l'avenir du logement. 🚀 Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Private Banker mit einem aufgebauten Kundenbuch
description: Unsere Mandantin, ist eine internationale, unabhängige Privatbank im Herzen von Zürich, die sich auf die ganzheitliche Vermögensverwaltung und Anlageberatung spezialisiert hat. Dabei legt sie grossen Wert auf Innovation und Unabhängigkeit in Bezug auf Produktpolitik und deren Selektion. Im Zuge des weiteren Ausbaus, sind wir beauftragt worden, zwei unternehmerische und eigenständige Persönlichkeiten zu gewinnen, als Private Banker-/ Relationship Manager mit einem aufgebauten Kundenbuch Als erfolgsorientierter Private Banker überträgt Ihnen unser Kunde die Verantwortung seinen Brand bei Ihrem bestehenden Kundenstamm in einer hohen Komplexität zu präsentieren. Durch profunde Beratung und raschen Vertrauensaufbau entwickeln Sie langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, die dem Stile der Bank entsprechen. Zudem verstehen Sie es durch gezielte Durchführung von Kundenveranstaltungen, für die nötigen Akzente in Ihrem Marktgebiet zu sorgen. Sie sind auf der Suche nach der beruflichen Herausforderung, in welcher Sie Ihre ausgeprägte, unternehmerische Denkens- und Handelsweise einbringen können, mit der Möglichkeit Ihr eigenes Portfolio und Ihr persönliches Kundennetzwerk in einer transparenten Private-Banking-Struktur weiterzuentwickeln. title: MSF International Managing Director
description: Location: Based in Geneva or within approximately +/- two (2) hours from Geneva Contract: Fixed term at 100% - It is a mandated role (currently 3+3 years) Starting date: 01st of March 2027 Deadline to apply: 26th of November 2026 - We reserve the right to close this position once suitable candidates have been identified. Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement. Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement. The role ensures that MSF International: Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities. Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee); Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care; Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems; Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization; Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management; Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland. The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International. III. ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments. Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners. a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services. b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments. c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services. d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope. e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates. f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests. 2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making. Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated. a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance. b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International. c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations. d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International. e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use. f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law. g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans. 3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery. Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations. a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded. b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy. c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency. d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues. 4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements. Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives. a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International. b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation. c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements. d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel. e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International. f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International 5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce. Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture. a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning. b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning. d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread,

title: Senior RAM Engineer
description: Destinus Engineering is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Reliability Engineer to ensure that our defense systems and products perform dependably in demanding operational environments. You’ll lead reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) efforts across Destinus systems and products covering the full product lifecycle, from early design trade studies through qualification, fielding, and sustainment. You will work closely with system design, test, and supply chain teams as well as customers. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and leadership skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams. Key Responsibilities · Develop and execute reliability program plans in line with contract requirements and applicable standards (e.g., MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-1629, IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L or customer-specific equivalents) · Perform reliability predictions, FMEA/FMECA, fault tree analysis, derating and worst-case analyses, and reliability block diagram modeling · Define and run reliability test programs, including HALT/HASS, environmental stress screening, accelerated life testing, and reliability growth testing · Contribute to design reviews (PDR, CDR) and influence design for reliability and maintainability early in development · Support sustainment engineering, including obsolescence and parts-quality assessments, and supplier reliability oversight · Prepare reliability documentation and present findings to internal leadership and government customers · Availability modelling and allocating RAM requirements down from the system to subsystems · Maintainability analysis plus testability and BIT coverage analysis · Input to the maintenance and logistic support analysis, working with ILS Requirements Required Qualifications · BSc or MSc in engineering (electrical, mechanical, systems, or related) · [7+] years of reliability engineering experience preferably in the defense sector · Experience in a tier 1 defense supplier company interacting directly with the military customer is a plus · Hands-on experience with FMEA/FMECA, reliability prediction, and statistical life data analysis · Experience with Air Defence and / or Strike systems is a plus · Experience with modern European RAM standards: IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L · Familiarity with military reliability and environmental standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and DoD acquisition or equivalent processes · Experience using RWB Isograph or similar RAMS software. · Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities · Ability to work autonomously and as part of a fast-paced, dynamic, international and multidisciplinary development team. · Fluency in English is required; German is a plus. title: Mechanical Engineer, Jigs & Tools
description: About the Role The Destinus engineering team is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering jigs and tooling solutions as part of the research and development in the rocket motor department. In this role, you will design and develop equipment and machines for testing and production of our products. The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience as a mechanical engineer with experience in industrialization projects, mechanical design and DFM with a demonstrated ability to take ownership during development and drive technical solutions. Responsibilities Take the technical lead for the Jigs and Tools development Review product designs from a production point of view Understand and evaluate the production steps and the needed tools Research existing off-the-shelf components and combine them to a production solution Generate 3D CAD models, drawings, bills of material, and other related documentation required for production. Deliver technical documentation including any engineering calculations, analysis and assumptions required to substantiate your design decisions and solutions. Manage suppliers and manufacturers by addressing any technical questions and resolving any issues which may arise during the manufacturing process. Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables following best practices and industry standards. Coach junior engineers and interns in jigs and tooling design, manufacturing and CAD. Participate in design reviews and technical discussions during different development stages. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical, testing, and industrialization engineers, to ensure seamless integration and functionality of the components into the vehicle. Requirements Qualifications and Experience BSc. In Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering or a related discipline. Ideally, technical training as a mechanical designer/drafter, Toolmaker or Mechanic Min. 3 years of experience in mechanical engineering with close ties to jigs & tools for production Knowledge of machining, sheet metal, composites and assembly processes, and of metrology and inspection methods. Lean manufacturing knowledge is desirable. Experience with 3D printing for tooling is a plus. Experience with design of automated solutions, special machines or test benches is a benefit Ideally, experience in several different phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation. Good communication skills, proactive attitude, and problem-solving skills. The ability to work to strict timescales as part of an integrated, multidisciplinary team and autonomously. The ability and willingness to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing work environment. Willingness to travel to different Destinus sites in Switzerland (max. 20%) Fluency in English and German language is required. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

regulated financial services environment and how it is changing</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰A salary range of €68,000 - €85,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has <li>Final stage 2-part Role Specific and Behavioural interviews with members from the wider Risk and Compliance collective</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next title: Software Engineer (80-100%)
description: Worum geht es? Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln. Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team. title: System Identification Engineer
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles. As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Lausanne, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust. Responsibilities Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the . Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller. Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects. Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting. Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C. New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles. Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data. Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for. Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs. Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun. Nice to have Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven. Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code. Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models. title: Storytelling and narrative lead
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are looking for an outstanding <strong>storytelling and narrative development lead</strong> to lead our content marketing team. Canonical has a robust portfolio of open source products and offers support for a wide range of open source technologies. This role is for someone who cares deeply about narrative quality and wants to elevate our brand positioning. It requires process discipline and creative smarts, leadership skills and performance-driven strategy to ensure our content aligns with our business objectives. </p> <p>The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They would love to gain experience optimizing content processes, coaching others on their narrative skills and building brand authority. They enjoy learning and improving themselves, the team and the organization. They problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation to make daily life easier. To succeed in this role, the candidate must be metrics-driven, highly organized and skilled at team development, capacity planning and cross-functional collaboration.  </p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Communications. </p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home based in the EMEA region. </p> <h2>What your day will look like</h2> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a content strategy that aligns with our business goals, SEO and brand. </li> <li>Manage our content calendar end to end, ensuring content is efficiently produced with minimum friction and process clarity.</li> <li>Ensure content quality, consistency and brand alignment in everything we produce. </li> <li>Collaborate with our web and growth engineering teams to optimize content for search and AI engines, building on proven SEO or GEO expertise. </li> <li>Supervise quarterly content planning sessions and work closely with content specialists, product management and marketing to optimize content plans.</li> <li>Monitor and report on KPIs for our content program and use analytics tools to identify improvement opportunities. </li> <li>Align messaging to ensure integrated campaign support across channels, working closely with our marketing, product and brand teams.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of work experience in content or related roles, preferably at technology companies, with 2+ years of experience as a manager or team lead. </li> <li>Proven experience creating authoritative and engaging content. Portfolio of written work required.</li> <li>Applied knowledge of GEO and SEO, experience with relevant tools and SEO-driven content calendars. </li> <li>Excellent project management and interpersonal skills with the ability to create highly efficient processes for content production and reuse. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or a relevant discipline. </li> <li>Someone who is passionate about technology and open source. </li> <li>A problem solver: you don’t shy away from taking on challenges and see projects through to completion. </li> <li>Attention to detail and appreciation for standards: you value quality and accuracy but can adapt quickly when the need arises.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  <br>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <p>🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</p> <p>📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum</p> <p>💰Annual compensation review</p> <p>🏆Recognition rewards</p> <p>🏝 Annual holiday leave</p> <p>👶Parental Leave</p> <p>🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme</p> <p>🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</p> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Senior FinCrime Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. You will need to oversee our outsourced partners, holding them accountable for SLAs and performance. This position requires in-depth data analysis expertise and a strong commitment to data-driven decision making, alongside a solid understanding of day-to-day fincrime operations and deep knowledge of transaction monitoring, AML/CTF, screening, and onboarding rules and models implementation. You will work across different areas and products including our current and business accounts and partner with our group data science, data engineering, product, and technology teams.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving strategic partners oversight: Ensuring that our outsourcing partners for FinCrime Operations are operating effectively.</li> <li>Monitoring our FinCrime metrics and driving action delivery with our product teams to address the trends.</li> <li>Combining hands-on execution with strategic thinking to align cross-functional teams with our FinCrime, AML/ CTF vision and strategy.</li> <li>Helping to build and oversee solutions with technology at the heart of our screening, onboarding and transaction monitoring mitigation strategies to cover the various typologies using automated alerts.</li> <li>Supporting the Director of FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes operations with producing Committee packs.</li> <li>Supporting and managing the oversight of change implementation, making prioritisation calls of those initiatives. </li> <li>Working closely with the second line of defence and our Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) to complete assurance activity, identification and remediation of any actions. </li> <li>Collaborating across the company to remove roadblocks and solve complex challenges relating to Monzo's EU expansion.</li> <li>Supporting 3rd line of defence with auditing activities. </li> <li>Being an excellent partner to our third party vendors, unblocking and empowering their teams for high delivery and high performance. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You excel at leveraging robust data insights and analytics to drive strategic decision-making.</li> <li>You are a problem solver who takes initiative to create a high impact for stakeholders.</li> <li>Excel at stakeholder management and coordination across multiple teams.</li> <li>You have previous experience of achieving results through 3rd party/outsourcing  management and you’re excited about working in a cross-functional team with engineers and data scientists to empower third party vendors' success.</li> <li>You have previous experience leading and managing FinCrime operations in payments or banking.</li> <li>You enjoy partnering with 3rd party vendors, data scientists, and second line of defence (2LOD) to proactively mitigate and respond to existing and emerging fraud trends.</li> <li>You understand the Financial crime,  money mulling risks of the various products and services operating in the fintech space.</li> <li>You champion the use of automated processes to find more efficient ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €76,500 - €95,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

For this role, appointment will be conditional on Monzo being fully satisfied that the appointee meets the requirements as set out in the Fitness and Probity Standards issued by the Central Bank of Ireland. As a CF, the role holder will be subject to Conduct Standards under the Central Bank of Ireland Individual Accountability Framework (IAF) and will be required to take reasonable steps to ensure that the relevant conduct standards are met.</p> <p> <strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the second line subject matter expert for operational risk, technology (ICT and security risk (including cyber)), and operational resilience.</li> <li>Reviewing and challenging the design and effectiveness of controls over key technology systems, digital infrastructure.</li> <li>Providing effective oversight and challenge of first line risk and control self-assessments (RCSA), incident management and reporting, issue remediation and risk mitigation processes.</li> <li>Providing second line input into our technology and security strategies and business continuity planning.</li> <li>Supporting the ongoing development and maintenance of our Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, standards and associated ICT,  Security and Resilience policies and risk appetite metrics.</li> <li>Co-ordinating second line assurance reviews and risk deep dives into critical operational and technology areas, providing actionable recommendations and insights.</li> <li>Overseeing ongoing compliance with  the digital operational resilience act (DORA) in the EU and ensuring alignment  with applicable local regulatory standards.</li> <li>Preparing operational and technology risk reports and providing updates to relevant governance forums, including risk committees and senior management.</li> </ul> <p> <strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 8+ years’ experience in operational risk, technology risk or related roles in financial services, ideally within a digital or challenger bank, or a pan-European firm. </li> <li>You have a deep knowledge of risk management practices, regulatory expectations, and industry standards related to operational risk, technology and operational resilience. (e.g. EBA Guidelines on ICT & Security Risk Management, DORA, Central Bank of Ireland Guidance on Operational Resilience, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Payment Service Directive (PSD2/PSD3)).</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of digital banking technology, including cloud computing, cybersecurity, fintech integrations and data management.</li> <li>You have experience in evaluating and challenging risk and control environments, particularly in high-growth or fast-changing environments.</li> <li>You are an ambitious risk professional ready to leave the constraints of legacy firms behind. This role places you at the cutting edge of technology and operational risk, challenging you to define the governance needed for our next-generation platforms.</li> <li>You have strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills.</li> <li>You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership. </li> <li>You have a proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes such as working with regulators/managing regulatory engagements.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? title: Accountant
description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical.  You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.</span></p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</span></p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.</span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote</span></p> <p> </p>

We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies. </p> <p>You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.</p> <p>We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This opportunity is available in the APAC region and is remote.</p> <p><strong>The role entails:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic planning and analysis:</strong> preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success.
