Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration: </strong>collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.</li> <li><strong>Documentation and reporting: </strong>you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject</li> <li>Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries</li> <li>Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific</li> <li>Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration</li> <li>Experience growing and developing a CSM team</li> <li>Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

France is a Tier 1 region in Notion’s country-first EMEA model, with significant room to scale into a standalone, high-growth business. Notion is shifting from a traditional sales model toward a builder-led model with fewer handoffs, stronger technical fluency, and more direct ownership of customer outcomes. As General Manager, France, you will be the second-line leader responsible for overall revenue outcomes, regional GTM strategy, and the operating model for the French business. You will lead through frontline managers, teams of Business Development Representatives, Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects as well as partner cross functionally with Professional Services, Channel Partnerships and RevOps. This is a hands-on builder-leader role for an AI-native, country-first GTM model. You will bring Notion’s new GTM model to life in France: moving from a segment-first motion to a country-first, AI-native operating system where teams help customers diagnose problems, design agentic workflows, and build real systems with Notion AI. This role sits on the EMEA Leadership Team and reports to the General Manager, EMEA. This role will be based in Paris. Make agentic transformation central to the French GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption. - Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, Marketing and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value. - Create a talent destination in France by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent. - Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent. You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow. You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years leading SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in France. - Deep knowledge of the French enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics across all market segments (commercial, midmarket and enterprise) - Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams. - Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics. - Agency & Urgency: experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment. - Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products. - Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes. - Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process. - Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative. - Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product. - Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building. - Fluency in French and English. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model. - Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes. - Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation. title: Manager, People Analytics
location: Home Based - Americas; Home based - EMEA
description: <p>The Workplace Engineering function sits at the intersection of traditional HR analytics and modern Product Engineering. We transform raw workforce data into a suite of "People Products" that drive high performance. We don’t just "report" on what happened; we engineer the tools and insights that determine what happens next.</p> <p>This new role will report directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, and sits within our Data discipline inside of our People department. Experienced data professionals at Canonical live at the intersection of software, data, and the business. They don't just help surface analytic artifacts; they help transform them into a strategic asset that elevates decision making and innovation across our global operations (e.g., sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources). They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, designing and iterating on experiments, automations, and products that transform insights into valued outcomes. They shape tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source, ensuring that Canonical remains at the forefront of data-driven excellence. Their curiosity is contagious and has an amplifying effect on data literacy and stewardship across the business teams they support.</p> <p>Location: This is a remote role based in the AMER or EMEA Region.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Multi-Disciplinary Leadership:  Lead and mentor a specialized squad of People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers. You aren't just managing analysts; you are leading a product squad.</li> <li>Product Ownership on People Science: Bridge the gap between "HR-speak" and "Dev-speak", ensuring engineers understand the human behavioral intent behind the code.</li> <li>Strategic Insight & Business Outcomes: Move beyond descriptive metrics (e.g., turnover rate) to predictive and prescriptive insights (e.g., predicting attrition risk based on "Time-Product" engagement data).</li> <li>Data Stewardship & Product Storytelling: Act as the "Translator-in-Chief". Our goal is to deliver the world's best long term OS stability commitment on PC, server and IoT hardware.</p> <p>We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should be very comfortable reviewing a patch or a software design spec. You’ll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus and learning.</p> <p>In this Engineering Director role, you will lead the strategy and the team responsible for quality coordination and integration testing of our software stacks with hardware. We are looking for a quality expert with the ability to establish quality processes from the ground up. The candidate must understand today's PC and ARM IoT hardware, and be excited about the new generation of RISC-V hardware that is on the horizon. They should understand the board and device product lifecycle and know the tools and techniques used to introduce new products. They will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill combined with management experience.</p> <p>Today, most Linux certification is poor quality. Vendors run one set of tests and then declare that 'the hardware is certified'. But Linux is not a static platform. We make many more security fixes in the Linux world than people traditionally made in the proprietary OS world - all of these need to be tested on hardware which has been certified, even if that certification is 'old'. Also, Linux and open source evolve significantly every six months, and even more between major enterprise releases like the Ubuntu LTS versions. During the lifespan of an LTS, new kernel improvements will be available to users, and they want to be sure that their hardware will work. Today's Linux certification programs do not meet the needs of its users, and we want to change that.</p> <p>Our intention is to deliver <strong>continuous quality and certification</strong> across the entire portfolio of certified hardware. Once we have enabled and certified a device, we intend to keep testing it to ensure that every single change we deliver to Ubuntu users globally is verified on all the hardware we know about. We also intend to <strong>measure energy consumption</strong> on a continuous process, as part of our commitment to <strong>measure, manage and drive down the carbon footprint of Ubuntu</strong> usage around the planet. We are building the world's largest and best-equipped Linux device certification facility in Taipei, which will enable this continuous testing. We are also structuring our renewed partnership and customer agreements to facilitate this process going forward.</p> <p>We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. Our engineering directors and managers help teams achieve more than they thought they could, and feel proud of the result.</p> <p>As an Engineering Director at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the teams you lead, to ensure that they measure outcomes, make process improvements, do valuable work, and find career satisfaction at Canonical. We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers.</p> <p>We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.</p> <p>You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation, security and performance in your work.</p> <p>At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, Private Clouds, MAAS and Kubernetes across a broad range of devices and use cases.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: we have network software engineering roles in APAC (Top-of-Rack switches) and Americas (SmartNIC/DPU) time zones.</p> <h2>What your day will look like</h2> <ul> <li>Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available</li> <li>Participate upstream and deliver the Ubuntu SoNIC stack</li> <li>Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers</li> <li>Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the data center</li> organization</li> <li>Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind</li> <li>Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities</li> <li>Influence open-source projects and communities</li> <li>Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path</li> <li>Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols</li> <li>Understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space</li> <li>Fluency in C/C++ and at least one of Rust, Python or Golang</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Experience with Linux</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, drive to meet commitments </li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each</li> </ul> <h2>Additional skills that you might also bring</h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with title: Product Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical. You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.</p> <p>We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. description: <p>Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. title: Renewals Sales Manager, Americas
description: <p>Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.</p> <p>We are profitable and growing our global enterprise sales organisation. We are hiring a <strong>regional sales renewal team manager</strong> in North America to lead the renewals team in the region.</p> <p>We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.</p> <p>Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.</p> <p>Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and over $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.</p> <p>We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.</p> <p>In building our sales team, we look for five things:</p> <ul> <li>Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems</li> <li>High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence</li> <li>Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes</li> <li>Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions</li> <li>Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers</li> </ul> <p>Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.</p> <p>The successful candidate will carry an annual team bookings quota within their territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagements or, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness in managing their team. They will need to coach, mentor and lead by example. Their sales representatives are expected to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open sales team manager roles in every region.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting</li> <li>Allocate portions of territory and accounts to sales representatives on your team</li> <li>Identify and prioritise new logo accounts in your territory for account-based marketing and prospecting</li> <li>Ensure that sales representatives have high quality account plans for existing accounts and priority prospects</li> <li>Monitor new pipeline development by your team, through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events</li> <li>Support contract closure to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets</li> <li>Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives</li> <li>Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities</li> <li>Ensure your team maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce</li> <li>Represent the company, its solutions and software</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science</li> <li>Leadership and management skill</li> <li>Experience of open source technology and solutions</li> <li>Detail oriented with effective planning, organisation and reporting skill</li> <li>Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution</li> <li>Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins</li> <li>Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market</li> <li>Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events</li> </ul> <h3>Additional skills of interest</h3> <ul> <li>Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech</li> <li>Experience speaking at conferences or industry events</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team meetings in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Ejemplos de éxito de los clientes incluyen IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma de desarrollo preferida.</p> <p><strong>El papel de un representante de desarrollo de ventas en Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical es rentable y está creciendo. Consideramos que nuestra organización de desarrollo de ventas es la mejor academia de ventas de tecnología del mercado y, como tal, seleccionamos candidatos excepcionales y ambiciosos para unirse a nuestro equipo. Disfrutarás de este papel si eres organizado, persistente, carismático y trabajador. Deberás estar interesado en la tecnología y sus implicaciones comerciales. En este puesto, colaborarás con un equipo regional de ventas y marketing, y tu objetivo principal es encontrar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestras líneas de productos y difundir el buen nombre de Canonical en múltiples industrias y geografías diferentes.</p> <p>Haz clic <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FTMaesnL8LM">AQUÍ</a> para ver a nuestro equipo SDR discutir su papel en Canonical</p> <p><strong>Cómo será tu día</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manejar las consultas entrantes de los clientes a través de correo electrónico, teléfono y chat.</li> <li>Ejecutar campañas salientes de ventas y marketing.</li> <li>Viajar a eventos y conferencias en todo el mundo, presentar en stands e impulsar oportunidades de marketing y ventas cara a cara.</li> <li>Colaborar entre múltiples equipos y partes interesadas de alto nivel para impulsar resultados.</li> <li>Trabajar directamente con marketing en campañas.</li> <li>Investigar información sobre clientes potenciales.</li> <li>Generar un pipeline de varios millones</li> <li>Identificar perspectivas y tendencias del mercado.</li> <li>Ayudar a definir los procesos y políticas del equipo.</li> <li>Servir de enlace con clientes nuevos y existentes, organizando y asistiendo a reuniones mientras mapea activamente cuentas para identificar nuevas oportunidades.</li> <li>Crear, actualizar, mantener y fomentar con precisión clientes potenciales en oportunidades globales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lo que buscamos en ti</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excelentes resultados académicos en la escuela y la universidad.</li> <li>Pasión por los negocios y la tecnología.</li> <li>Compromiso con el aprendizaje y la mejora continua: curioso, flexible, científico.</li> <li>Resolución creativa de problemas y colaboración entre equipos.</li> <li>Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.</li> <li>Impulsado por resultados con un espíritu de superación</li> <li>Persistencia y perseverancia</li> </ul> <p><strong>Que te ofrecemos</strong></p> <p>Tu salario base dependerá de varios factores, incluida su ubicación geográfica, nivel de experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además de los beneficios anteriores, ciertos roles también son elegibles para beneficios y recompensas adicionales, incluidas bonificaciones anuales e incentivos de ventas basados en los ingresos o la utilización. Nuestra filosofía de compensación es garantizar la equidad en toda nuestra fuerza laboral global.</p> <p>Además de un salario base competitivo, brindamos a todos los miembros del equipo beneficios adicionales que reflejan nuestros valores e ideales. Ten en cuenta que pueden aplicarse beneficios adicionales según el lugar de trabajo y, para obtener más información al respecto, consulte a su socio de talento.</p> <ul> <li>Presupuesto de aprendizaje y desarrollo personal de 2000 USD al año.</li> <li>Revisión anual de compensación</li> <li>Recompensas de reconocimiento</li> <li>Vacaciones anuales</li> <li>Licencia parental</li> <li>Programa de asistencia al empleado</li> <li>Oportunidad de viajar a nuevas ubicaciones para conocer colegas en "sprints"</li> <li>Priority Pass para viajes y mejoras de viaje para eventos de empresa de larga distancia</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Canonical es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades</em></strong></p> <p>Estamos orgullosos de fomentar un lugar de trabajo libre de discriminación. La diversidad de experiencias, perspectivas y antecedentes crean un mejor ambiente de trabajo y mejores productos. Cualquiera que sea su identidad, le daremos a su solicitud una consideración justa.</p> <p><br><br></p> <p>#LI-remoto</p>

title: Revenue Accountant
description: <h3><strong></strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3><strong></strong></h3> <h3><strong>The role of a Revenue Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS 15 experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS 15 or ASC 606.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the revenue recognition process relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>IFRS 15/ASC 606 revenue recognition experience</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar systems experience a plus</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3></h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3></h3>

title: Sales Enablement Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Sales Enablement</strong> leader to architect the growth journey for our global sales organization. At Canonical, sales enablement isn't just about onboarding; it’s about ensuring our teams can articulate the complex value of Ubuntu, OpenStack, and AI infrastructure to the world’s most sophisticated tech leaders. You will act as a trusted partner to identify, scope, and implement tooling and workflow improvements that drive efficiency and reduce friction in the sales process. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Sales, transforming high-level strategy into actionable field excellence.</p> <p>If you are an experienced <strong>leader </strong>ready to lead global strategy, you will find a high-performance environment that challenges you. You will work with Sales Leadership to identify performance gaps, reduce ramp time, improve productivity and increase win rates. This is a high-visibility role where you will ensure our "distributed-first" workforce remains the sharpest in the industry.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> These are EMEA-based remote roles.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead enablement programs to drive continuous improvement in sales productivity and ramp time</li> <li>Lead the design and execution of global sales enablement strategies to drive revenue growth </li> <li>Provide coaching and mentoring that incorporates sales strategy, process and proven sales methodology</li> <li>Drive the creation of advanced sales plays and competitive intelligence resources for enterprise markets</li> <li>Collaborate and align cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and all GTM teams to ensure enablement strategy supports broader organizational objectives</li> <li>Own the end-to-end sales onboarding experience, ensuring new hires reach peak productivity rapidly</li> <li>Identify and deliver training needs for Sales teams for continuous improvements</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Management and Marketing to translate technical roadmaps into value-based sales narratives</li> <li>Manage the sales enablement tech stack (CRM, LMS, etc.) to ensure tools are optimizing, not hindering, the sales process through right-time right-place delivery</li> <li>Provide a framework to relevant teams to develop and maintain high-quality sales assets, including discovery guides, pitch decks, and battlecards</li> <li>Facilitate live and virtual training sessions on advanced product features and sales techniques</li> <li>Coordinate the logistics for global sales training events and twice-yearly "sprint" weeks</li> <li>Monitor, report and act on the adoption and effectiveness of enablement initiatives using data-driven insights</li> <li>Support the senior team in preparing reports for leadership and auditing sales documentation for accuracy</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Demonstrated experience coaching sales leaders and diagnosing business challenges to drive organizational improvement</li> <li>Proficiency in a modern sales methodology such as MEDDPICC – able to coach leaders and sellers using this methodology</li> <li>Ability to align and influence others, establish direction, achieve consensus, and execute</li> <li>Experience building enablement programs from the ground up in emerging or high-growth markets</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship</li> <li>Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Appreciative of diversity and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in sales enablement, technical training, or sales operations (level-dependent)</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce, modern LMS platforms and project management tools (e.g. Jira)</li> <li>Basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

We have created a hiring process that is totally unique empowering our business based Hiring Leadership team to lead talent selection. Our Talent Science team ensures that our processes are effective and that the business is able to make the best decisions to select exceptional talent. This is an exceptional opportunity to join a team that is changing the way an organisation hires. </p> <p>We have a mission to ensure that we follow objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient processes to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. We work closely with a carefully selected hiring cohort to ensure we have exceptional judgement with a hiring model that supports the selection of world class talent, regardless of location, culture or background. We drive initiatives, build automations and offer an expert viewpoint on assessing talent. </p> <p>We are looking to advance our graduate hiring strategy to ensure we can reach and assess world class junior talent. The role will focus on building strong partnerships with top ranked universities across the globe. The suitable individual will bring experience of leading graduate hiring on a regional or global scale within the technology industry. You will possess a strong academic track record with the ability to analyse data, assess performance outcomes and build dashboard to monitor your outcomes. This is not a recruiter position;  it's about the science of talent and performance, raising awareness and insights across the business so that they are able to select the best talent available from our global talent pool. </p> <p>Location: This is a remote position based in the EMEA region</p> <h2>What your day will look like</h2> <ul> <li>Build effective partnerships with leading academic institutions to raise awareness of our graduate opportunities.</li> <li>Create a highly effective proposition to inspire top talent to apply to Canonical.</li> <li>Drive talent analytics to provide our business with real-time insight, partnering with the business to help them move through their hiring processes efficiently.</li> <li>Conduct in-depth behavioural talent interviews providing considerable insights into motivations and behaviours.</li> <li>Build key relationships with global stakeholders to ensure we deliver against our hiring agenda, closely monitoring hiring activities, driving results and ensuring that there is consistency in our operational processes.</li> <li>Drive data driven insights, making sure our decision making process is robust and supportive to inform our decisions.</li> <li>Consider our employer brand and how our interactions with a candidate impacts their experience.</li> <li>Review and streamline hiring processes and tools to drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Work with external third parties and platforms to ensure we maximise our return on investment.</li> <li>Bring a passion for diversity and inclusion, ensuring we remove unconscious bias from our hiring process and ensuring our sourcing strategy underpins this.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic background from both high school and university, with a Bachelors or Masters degree in a Psychology or People based subject.</li> <li>Experience of hiring talent in the technology industry, with an informed view point on graduate hiring essential.</li> <li>A highly data drive mindset with the ability to create measurable outcomes, using SQL.</li> <li>Passionate about how an organisation selects talent using scientific approaches with viewpoint on how to predict and measure hiring outcomes.</li> <li>Exposure/appreciation of psychometric assessments preferable, including interpretation.</li> <li>Experience of conducting behavioural, competency based interviews with the ability to train stakeholders and advise on how to get the best out of an interview.</li> <li>Experience of the following tools advantageous: Greenhouse, LinkedIn, Superset, Thomas International/DISC assessments.</li> <li>A high level of personal organisation and self drive to work remotely and be effective.</li> <li>Willingness to travel to company events 2-4 times a year, for up to two weeks each.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, including lounge access, for company travel</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Technical Product Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical. You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.</p> <p>We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.</p> <p>Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives.</p> <p>We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including:</p> <ul> <li>Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement</li> <li>Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem</li> <li>AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge</li> <li>IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics</li> <li>Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD</li> <li>Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs</li> <li>Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics</li> <li>Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434</li> <li>Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms</li> </ul> <p>If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone. You will be expected to be located in this region.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales</li> <li>Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track</li> <li>Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities</li> <li>Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations</li> <li>Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience</li> <li>Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training</li> <li>Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings</li> <li>Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams</li> <li>Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic results at high school and university</li> <li>Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community</li> <li>Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices</li> <li>Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape</li> <li>A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement</li> <li>Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning</li> <li>A strong sense of ownership</li> <li>Problem solving and the ability to innovate</li> <li>Outstanding communications skills in English, title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, DACH
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. - Fluency in English and German. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €270,000 - €325,000 per year. title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality and Test Engineering
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, <strong>Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives</strong> such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an <strong>Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality Engineering</strong>, to lead the team responsible for the test suites which validate hardware compatibility with Ubuntu Linux (Core, Desktop and Server – see <a href="https://ubuntu.com/certified">https://ubuntu.com/certified</a> for more information). You will pioneer the use of Canonical’s open source test frameworks and custom designed hardware to drive automated hardware validation of the operating system. This is a challenging position for a quality focused engineering leader, and requires an analytical mind with a passion for test automation and team leadership.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role will be office based in Taipei Minsheng district, Taiwan.</p> <h3>This role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the development and maintenance of Canonical’s hardware certification test suite</li> <li>Manage timely delivery of certifications as part of the hardware certification programmes</li> <li>Work collaboratively to ensure continuous improvement of test practices and tools</li> <li>Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers</li> <li>Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development</li> <li>Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders</li> <li>Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation</li> <li>Participate in strong engineering process through code, test plan, architectural reviews</li> <li>Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners</li> <li>International travel twice per year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Knowledge of low-level embedded software and hardware - BIOS, firmware, bootloaders, ACPI, devicetree, kernel, RTOS</li> <li>A good understanding of Linux system architecture</li> <li>Knowledge of quality and reliability oriented engineering practices</li> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or another technical subject</li> <li>Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Track record of delivery of timely, high quality software</li> <li>Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation</li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation </li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments </li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills we would value</h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with ARM, x86 and possibly RISC-V conventions and low-level enablement details</li> <li>Experience with continuous integration and delivery tools and practices</li> <li>Experience of automated testing practices in a hardware enablement setting</li> <li>In-depth project experience with Python</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>
